astr: Astar (ASTR) is a blockchain ecosystem founded by Japanese entrepreneur Sota Watanabe. It started as a Polkadot parachain and later expanded to Soneium, an Ethereum network; the project is popular in Japan and works with large corporations, and ASTR is its main token.
astr-ru: Astra Group is a Russian software developer based in Moscow, best known for the Astra Linux operating system. It also makes virtualization, backup, mail and database products used by government agencies and large companies.
asts: AST SpaceMobile is a US satellite company from Midland, Texas, building a network of large BlueBird satellites in low Earth orbit that connect directly to ordinary, unmodified smartphones. It partners with mobile operators such as AT&T, Verizon and Vodafone.
asurb: ASUR (Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste) is a Mexican airport operator. It runs Cancún International Airport, Mexico's main tourist gateway, and eight other airports in south-east Mexico, plus airports in Puerto Rico and Colombia.
at: APRO is a decentralized oracle that combines off-chain data processing with on-chain verification. It feeds smart contracts with prices, real-world asset data and event outcomes for DeFi, AI agents and prediction markets; AT is the network's token.
atco-a: Atlas Copco is a Swedish industrial group based near Stockholm, founded in 1873. It makes air compressors, vacuum pumps, industrial power tools and assembly systems, and portable power equipment used in factories and construction worldwide.
atd: Alimentation Couche-Tard is a Canadian company from Laval, Quebec, founded in 1980. It runs thousands of convenience stores and gas stations across North America, Europe and Asia under the Circle K and Couche-Tard brands.
ath: Aethir (ATH) is a decentralized GPU cloud for companies that need powerful graphics processors for artificial intelligence and cloud gaming. Hardware owners rent out their GPUs to the network and clients lease them; ATH is used for payments and staking.
ati: ATI is a US maker of specialty materials headquartered in Dallas. It produces titanium, nickel superalloys and stainless steel, plus complex parts for jet engines, defence, energy and medicine; aerospace is its main market.
atlas: Star Atlas is a space-exploration strategy game built on the Solana blockchain with Unreal Engine graphics, where players own ships and land as NFTs, mine resources and fight for territory. ATLAS is the in-game currency, while the separate POLIS token is used for governance.
atm: Atletico Madrid Fan Token (ATM) is the fan token of Spanish football club Atlético de Madrid on the Socios.com platform, running on the Chiliz chain. Holders vote in club polls and get access to VIP rewards and exclusive promotions.
atm-nz: The a2 Milk Company is a New Zealand dairy company, founded in 2000, that sells milk containing only the A2 type of beta-casein protein. Its best-known product is a2 Platinum infant formula, sold mainly in China, Australia and New Zealand, plus fresh milk in Australia and the US.
ato: Atmos Energy is the largest natural-gas-only distributor in the United States, headquartered in Dallas. It supplies gas to millions of homes and businesses in eight states, mostly in Texas, and owns gas pipelines and storage.
atom: Cosmos is an ecosystem of independent blockchains linked by the IBC protocol, which lets them exchange data and tokens. Dozens of networks are built with its tools (Cosmos SDK, CometBFT); ATOM is used for staking and governance of the Cosmos Hub.
atone: AtomOne (ATONE) is the staking and governance token of AtomOne, a community-driven fork of the Cosmos Hub focused on decentralization and a formal on-chain constitution. Transaction and IBC fees are paid in a separate token, PHOTON.
atos: Atoshi (ATOS) is the coin of the Atoshi project, which is building its own public blockchain with smart contracts and NFTs, inspired by Bitcoin and Ethereum. Its mobile app has a large user base that started in mainland China and spread across Asia.
atr: AptarGroup is an American company based in Illinois that makes dispensers, sprays, pumps and closures. Its products are used in nasal sprays and inhalers, perfumes, cosmetics, household cleaners, and food and drink packaging.
atr-token: Artrade (ATR) is the token of Artrade, an art marketplace on Solana where artists and collectors buy and sell artworks, both physical and digital, with each piece tied to an on-chain certificate.
ats: Alltoscan (ATS) is a project building an open-source block explorer that works with all rollups, the layer-2 networks built on top of blockchains such as Ethereum. It lets users look up transactions, addresses and tokens across these networks in one place.
ats-at: AT&S is an Austrian electronics company from Leoben that makes high-end printed circuit boards and IC substrates. Its products go into smartphones, computers and data-centre processors, cars, industrial equipment and medical devices.
att: Grupa Azoty is Poland's largest chemical group, based in Tarnów and controlled by the state. It makes nitrogen and compound fertilizers, plastics such as polyamides, pigments and other chemicals.
auction: Bounce (AUCTION) is a decentralized platform for auctions and new token launches, founded in 2020. It helps projects run token and NFT sales, and AUCTION is used for staking and access to launches.
audd: Australian Digital Dollar (AUDD) is a stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the Australian dollar and backed by reserves held in Australia. Issued by a company of the Novatti group, it lets users hold and send Australian dollars on several blockchains.
audf: Forte AUD (AUDF) is a stablecoin designed to equal one Australian dollar, issued by the Australian company Forte. It lets businesses and people hold and move Australian dollars on blockchains for payments and settlement.
audio: Audius is a decentralized music streaming platform founded in 2018 in San Francisco. Artists upload tracks directly and keep control of their work, while AUDIO is used for staking, governance and rewards.
audx: Aussie Dollar Token (AUDX) is a stablecoin designed to keep a 1:1 value with the Australian dollar. It brings the Australian currency onto the blockchain, so it can be sent, traded or used in crypto apps the way dollar stablecoins are.
auki: Auki is a project that makes the physical world accessible to AI, robots and smart glasses. Its posemesh protocol gives devices a shared spatial understanding so they can navigate and find information inside real buildings; AUKI is the network's token.
aurora: Aurora is an Ethereum-compatible virtual machine (EVM) built on the NEAR Protocol blockchain. It lets developers run Ethereum apps with high throughput and low fees; the AURORA token is used for governance.
auto: Hastra AUTO is a token that gives exposure to the yield of a pool of US consumer auto loans on Figure's Democratized Prime platform. Holders earn the interest paid by real car-loan borrowers, minus the Hastra platform fee.
auto-gb: Auto Trader is the UK's largest online marketplace for new and used cars, based in Manchester. It began as a classified-ads magazine in 1977 and now earns mainly from car dealers who pay to advertise vehicles on its website and app.
av: Aviva is one of the UK's largest insurers, headquartered in London, with a history going back to 1696. It sells car, home and life insurance, pensions and investment products in the UK, Ireland and Canada.
ava: AVA is the token of Travala.com, a travel platform for booking hotels, flights and tours with cryptocurrency. AVA holders get discounts and cashback, and Travala was one of the first major travel services to accept crypto.
avail: Avail (AVAIL) is a modular blockchain focused on data availability: it stores and verifies transaction data for rollups and other chains so they can scale cheaply. It was spun out of Polygon in 2023; AVAIL pays fees and secures the network through staking.
avan: Bank Avangard is a private Russian commercial bank headquartered in Moscow, founded in 1994. It serves companies and individuals with accounts, loans and payment cards and is known for its own card processing and online banking.
avav: AeroVironment is a US defense company based in Virginia that makes drones and loitering munitions. It is known for the Puma and Raven reconnaissance drones and the Switchblade strike drone, used by Ukraine's armed forces, and also develops counter-drone systems.
avax: Avalanche is a smart-contract platform developed by Ava Labs, led by Emin Gün Sirer. It lets teams launch their own blockchains (L1s) for games, finance and business; AVAX pays fees and is used for staking.
avc: AlterVerse is a Web3 gaming ecosystem whose flagship title, AlterVerse: Disruption, is a free-to-play multiplayer shooter. The AVC token powers its in-game economy, player rewards and node programme.
avgo: Broadcom is a US company from Palo Alto, California, that designs semiconductors for networking, data centers, smartphones and custom AI accelerators for big tech companies. Since buying VMware, it is also a major supplier of enterprise software.
avici: Avici (AVICI) is a self-custodial crypto neobank on Solana that offers a Visa debit card for spending crypto and aims to add on-chain credit. Its token was launched through the MetaDAO launchpad.
avl: Avalon Labs (AVL) builds an on-chain financial center for Bitcoin holders: loans backed by BTC, a Bitcoin-backed stablecoin, yield-earning accounts and a crypto credit card. It started as a large issuer of Bitcoin-backed loans; AVL is the ecosystem's governance token.
avnt: Veranta (AVNT) is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange on the Base network where people can trade not only crypto but also real-world assets such as currencies, commodities and stocks. The AVNT token is used for governance and incentives.
avnt-etf: Avient is a US specialty materials company from Avon Lake, Ohio, formed in 2020 from PolyOne. It makes colorants and additives for plastics, inks and engineered composite materials, including the ultra-strong Dyneema fiber used in body armor and ropes.
avt: Avnet is an electronic components distributor from Phoenix, Arizona, founded in 1921. It supplies semiconductors, connectors and other parts from hundreds of manufacturers to electronics makers worldwide, and owns the Farnell distribution brand.
avt-token: Aventus is a London-based blockchain project that started in 2017 with a ticketing protocol meant to stop ticket touting and fraud, and later became a layer-2 network that gives businesses faster, cheaper transactions secured by Ethereum. AVT is used for fees and staking.
avtr: Avantor is an American supplier of laboratory products and chemicals based in Radnor, Pennsylvania. It sells reagents, consumables, equipment and services to biopharma companies, hospitals, universities and industry, largely under its well-known VWR brand.
avy: Avery Dennison is a US materials science company from Mentor, Ohio, founded in 1935 by Stan Avery, inventor of the self-adhesive label. It makes pressure-sensitive label materials, graphics films, apparel labels and tags, and RFID tags for retailers and brands.
awe: AWE Network is a project building identity and payment infrastructure for the AI agent economy. It began as the Autonomous World Engine, an engine for multi-agent worlds where many agents act at once; AWE is the ecosystem's governance token.
awin: AlphaWin (AWIN) is the token of a platform that runs open tournaments for financial prediction models: data scientists and quants submit forecasts and are rewarded based on how accurate they turn out to be going forward.
awk: American Water Works is the largest private water and wastewater utility in the United States, founded in 1886. From its headquarters in Camden, New Jersey, it supplies drinking water and treats wastewater for millions of people in more than ten states.
axiata: Axiata Group is a Malaysian telecom group based in Kuala Lumpur with mobile operators across South and Southeast Asia, including Robi in Bangladesh, Dialog in Sri Lanka, Smart in Cambodia and XLSmart in Indonesia. It also holds a large stake in CelcomDigi and runs tower and digital businesses.
axis: Axis Robotics (Axis AI) is a data infrastructure project for robotics and physical AI. Users control robots in simulations through tasks such as grasping objects and pose control, creating training data for models in exchange for crypto rewards.
axisbank: Axis Bank is one of India's largest private banks, based in Mumbai and founded in 1993 as UTI Bank. It offers retail and corporate banking, credit cards and loans, and in 2023 acquired Citibank's Indian consumer business.
axl: Axelar (AXL) is a cross-chain network that passes messages and assets between dozens of blockchains, including Ethereum, Cosmos and Solana. Developers use a simple API to build apps that work on several networks at once; AXL is used for validator staking and fees.
axon: Axon Enterprise is a US company from Arizona known for TASER stun guns, which gave the company its name until 2017. It also makes police body cameras and sells cloud software for storing evidence and running law-enforcement work.
axp: American Express is a US payments company based in New York, founded in 1850. It issues Amex credit and charge cards, processes the transactions itself and lends to cardholders, and is known for its rewards programs and travel services for affluent customers.
axs: Axie Infinity (AXS) is the governance token of Axie Infinity, a game by Vietnamese studio Sky Mavis in which players collect and battle fantasy NFT creatures. The game became a symbol of the 2021 play-to-earn boom and runs on the Ronin network.
axta: Axalta Coating Systems is a Philadelphia-based maker of paints and coatings and a former DuPont division. It supplies refinish paint for car repair shops, factory coatings for carmakers and industrial coatings for many other products.
ayi: Acuity (formerly Acuity Brands) is an American company based in Atlanta that makes light fixtures and lighting controls for offices, shops, streets and homes, including the Lithonia Lighting brand. It also develops building management and audiovisual control platforms.
aze: Azelis is a Belgian distributor of specialty chemicals and food ingredients based in Antwerp. It links chemical producers with manufacturers of cosmetics, food, pharmaceuticals and industrial goods, adding lab and formulation support.
azero: Aleph Zero is a layer-1 blockchain launched in 2021, developed largely by a team from Poland, that uses its own AlephBFT consensus for fast, low-cost transactions with quick finality. It focuses on privacy features based on zero-knowledge proofs and also has an Ethereum-compatible EVM layer; AZERO pays fees and is staked.
azn: AstraZeneca is a British-Swedish pharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, formed in 1999 by the merger of Astra and Zeneca. It develops medicines for cancer, heart, kidney and respiratory diseases, and for rare diseases through Alexion.
azn-etf: AstraZeneca is a British-Swedish pharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, formed in 1999 by the merger of Astra and Zeneca. It develops medicines for cancer, cardiovascular and respiratory diseases and is known for the COVID-19 vaccine developed with Oxford.
azo: AutoZone is the largest auto parts retailer in the US, headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, and founded in 1979. It sells parts, oils and accessories for cars and pickups to do-it-yourself owners and repair shops in the US, Mexico and Brazil.
azrg: Azrieli Group is one of Israel's largest real estate companies, founded by David Azrieli and based in Tel Aviv. It owns the Azrieli Center towers and a chain of shopping malls and office buildings across Israel, as well as senior housing and data centres.
aztec: Aztec is a privacy-focused layer-2 network on Ethereum: developers build apps in which users' transactions and data can be hidden using zero-knowledge proofs. The London-based team created its own programming language, Noir.
b: BUILDon (B) is a meme token on BNB Chain that emerged around the USD1 stablecoin and the community of "builders" in its ecosystem. Its value rests on community interest and trading rather than on a specific product.
b2: B² Network (BSquared) is a Bitcoin layer-2 that uses zero-knowledge proofs to extend what bitcoin can do. It adds smart contracts and DeFi while anchoring settlement to the Bitcoin network; B2 is the network token.
b2m: B2M is the token of Bit2Me, a Spanish cryptocurrency exchange based in Madrid and founded in 2014. Holding B2M gives users lower trading fees, rewards and other benefits on the Bit2Me platform.
b3: B3 is a project created by former members of the Base team that builds infrastructure for games, AI agents and automated workflows that execute on-chain transactions. Its main product, B3OS, is a workflow automation platform for agents.
b3sa3: B3 (Brasil, Bolsa, Balcão) is Brazil's main stock exchange, based in São Paulo. It runs trading in shares, derivatives and bonds, provides clearing, custody and registry services, and calculates the Ibovespa index.
b3tr: VeBetterDAO is a platform on the VeChain blockchain that rewards people for sustainable everyday actions, such as recycling, cycling or buying second-hand, through apps connected to it. Users earn B3TR tokens, which can be converted into VOT3 to vote on how rewards are shared between apps.
ba: Boeing is an American aerospace giant founded in Seattle in 1916 by William Boeing. It builds the 737, 777 and 787 passenger jets, military aircraft, satellites and space systems, and services airline fleets worldwide.
ba-gb: BAE Systems is the largest defence company in the UK and Europe, based in London and formed in 1999. It builds fighter jets (Eurofighter Typhoon, a share in the F-35), warships and nuclear submarines, CV90 combat vehicles and ammunition.
baby: Babylon (BABY) is a protocol that lets bitcoin holders stake BTC to secure other proof-of-stake blockchains without bridges or custodians, while the coins stay on the Bitcoin network. It was founded by Stanford researchers including David Tse; BABY is the token of Babylon's own chain.
babydoge: Baby Doge Coin (BABYDOGE) is a memecoin on BNB Chain launched in 2021 as the «child» of Dogecoin. Part of every transaction is burned and part is distributed to holders; the community is also known for charity work supporting animal shelters.
bac: Bank of America is one of the largest banks in the United States, headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It serves millions of individual and business customers and runs an investment bank and the Merrill brokerage; Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway is one of its biggest shareholders.
badger: Badger (BADGER) is the governance token of Badger DAO, a project launched in 2020 to bring bitcoin into decentralized finance on Ethereum. It offers vaults that earn yield on tokenized bitcoin and eBTC, a bitcoin-backed stablecoin-style asset.
bah: Booz Allen Hamilton is an American consulting and technology firm based in McLean, Virginia, founded in 1914. It works mainly for US government agencies, including the armed forces and intelligence community, on artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data analytics and engineering.
baidu: Baidu is a Chinese internet company from Beijing, founded in 2000 by Robin Li. It runs China's largest search engine, develops the Ernie AI language model and cloud services, and operates the Apollo Go robotaxi service.
bajaj-auto: Bajaj Auto is an Indian maker of motorcycles and three-wheelers based in Pune, part of the Bajaj Group. Its brands include Pulsar and Chetak, it is one of the world's largest three-wheeler makers, and it holds a stake in Austria's KTM.
bajajfinsv: Bajaj Finserv is an Indian financial holding company from Pune and part of the Bajaj group. It holds controlling stakes in the lender Bajaj Finance and in the Bajaj Allianz general and life insurance companies.
bajfinance: Bajaj Finance is India's largest non-bank lender, based in Pune and part of the Bajaj Group. It offers consumer loans for electronics and appliances, personal and business loans, home loans and deposits to tens of millions of customers.
bal: Balancer is a DeFi protocol launched on Ethereum in 2020 that runs decentralised exchange pools with many tokens and custom weights, which also work like self-rebalancing index portfolios. BAL is its governance token.
ball: Ball Corporation is a US maker of aluminum cans and bottles based in Westminster, Colorado, founded in 1880 by the Ball brothers, famous for Ball glass jars. Today it supplies beverage cans to drinks brands worldwide.
bami: Banco BPM is Italy's third-largest bank, formed in 2017 by merging Banco Popolare with Banca Popolare di Milano. It serves individuals and small and medium-sized businesses, mainly in northern Italy.
bamnb: Royal BAM Group is a Dutch construction company from Bunnik, founded in 1869. It builds homes, offices, schools, hospitals, roads, bridges and rail infrastructure, mainly in the Netherlands, the UK and Ireland.
ban: Comedian (BAN) is a meme token on Solana inspired by Maurizio Cattelan's controversial artwork «Comedian» — a banana duct-taped to a wall that sold at auction for millions of dollars in 2024.
banana: Banana Gun is a crypto trading ecosystem best known for its Telegram trading bot, which lets users buy and sell tokens quickly across several blockchains, plus the Banana Pro web terminal. BANANA holders receive a share of the bot's fees.
bananas31: Banana For Scale (BANANAS31) is a memecoin on BNB Chain inspired by a 2012 Reddit meme in which a banana is placed next to an object «for scale». It is a community token with no practical function whose price depends on interest in the meme.
band: Band Protocol (BAND) is a decentralized oracle founded in Thailand in 2017 that delivers outside data such as prices to blockchains and AI apps. It runs on its own BandChain blockchain in the Cosmos ecosystem.
bandai-namco: Bandai Namco is a Tokyo-based entertainment company formed in 2005 by merging toymaker Bandai and game maker Namco. It sells Gundam plastic models, Tamagotchi and other toys, makes and publishes games such as Pac-Man, Tekken and Elden Ring, and runs arcades and anime studios.
bane: Bashneft is a Russian oil company based in Ufa, Bashkortostan, controlled by Rosneft. It produces oil mainly in Bashkortostan and runs large refineries in Ufa that make fuel and petrochemicals.
bank: Lorenzo Protocol is an asset management platform for bitcoin and on-chain funds, running mainly on BNB Chain. It issues liquid bitcoin staking tokens such as stBTC and enzoBTC and yield products; BANK is the governance token.
bank-of-china: Bank of China is one of China's four big state-owned banks, headquartered in Beijing and founded in 1912. The most international of Chinese banks, it specializes in foreign-exchange and trade finance and has branches in dozens of countries.
bankbaroda: Bank of Baroda is one of India's largest state-owned banks, founded in 1908 by Maharaja Sayajirao Gaekwad III in Vadodara (Baroda). It offers retail, corporate and digital banking through a large branch network in India and branches abroad.
bankroll: Bankroll (BANKROLL) is a Solana token paired with USDC: every transfer carries a 3% fee that is paid out to holders in USDC, and its trading pool is permanently locked, so liquidity cannot be withdrawn.
bar: FC Barcelona Fan Token (BAR) is the fan token of Spanish football club FC Barcelona on the Socios.com platform and the Chiliz blockchain. Holders vote in club polls and get bonuses, prizes and access to VIP events.
bara: Capybara Nation (BARA) is a capybara-themed Web3 game that runs inside Telegram. Players earn in-game coins, upgrade and level up quest cards and get extra tasks and rewards for inviting friends, a simple way to bring Telegram users into crypto.
barc: Barclays is a British bank based in London, founded in 1690. It serves retail customers in the UK, issues Barclaycard credit cards and runs a large investment bank in London and New York; in 1967 it installed the world's first cash machine.
bard: Lombard (BARD) is a protocol founded in 2024 that turns bitcoin into a yield-earning asset in DeFi. Users stake BTC through Babylon and receive LBTC, a liquid token that works across many blockchains; BARD is the governance token.
bas: BASF is the world's largest chemical company, based in Ludwigshafen, Germany, and founded in 1865. It makes basic chemicals, plastics, catalysts, coatings, crop protection products and battery materials; its main site is one of the biggest chemical complexes in the world.
bas-token: BNB Attestation Service (BAS) is a protocol for creating on-chain attestations on BNB Chain: verified records about identity, reputation or events that other apps can rely on. The BAS token is used within the service's ecosystem.
basecat: Basecat (BASECAT) is a cat-themed meme coin on Base, the Ethereum layer-2 network built by Coinbase. It is a community token driven by memes and has no built-in utility.
based: Based is a financial super-app built on Hyperliquid that lets users trade crypto, stocks and commodities from one interface. Accounts can be funded from a bank account or card, and BASED is the ecosystem's token.
bat: Basic Attention Token (BAT) is the token of the ad ecosystem of the Brave browser, created by Brendan Eich, the inventor of JavaScript and co-founder of Mozilla. Advertisers pay in BAT, and users who opt in to private ads get a share they can use to support websites and creators.
baton: baton (BATON) is a memecoin on the Solana blockchain created through a quick-launch platform and traded in the Pump.fun ecosystem. It has no business behind it; its price follows community hype.
bats: British American Tobacco (BAT) is one of the world's largest tobacco companies, based in London and founded in 1902. It sells Dunhill, Lucky Strike, Kent and Pall Mall cigarettes, plus glo heated tobacco, Vuse vapes and Velo nicotine pouches.
bax: Baxter International is a US medical products maker from Deerfield, Illinois, founded in 1931. It makes infusion pumps, IV solutions, injectable drugs and surgical products used in hospitals around the world.
bay: Marina Protocol (BAY) is a marketing-technology platform that turns ordinary quizzes, missions and events into Web3 campaigns with instant on-chain rewards. Social-login wallets and gasless onboarding let participants join without crypto experience, and brands run campaigns through SDKs and embed codes.
bayn: Bayer is a German pharmaceutical and agrochemical group based in Leverkusen, founded in 1863. Known for aspirin, it makes prescription and consumer medicines and, since buying Monsanto in 2018, seeds and crop-protection products such as Roundup.
baza: Basis (Bazis) is a Russian developer of IT infrastructure software based in Moscow, listed on the Moscow Exchange in 2025. It makes virtualization, cloud-management and virtual-desktop platforms used by government agencies and large companies, with Rostelecom as main shareholder.
bb: BitBoard (BB) is the token of BitBoard, a fan platform on Polygon where fans use BB to vote for celebrities on a live star-ranking chart.
bbai: BigBear.ai is a US company that sells AI-based analytics and 'decision intelligence' software, mainly to the US defence, intelligence and homeland security agencies. Its tools also include biometric identity checks used at airports and border crossings.
bbajioo: Banco del Bajío is a Mexican bank headquartered in León, Guanajuato, founded in 1994. It focuses on loans and banking services for small and medium-sized businesses, agribusiness and companies, alongside accounts for individuals.
bbar: BBVA Argentina, formerly BBVA Francés, is one of Argentina's leading private banks and a subsidiary of Spain's BBVA. Its history goes back to Banco Francés del Río de la Plata, founded in 1886, and it serves individuals and companies through branches and digital banking.
bbas3: Banco do Brasil is Brazil's oldest bank, founded in 1808 and headquartered in Brasília. Controlled by the federal government, it is one of the country's largest banks, serving individuals, companies and the public sector, and the leading lender to Brazilian agribusiness.
bbca: Bank Central Asia (BCA) is Indonesia's largest private bank, based in Jakarta and founded in 1957. It is known for everyday banking and payments — current and savings accounts, the BCA mobile app, cards and a huge network of ATMs — and it is controlled by the Hartono family's Djarum group.
bbdc4: Bradesco is one of Brazil's largest private banks, based in Osasco, São Paulo state, and founded in 1943. It offers retail and corporate banking and, through Bradesco Seguros, runs one of the country's leading insurance groups.
bbl: Bangkok Bank is one of Thailand's largest commercial banks, founded in 1944. It is a major lender to big corporations and trading businesses, has a wide network across Asia, and in 2020 bought Indonesia's Permata Bank.
bbni: Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) is a state-owned Indonesian bank from Jakarta, founded in 1946 as the first bank created by the government of independent Indonesia. It serves corporations, small businesses and individuals and is strong in international trade finance.
bbri: Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) is a state-owned Indonesian bank from Jakarta whose history goes back to 1895. It specialises in microloans and small businesses and has a huge network of branches and agents in villages across the archipelago.
bbse3: BB Seguridade is the insurance holding of Banco do Brasil, based in Brasília. Through Brasilseg, Brasilprev and other partnerships it sells life, rural and credit insurance, private pensions and capitalisation bonds, mostly through Banco do Brasil's branches and apps.
bbt: BabyBoomToken (BBT), launched in March 2023, is a blockchain-based reward system that aims to address falling birth rates by rewarding family-related milestones such as pregnancy, childbirth and child-rearing with tokens.
bbva: BBVA is Spain's second-largest bank, headquartered in Bilbao and Madrid. The group's biggest business is Mexico's BBVA México; it also controls Turkey's Garanti BBVA, operates in South America and is known for its advanced digital banking.
bbwi: Bath & Body Works is an American retailer of fragrance and personal-care products based in Ohio, founded in 1990. It is known for its three-wick candles, shower gels, body lotions, pocket hand sanitisers and home fragrances.
bby: Best Buy is the largest consumer electronics retailer in the US, based in Minnesota and founded in 1966. It sells laptops, smartphones, TVs, appliances and games in stores and online, and its Geek Squad service installs and repairs devices.
bc: Brunswick is an Illinois-based maker of boats and marine engines, founded in 1845. It owns Mercury Marine outboard motors, the boat brands Sea Ray, Boston Whaler and Bayliner, and the marine electronics group Navico.
bc-token: BC is the native token of BC.GAME, an online crypto casino and betting platform. Built on Solana, it serves as the platform's utility and governance token, used for rewards, incentives and in-platform features.
bce: BCE is Canada's largest telecommunications company, based in Montreal and the parent of Bell Canada. It provides mobile, internet and TV services and owns Bell Media, which includes the CTV television network.
bch: Bitcoin Cash is a cryptocurrency that split off from bitcoin in a 2017 hard fork. Its supporters raised the block size so the network can handle more transactions with lower fees, promoting BCH as digital cash for everyday payments.
bci: Banco de Crédito e Inversiones (BCI) is one of Chile's largest banks, founded in 1937 and controlled by the Yarur family. Based in Santiago, it serves individuals and companies in Chile and owns City National Bank of Florida in the United States.
bco: Brink's is a Texas-based global leader in cash management and secure transport of valuables, founded in 1859 in Chicago. It moves cash and precious goods in armored trucks, services ATMs and offers stores smart safes and digital cash-handling tools.
bcp: Millennium bcp (Banco Comercial Português) is Portugal's largest private bank, based in Porto and Lisbon and founded in 1985. It serves retail and business customers in Portugal and owns Bank Millennium in Poland and Millennium bim in Mozambique.
bdc: Belden is an American maker of networking equipment and cable from St. Louis, founded in 1902. It supplies copper and fibre-optic cable, connectors and industrial networking gear for factories, utilities, transport and broadband providers.
bdca: BitDCA is a project with the Littlebit mobile app, which automatically sets aside a small percentage of every regular card purchase in bitcoin. BDCA token holders receive a share of transaction revenue; the service is aimed mainly at Europe.
bdms: Bangkok Dusit Medical Services (BDMS) is Thailand's largest private hospital operator, based in Bangkok. It runs the Bangkok Hospital, Samitivej, BNH and Phyathai hospital networks, and many of its patients are medical tourists from abroad.
bdx: Becton Dickinson (BD) is a US medical supplies maker based in Franklin Lakes, New Jersey, founded in 1897. It is one of the world's largest makers of syringes and needles and also produces blood-collection systems, infusion pumps and diagnostic equipment.
bdx-pl: Budimex is Poland's largest construction company, based in Warsaw and founded in 1968. It builds motorways, railways, bridges, hospitals and housing, and its majority owner is the Spanish infrastructure group Ferrovial.
bdx-token: Beldex is a privacy cryptocurrency and ecosystem launched in 2018. The BDX coin enables private transfers, and the project builds data-protection tools including the BChat messenger, a browser and a private VPN.
be: Bloom Energy is a US energy company from San Jose, California, founded in 2001 by K. R. Sridhar. It makes Bloom Energy Server solid oxide fuel cells that generate electricity on site for factories, hospitals and data centers.
beam: Beam is a blockchain gaming ecosystem that grew out of the Merit Circle gaming guild and runs as its own network on Avalanche. It gives game studios infrastructure for games, NFTs and other digital products; BEAM is the native token used for transaction fees in the network.
bear: TEDDY BEAR (BEAR) is a PRC-20 meme coin on PulseChain, the blockchain founded by Richard Heart. It pays tribute to the teddy bear that became a familiar sight in the crypto community thanks to his livestreams.
bei: Beiersdorf is a German consumer goods company based in Hamburg, founded in 1882. It makes skin and body care products under brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin and La Prairie, and adhesive tapes and bonding solutions under the tesa brand.
beke: KE Holdings is a Beijing-based housing platform known for its Beike app and the Lianjia real estate brokerage, founded in 2001. It connects home buyers, sellers and renters with agents across China and also offers home renovation and furnishing services.
bel: Bharat Electronics (BEL) is India's state-owned defense electronics company from Bengaluru, founded in 1954. It makes radars, communication systems, air defense systems, electronic warfare equipment and electronic voting machines.
bel-token: Bella Protocol (BEL) is a DeFi platform that aims to make earning yield on crypto as simple as a one-click savings product, packaging automated strategies into easy-to-use vaults. BEL is its governance and reward token.
bela: Jumbo is a Greek retailer of toys, baby products, stationery and seasonal goods, based in the Athens area. It runs large stores in Greece, Cyprus, Bulgaria and Romania and sells through franchise partners in other countries.
believe: Believe is a token-launch platform on Solana, formerly known as Clout and founded by Ben Pasternak. Anyone can create a token for a startup or idea simply by posting on social media, and BELIEVE is the platform's token.
bells: Bellscoin (BELLS) is a proof-of-work cryptocurrency created in 2013 by Billy Markus, shortly before he co-created Dogecoin. Long dormant, it was revived by its community and now also supports inscriptions similar to Bitcoin Ordinals.
belu: NovaBev Group (formerly Beluga Group) is a Russian alcoholic drinks company based in Moscow. It makes vodka brands such as Beluga, Belenkaya and Myagkov, imports wines and spirits, and runs the WineLab chain of wine shops.
bem: BEM is the first example token of the TapeOut protocol on Ethereum, where developers wire basic logic components into circuits and publish them as on-chain NFTs anyone can run and verify. BEM is mined through "Proof of Design" with a fixed 21 million supply.
ben: Franklin Resources, which operates as Franklin Templeton, is a US asset manager based in San Mateo, California, founded in 1947. It runs mutual funds, ETFs and investment strategies in stocks, bonds and alternatives for individual and institutional investors, and bought Legg Mason in 2020.
benji: Basenji (BENJI) is a meme token on Base, Coinbase's Ethereum layer-2 network, themed around the Basenji, an ancient African dog breed. It brands itself as the "chosen dog" of the Base ecosystem and has no real utility beyond community memes and trading.
bera: Berachain (BERA) is an EVM-compatible layer-1 blockchain using a Proof of Liquidity mechanism, which grew out of the community around the Bong Bears NFT collection. BERA is the gas token used to pay fees, while a separate token, BGT, handles governance and rewards.
bert: Bertram The Pomeranian (BERT) is a memecoin inspired by Bertram, a real Pomeranian dog with a large online fan following. The project says its mission is to help dogs around the world, linking the meme with AI tools and smart dog tags.
besi: BE Semiconductor (Besi) is a Dutch maker of chip assembly and packaging equipment based in Duiven. Its machines, including hybrid bonding systems, are used by makers of chips for artificial intelligence, smartphones and cars.
bezq: Bezeq is Israel's largest telecommunications group, founded in 1984 as the state phone company and later privatised. It provides landline and fibre internet, mobile service through Pelephone, satellite TV through yes, and international and business services.
bf-b: Brown-Forman is a US spirits and wine company from Louisville, Kentucky, founded in 1870. It makes Jack Daniel's Tennessee whiskey, Woodford Reserve and Old Forester bourbons, Herradura and el Jimador tequilas and other brands sold worldwide. Class B shares have no voting rights.
bfc: Bifrost (BFC) is a South Korean blockchain project building a multichain network and bridges for decentralized apps that run across different blockchains. The BFC token pays for network services and is used for staking.
bfit: Basic-Fit is a Dutch fitness chain from Hoofddorp, founded in 2005. It runs low-cost gyms with long opening hours across the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Spain, Luxembourg and Germany, with members paying an affordable monthly fee.
bft: Benefit Systems is a Polish company based in Warsaw, founded in 2000. It is best known for the MultiSport card, which employers give staff for access to gyms and pools, and it also runs its own fitness clubs in Poland and other countries.
bfusd: BFUSD is a reward-bearing margin asset created by Binance for its futures traders, launched in 2024. Users swap USDT for BFUSD, use it as collateral for futures positions and receive daily rewards generated by Binance's yield strategies; it is not an independent on-chain stablecoin.
bg: Bunge is one of the world's largest agribusiness and food companies, founded in Amsterdam in 1818 and now based in St. Louis. It buys, stores and processes soybeans, rapeseed, sunflower and other oilseeds into oils and meal, mills grain, and merged with Viterra in 2025.
bg-at: BAWAG Group is an Austrian banking group based in Vienna, founded in 1922. It serves retail and business customers in Austria, Germany and other Western European markets through brands such as BAWAG and easybank.
bgsc: BugsCoin (BGSC) is a reward token on BNB Smart Chain. It replaces closed loyalty-point systems: users earn it for activity in partner apps and services and can spend or trade it, with transactions and rewards recorded transparently on the blockchain.
bh: Bumrungrad International Hospital is a private hospital in Bangkok, opened in 1980, and one of Asia's best-known centers for medical tourism. In 2002 it became the first hospital in Asia accredited by JCI, and it treats patients from more than a hundred countries.
bhartiartl: Bharti Airtel is an Indian telecom operator based in New Delhi, founded by Sunil Mittal in 1995. One of the world's largest mobile operators, it works in India and many African countries (Airtel Africa) and also provides broadband and TV.
bhf: Brighthouse Financial is a US insurer based in Charlotte, North Carolina, spun off from MetLife in 2017. It sells annuities and life insurance that help Americans save for retirement and protect their families.
bhp: BHP is an Australian mining company based in Melbourne, one of the largest in the world, with a history dating back to 1885. It mines iron ore, copper and metallurgical coal and is developing a potash project in Canada.
bhw: Citi Handlowy (Bank Handlowy w Warszawie) is a Polish bank founded in Warsaw in 1870, one of the oldest in the country. Most of its shares are owned by the US group Citigroup, and it focuses on corporate clients and international companies.
bico: Biconomy is Web3 infrastructure that makes blockchain apps easier to use: through its APIs and SDKs developers add smart accounts, gasless transactions where the app pays fees, and simple sign-in without complex wallet setup. BICO is used for its relayer network and governance.
bid: BIDV (Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam) is one of Vietnam's largest state-owned banks, based in Hanoi and founded in 1957. It has traditionally financed infrastructure and large projects, and South Korea's KEB Hana Bank owns a stake.
bid-token: CreatorBid (BID) is a launchpad on Base for AI agents, where people can launch, co-own and earn from tokenized AI agents that are active on X, Telegram and other platforms. BID holders vote on which agents get listed, stake for rewards and get access to agent launches.
bifi: Beefy is a multi-chain yield optimizer launched in 2020: users deposit tokens into vaults that automatically reinvest farming rewards to compound returns. BIFI is the governance token and earns a share of the platform's fees.
big5on: Ondo Big 5 Core Allocation Portfolio (BIG5ON) is a tokenized investment product from Ondo Global Markets, the Ondo Finance platform that offers blockchain tokens tracking US securities to investors outside the United States. The token gives onchain exposure to a ready-made portfolio instead of a single stock.
bigtime: Big Time is a multiplayer online time-travel RPG from Big Time Studios, led by Decentraland co-founder Ari Meilich. While playing, gamers can earn BIGTIME tokens and NFT items.
biib: Biogen is an American biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 1978 and one of the oldest biotech firms. It focuses on brain and nerve diseases, with medicines for multiple sclerosis such as Tysabri, spinal muscular atrophy (Spinraza) and, together with Eisai, the Alzheimer's drug Leqembi.
bili: Bilibili is a Shanghai-based online video platform popular with young people in China, started in 2009 as a site for anime, comics and games fans. It is famous for 'danmaku' bullet comments that fly across the video, and also earns from mobile games, ads and live streaming.
bill: BILL Holdings is a US fintech company based in California that runs a cloud platform for small and mid-sized businesses. It automates paying supplier bills, invoicing customers, company cards and expense management.
bill-token: Billions Network is a network for verifying humans and AI agents: it confirms that a user is a unique real person via their mobile phone without revealing personal data. The BILL token is used for rewards and to run the network.
billy: Billy (BILLION•DOLLAR•CAT) is a cat-themed meme coin issued as a Rune on the Bitcoin blockchain. It was a community fair launch with no premine and a total supply of 1 billion tokens.
bim: BIM is the token of BIM Finance, a decentralized finance (DeFi) project built natively on Base, the Ethereum layer-2 network launched by Coinbase. The token is used inside the project's DeFi services.
bimas: BİM is Turkey's largest discount grocery chain, founded in Istanbul in 1995. Its thousands of small stores sell a limited range of food and household goods, much of it under private labels, and it also operates in Morocco and Egypt.
bimboa: Grupo Bimbo is a Mexican food company from Mexico City, founded in 1945, and the world's largest bakery. It makes bread, buns, cakes and snacks sold in dozens of countries under brands such as Bimbo, Marinela, Sara Lee, Thomas' and Entenmann's.
bio: Bio Protocol (BIO) is a decentralized science (DeSci) protocol that helps communities of patients and scientists fund biotech research and own the rights to it. The project was backed by Binance Labs, and BIO is used for governance and to support BioDAOs.
bio-etf: Bio-Rad Laboratories is an American maker of lab instruments and reagents based in California, founded in 1952. It supplies tools for life-science research, including digital PCR systems, and clinical diagnostic systems for hospital and lab testing.
biofi: Biometric Financial (BIOFI) is the utility token of BioFi, a project that brings biometric identity to blockchain and DeFi to protect users' personal data. The token moved from Avalanche to BNB Smart Chain.
birb: Moonbirds (BIRB) is a token linked to the Moonbirds NFT collection of 10,000 pixel owls, launched in 2022 by Kevin Rose's PROOF team. The brand was later acquired by Orange Cap Games.
birg: Bank of Ireland, founded in 1783 and based in Dublin, is one of Ireland's largest banks. It provides current accounts, mortgages, business lending, insurance and wealth services in Ireland and also has retail banking operations in the UK.
birk: Birkenstock is a German shoemaker with roots going back to 1774, best known for sandals with a contoured cork-latex footbed, such as the Arizona and the Boston clog. Based in Linz am Rhein, it makes most of its products in Germany and sells them worldwide.
bitcoin: HarryPotterObamaSonic10Inu (ticker BITCOIN) is a memecoin on Ethereum launched in 2023. Its absurd name mixes Harry Potter, Barack Obama, Sonic and the Inu dog-coin trend as a joke, and it has no function beyond its community.
bj: BJ's Wholesale Club is a US warehouse club chain from Marlborough, Massachusetts, founded in 1984. Members pay a yearly fee to buy groceries, household goods, electronics and gasoline in bulk at low prices, mainly in the eastern US.
bkh: Black Hills is an energy utility from Rapid City, South Dakota, founded in 1941. It delivers electricity and natural gas to homes and businesses in eight US states across the Rocky Mountains and the Midwest.
bkn: Brickken (BKN) is the token of Brickken, a Barcelona-based platform that helps companies tokenize real-world assets such as company shares, debt and real estate and offer them to investors. BKN is used for payments and rewards on the platform.
bkng: Booking Holdings is a US online travel company headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut. It owns Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable for booking accommodation, flights, rental cars and restaurant tables.
bkr: Baker Hughes is a US energy technology company from Houston whose history goes back to 1907. It supplies oil and gas companies with drilling and production equipment and services and also makes gas turbines, compressors and LNG equipment.
bkt: Bankinter is a Spanish bank based in Madrid, founded in 1965. It serves individuals, wealthy clients and companies in Spain and Portugal, offers consumer lending in Ireland through Avant Money, and is known for its early move into online banking.
blend: Fluent is a blockchain for apps that depend on user reputation. Its Prints data layer gives developers verifiable reputation scores built from on-chain activity and contribution quality; the BLEND token powers the ecosystem.
bless: Bless Network (BLESS) is a San Francisco-based decentralized computing platform that turns the spare capacity of everyday devices such as laptops and phones into a shared global computer. Participants earn tokens for the computing power they provide.
blk: BlackRock is the world's largest investment manager, headquartered in New York and founded in 1988 by Larry Fink. It manages pension and investment money, issues ETFs under the iShares brand, including the bitcoin fund IBIT, and built the Aladdin risk-analytics platform.
blkdigon: BLKDIGon (Ondo Diversified Growth Powered by BlackRock) is a tokenized portfolio from Ondo Finance that gives on-chain exposure to a model allocation of roughly 70% stocks and 30% bonds and alternatives built from BlackRock funds, aiming for balanced, moderate-risk growth.
blkgrwon: Ondo High Growth Powered by BlackRock (BLKGRWON) is a tokenized investment portfolio from Ondo Finance aimed at long-term capital growth. It holds roughly 95% stocks through BlackRock's iShares equity strategies across US and international markets, plus about 5% in bitcoin.
blkhion: BLKHIon is a tokenized portfolio from Ondo Finance, «Ondo High Income Powered by BlackRock». The token gives exposure to a model mix of BlackRock iShares bond ETFs: flexible income, securitized debt, investment-grade and high-yield credit and short-duration bonds. Access restrictions apply.
blng: Belon is a Russian coal company in the Kemerovo region, part of the Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works (MMK) group. It mines and enriches coking coal in Kuzbass, mainly supplying MMK's steelmaking.
blob: BLOB is a memecoin named after the "Big Blob of Compute" – the idea in artificial intelligence that progress comes mainly from scaling up computing power and data rather than clever tricks. It is a community token with no product of its own, so its price depends on hype.
blsh: Bullish is a digital-asset company that runs the Bullish exchange, a crypto trading platform built mainly for institutions, and owns the crypto news site CoinDesk. Its chief executive is Tom Farley, a former president of the New York Stock Exchange.
bluai: Bluwhale (BLUAI) is a decentralized AI network where developers and companies deploy AI agents that provide financial insights and services to its users across several blockchains, including Sui, Arbitrum and Cardano. It is backed by UOB Venture Management and SBI Holdings; BLUAI, launched in October 2025, pays for gas, governance, staking and nodes.
blue: Bluefin is a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures and spot trading built on the Sui blockchain. It aims to feel like a centralized exchange while users keep control of their funds; BLUE is its governance and rewards token.
blur: Blur is an NFT marketplace and aggregator for professional traders on Ethereum, launched in 2022. It quickly became one of the market leaders thanks to zero trading fees and rewards for active traders; the BLUR token is used for governance.
blz: Bluzelle is a decentralized storage network founded in Singapore in 2017, later focused on storing data and NFTs for games and Web3 apps. BLZ is its token, used to pay for storage and to stake for securing the network.
bma: Banco Macro is one of Argentina's largest private banks, based in Buenos Aires. It has one of the widest branch networks in the country, with a strong presence in the provinces, where it also acts as financial agent for several provincial governments, and serves individuals, small businesses and companies.
bmed: Banca Mediolanum is an Italian bank based in Basiglio near Milan, founded by Ennio Doris. Instead of traditional branches it works through a network of financial advisers, offering accounts, mortgages, investment funds and insurance; the Berlusconi family's Fininvest is a major shareholder.
bmnr: BitMine Immersion Technologies is a US company from Las Vegas, Nevada, that holds Ether (ETH) as its main treasury asset, making it one of the largest corporate ETH holders. Chaired by Fundstrat's Tom Lee, it began as a bitcoin mining and hosting firm.
bmo: Bank of Montreal (BMO) is Canada's oldest bank, founded in 1817 in Montreal. It provides banking, investment and insurance services in Canada and has a large US network, especially in the Midwest.
bmps: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) is an Italian bank based in Siena, founded in 1472 and considered the world's oldest bank still in operation. It offers retail, business and wealth-management banking across Italy; after a state rescue in 2017 it returned to strength and in 2025 took control of the investment bank Mediobanca.
bmri: Bank Mandiri is one of Indonesia's largest banks, state-owned and based in Jakarta. It was formed in 1998 by merging four state banks after the Asian financial crisis and serves large corporations, small businesses and retail customers, including through its Livin' app.
bmrn: BioMarin Pharmaceutical is a US biotech company from California, founded in 1997. It develops medicines for rare genetic diseases, including enzyme therapies for MPS disorders, treatments for phenylketonuria (PKU) and Voxzogo for achondroplasia.
bmt: Bubblemaps is a blockchain data visualization tool that shows the links between wallets as 'bubbles'. It is used to spot token concentration and possible manipulation; BMT is the platform's token.
bmw: BMW is a German carmaker based in Munich, founded in 1916 as a maker of aircraft engines. It builds premium BMW cars and motorcycles and also owns the MINI and Rolls-Royce Motor Cars brands.
bmy: Bristol Myers Squibb is a US pharmaceutical company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey. It develops medicines for cancer, blood disorders, immunology and cardiovascular disease, including Opdivo and Eliquis.
bn: Danone is a French food company from Paris whose roots go back to a yogurt factory opened in Barcelona in 1919. It makes dairy and plant-based products (Activia, Alpro), Evian and Volvic water, and baby and medical nutrition (Aptamil, Nutricia).
bn-ca: Brookfield Corporation is a Canadian investment company based in Toronto with roots going back to 1899. It owns and manages real estate, renewable power, infrastructure, private equity and insurance businesses worldwide, largely through its asset manager Brookfield Asset Management.
bn4: Keppel is a Singapore company founded in 1968 as a shipyard that has become a global asset manager and operator. It invests in and runs infrastructure such as power, renewables and waste-to-energy plants, real estate, and connectivity assets like data centres and subsea cables, often through funds for outside investors.
bnb: BNB is the coin of the BNB Chain ecosystem, launched in 2017 by the Binance exchange founded by Changpeng Zhao. It pays fees on BNB Smart Chain, gives trading-fee discounts on Binance and is used in DeFi and staking.
bnc: Bifrost (BNC) is the native coin of Bifrost, a Polkadot parachain specialising in liquid staking: it issues tokens such as vDOT and vETH that keep earning staking rewards while staying usable in DeFi. BNC is used for fees and governance.
bnc4: Cea Industries (BNC4) is a tokenized version of shares in Cea Industries, a US company listed on Nasdaq that holds BNB as its treasury reserve. The token trades on BNB Chain and tracks the stock price; it is not the share itself.
bnd: Vanguard Total Bond Market (BND) covers the whole US investment-grade bond market in one fund: Treasuries, corporate bonds and mortgage-backed securities.
bnkr: BankrCoin (BNKR) is the official token of Bankr, an AI agent that buys and sells crypto through ordinary chat messages. Bankr is known for helping users of the Farcaster social network buy coins right in their feed.
bnp: BNP Paribas is France's largest bank and one of the biggest in the eurozone, formed in 2000 by the merger of BNP and Paribas. It runs retail networks in France, Belgium, Italy and Luxembourg, a large investment bank, insurance and asset management; in Ukraine it owns a stake in UkrSibbank.
bnr: Brenntag is the world's largest chemical distributor, based in Essen, Germany, with roots going back to 1874. It buys chemicals and ingredients from producers and delivers, blends and repackages them for many thousands of industrial customers in more than 70 countries.
bns: Scotiabank (Bank of Nova Scotia) is a Canadian bank based in Toronto, founded in 1832 in Halifax. Beyond Canada it has a strong presence in Latin America, including Mexico, Chile and Peru, and in the Caribbean.
bnt: Bancor is an ecosystem of decentralized protocols for on-chain trading and liquidity, launched in 2017. Bancor was one of the pioneers of automated market makers (AMMs), and its Carbon protocol lets users set up automatic trading strategies; BNT is used for governance.
bntx: BioNTech is a German biotechnology company from Mainz, founded in 2008 by Uğur Şahin and Özlem Türeci. Together with Pfizer it developed Comirnaty, the first approved mRNA vaccine against COVID-19, and it is now focused on new cancer treatments.
bny: BNY (Bank of New York Mellon) is the oldest bank in the US, founded in 1784 by Alexander Hamilton and based in New York. It is the world's largest custodian bank, holding and servicing securities for institutional investors and managing client assets.
bnzl: Bunzl is a British distribution company based in London that supplies businesses with everyday items they use but do not sell. It delivers packaging, food-service disposables, cleaning and hygiene supplies and safety equipment to customers in more than 30 countries.
bob: BOB (Build on Bitcoin) is a hybrid layer-2 network that combines Bitcoin's security with Ethereum compatibility. It lets people use bitcoin in DeFi apps; BOB is the network token.
boba: Boba Network is a layer-2 network for Ethereum that makes transactions faster and cheaper using optimistic rollup technology. Its HybridCompute feature lets smart contracts call off-chain services and APIs, and BOBA is used for fees, staking and governance.
bobo: Bobo (BOBO) is an Ethereum memecoin launched in 2023 featuring Bobo, the bear character crypto traders use as a symbol of falling markets. It is a community token with no utility beyond trading.
boden: Jeo Boden (BODEN) is a meme token on Solana that playfully misspells the name of former US President Joe Biden. It is a political satire coin from the PolitiFi wave around the 2024 US election and has no utility beyond community and trading.
bol: Boliden is a Swedish mining and smelting company headquartered in Stockholm, named after the village where gold was found in 1924. It mines and refines copper, zinc, lead, nickel, gold and silver at sites in Sweden, Finland, Norway and Ireland.
bold: BOLD is the dollar stablecoin of Liquity V2, a decentralized lending protocol on Ethereum. Users mint BOLD by depositing ETH or liquid staking tokens as collateral and choose their own interest rate on the loan.
bolsaa: Grupo Bolsa Mexicana de Valores (BMV) runs Mexico's main stock exchange in Mexico City, whose history goes back to 1894. Besides share and derivatives trading, it operates clearing and settlement through Indeval and sells market data.
bome: BOOK OF MEME (BOME) is a meme token on Solana created in 2024 by the artist Darkfarms. It was conceived as a decentralized digital archive of memes stored on Arweave and IPFS, and became known for its rapid surge right after launch.
bone: BONE (Bone ShibaSwap) is the governance token of ShibaSwap, the decentralized exchange of the Shiba Inu ecosystem. It is also used to pay transaction fees on Shibarium, Shiba Inu's layer-2 network, and to vote on proposals.
boner: Boner Coin (BONER) is a meme token on Robinhood Chain, launched through the Long.xyz launchpad, where its main trading pair is against a tokenized Hims & Hers (HIMS) stock. It has no utility beyond community and trading.
bonk: Bonk is a dog-themed meme coin on Solana, launched on Christmas 2022 to cheer up the community after the FTX collapse. A large share of the tokens was given away free to Solana users and developers, and BONK is integrated into many apps on the network.
booe: Book of Ethereum (BOOE) is a meme coin on Ethereum inspired by the Solana meme coin Book of Meme (BOME). It has no product of its own: its value rests on community interest and trading.
boop: BOOP is the token of Boop.fun, a Solana platform for launching meme coins with a game-like reward system, created by the well-known NFT trader Dingaling. BOOP holders can stake it to earn a share of platform fees and airdrops. The platform launched in May 2025.
bora: BORA is a blockchain platform for games and digital entertainment created by a South Korean company that belongs to the Kakao group. It distributes games and digital content and rewards participants with BORA tokens.
borg: SwissBorg is a crypto investment app from Lausanne, Switzerland, founded in 2017, where users buy, sell and exchange crypto, earn yield and use automated strategies. BORG is the app's token, giving holders better rewards and lower fees.
boson: Boson Protocol is a UK-founded decentralized commerce protocol that lets brands sell physical products on-chain as redeemable NFTs: the buyer holds a token that can be traded or exchanged for the real item, with funds held in escrow until delivery. BOSON is used for staking, fees and governance.
boss: Hugo Boss is a German fashion company based in Metzingen, founded in 1924. It designs and sells premium clothing, shoes and accessories for men and women under two brands, BOSS and HUGO, through its own stores, online and department stores.
bounty: ChainBounty (BOUNTY), formerly Sentinel Protocol, is a blockchain-based security project that pools collective cybersecurity intelligence to protect crypto users from hackers, scams and fraud, for example through shared threat databases.
box: DeBox is a decentralized social app for crypto communities: users sign in with a wallet, chat in groups and join clubs that can be limited to holders of certain tokens or NFTs. BOX is the token at the center of the DeBox ecosystem.
box-etf: Box is a US cloud software company from Redwood City, California, founded in 2005 by Aaron Levie and Dylan Smith. Businesses use its platform to store, share and collaborate on files securely, manage documents and e-signatures, and apply AI to their content.
bp: Backpack is a crypto exchange and wallet in one app, founded by Armani Ferrante's team, which previously built developer tools for Solana. The exchange offers spot and futures trading, and the wallet supports several blockchains; BP is the ecosystem token.
bp-gb: BP is a British oil and gas company based in London, founded in 1909 as the Anglo-Persian Oil Company. It produces oil and gas in the Gulf of Mexico, the North Sea, the Middle East and elsewhere, refines fuels and runs BP and Aral filling stations and Castrol lubricants.
bpac11: BTG Pactual is Latin America's largest investment bank, headquartered in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. It offers investment banking, trading, asset and wealth management, and a digital bank for individual clients.
br: Broadridge Financial Solutions is a New York fintech company spun off from ADP in 2007. It sends shareholder reports and proxy voting materials on behalf of companies and funds, and provides brokers and banks with trade-processing software.
br-token: Bedrock (BR) is a liquid restaking protocol that issues liquid tokens such as uniBTC and uniETH for staked BTC, ETH and other assets. BR is the governance token: holders lock it as veBR to vote on protocol settings and on how rewards are split between liquidity pools.
brainon: Ondo AI Leaders Portfolio (BRAINon) is a tokenized portfolio from Ondo Finance that gives on-chain exposure to companies across the artificial intelligence value chain: chip and compute makers, AI infrastructure and energy. Weights follow a modified market-cap method.
brbr: BellRing Brands is a US consumer products company from St. Louis, Missouri, that makes protein shakes, powders and bars. Its main brands are Premier Protein, known for ready-to-drink shakes, and Dymatize sports nutrition powders; it was spun off from Post Holdings.
brby: Burberry is a British luxury fashion house from London, founded in 1856 by Thomas Burberry. Famous for its trench coats and signature check pattern, it sells luxury clothing, bags and accessories worldwide.
bren: Barito Renewables Energy is an Indonesian geothermal power company based in Jakarta and part of the Barito Pacific group. Through Star Energy it runs the Wayang Windu, Salak and Darajat geothermal plants on Java and is Indonesia's largest geothermal producer.
brent: Brent is the world's main benchmark for crude oil, named after a North Sea field. Most of the oil traded globally is priced off Brent.
brett: Brett (BRETT) is a meme token on Coinbase's Base network, named after a character from Matt Furie's Boy's Club comic, a friend of Pepe the Frog. The community promotes it as «the Pepe of Base».
brev: Brevis is a ZK coprocessor that lets smart contracts read historical blockchain data and run complex computations off-chain, verified with zero-knowledge proofs. BREV is the network's token.
brew: BREW is the token of brew.family, a token launchpad on BNB Chain. Creators can launch a new token paired with an existing asset such as BNB, a stablecoin or a memecoin, straight into a PancakeSwap pool with locked liquidity, and part of the fees is used to burn BREW.
bridgestone: Bridgestone is a Japanese tire maker from Tokyo, founded in 1931 and one of the largest in the world. It makes tires for cars, trucks, aircraft and heavy machinery under the Bridgestone and Firestone brands, plus other rubber products.
brise: Bitgert (BRISE) began in 2021 as a token on BNB Chain and later launched its own blockchain, Bitgert Chain, which promotes near-zero gas fees and fast transactions. BRISE is the chain's native coin.
britannia: Britannia Industries is an Indian food company from Kolkata, founded in 1892 and part of the Wadia Group. It is one of India's biggest biscuit makers, with brands such as Good Day, Marie Gold and NutriChoice, and also sells bread, cakes, rusks and dairy products.
brk-b: Berkshire Hathaway is an American conglomerate from Omaha, Nebraska, led for decades by Warren Buffett. It owns the insurer GEICO, the BNSF railroad, energy companies and Duracell, and holds large stakes in Apple, Coca-Cola and American Express.
brkm5: Braskem is the largest petrochemical company in the Americas, based in São Paulo and controlled by Novonor and Petrobras. It makes plastic resins such as polyethylene, polypropylene and PVC at plants in Brazil, the US, Mexico and Germany, and pioneered 'green' polyethylene made from sugarcane ethanol.
brkr: Bruker is an American maker of scientific instruments based in Massachusetts, with roots in Germany in the 1960s. It is known for NMR spectrometers, mass spectrometers, X-ray and microscopy systems used by universities, drug makers and industry.
brl1: BRL1 is a stablecoin pegged to the Brazilian real, launched by a group of Brazilian crypto companies, including exchanges Mercado Bitcoin and Foxbit. Each token aims to equal one real and is backed by reserves.
brla: BRLA is a stablecoin pegged to the Brazilian real, issued by the Brazilian company BRLA Digital. Each token aims to equal one real and is backed by reserves, letting users make fast payments and conversions between reais and crypto on blockchains.
brn: BRN Metaverse (BRN) is a GameFi project on BNB Chain that combines a game, NFTs and staking. Its main game, BRNVERSE, is built on the Unity engine with in-game items as NFTs, and the BRN token powers the game, the NFT marketplace and staking.
bro: Brown & Brown is one of the largest insurance brokers in the US, founded in 1939 in Florida. It finds property, liability, health and employee insurance for businesses and individuals and earns commissions from insurers.
broccoli: CZ's Dog (BROCCOLI) is a memecoin on BNB Chain named after Broccoli, the dog of Binance founder Changpeng Zhao. The token appeared in early 2025 after CZ talked about his dog on social media.
bros: Dutch Bros is a US drive-thru coffee chain founded in 1992 in Oregon by brothers Dane and Travis Boersma. It sells coffee, Rebel energy drinks, teas and smoothies, and is known for its upbeat, fast service.
brsan: Borusan Boru (Borusan Mannesmann) is a Turkish steel pipe maker and part of the Borusan Group, with its main plant in Gemlik. It produces welded steel pipes for oil and gas, water, construction and industry, and also has a pipe mill in Texas.
brx: Brixmor Property Group is an American real estate investment trust (REIT) based in New York. It owns hundreds of open-air shopping centres across the country, typically anchored by supermarkets, pharmacies and everyday-needs stores.
brz: Brazilian Digital Token (BRZ) is a stablecoin pegged to the Brazilian real, issued by Transfero. Each BRZ aims to equal one real and is backed by reserves; it circulates on several blockchains and is used for payments, trading and remittances in reais.
brzl: Buryatzoloto is a Russian gold mining company in the Republic of Buryatia, near Lake Baikal, and part of the Nordgold group. It operates the underground Irokinda and Zun-Kholba gold mines.
bs6: Yangzijiang Shipbuilding is one of China's largest private shipbuilders, with shipyards in Jiangsu province along the Yangtze River, and has been listed in Singapore since 2007. It builds container ships, bulk carriers, tankers and gas carriers for shipping companies around the world.
bsantander: Banco Santander Chile is one of Chile's largest banks, based in Santiago and controlled by Spain's Banco Santander. It offers current accounts, loans, mortgages, credit cards and digital banking to individuals and businesses across the country.
bsb: Block Street (BSB) is a decentralized finance infrastructure project whose BSB token is issued on several networks, including Ethereum, BNB Chain and Base. It builds on-chain tools for trading and lending.
bspb: Bank Saint Petersburg is one of Russia's largest privately owned banks, founded in 1990 and based in St Petersburg. It serves individuals and companies, mainly in the city and the north-west of Russia, with loans, deposits, cards and investment services.
bst: Blocksquare (BST) is the token of Blocksquare, a Slovenian company founded in 2017 that provides infrastructure for tokenising real estate, letting marketplaces issue digital shares of properties. BST gives access to the protocol.
bsv: Bitcoin SV (Satoshi Vision) is a cryptocurrency that split off from Bitcoin Cash in a 2018 hard fork. Its backers, including Craig Wright, pushed for very large blocks to scale, and the network positions itself as a platform for micropayments and enterprise data.
bsx: Boston Scientific is a US medical device maker based in Marlborough, Massachusetts, founded in 1979. It makes stents, catheters, pacemakers, cardiac ablation systems and devices for minimally invasive surgery.
bsy: Bentley Systems is a US engineering software company from Exton, Pennsylvania, founded in 1984 by the Bentley brothers. Its software, such as MicroStation, is used to design, build and operate roads, bridges, railways, power grids and water networks.
bt-a: BT Group is the UK's largest telecom operator, based in London and formerly the state-owned British Telecom. It provides home broadband, mobile service through EE and TV, while its Openreach unit runs most of Britain's fixed-line network.
btbr: B2B-RTS is a Russian group that runs electronic trading platforms for procurement, where companies and state customers hold tenders and suppliers bid for contracts. Its shares were listed on the Moscow Exchange after an IPO in 2026.
btc: Bitcoin is the first cryptocurrency, launched in 2009 by the pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto. Its supply is capped at 21 million coins, which is why it is often called 'digital gold'.
btcbam: BitcoinBam (BTCBAM) is a BNB Smart Chain token at the centre of the BitcoinBam ecosystem, which includes the Bamstarter launchpad and a DAO. Holders stake it to earn reward tokens from projects the DAO backs and to vote.
btcmt: Minto is a Bitcoin-mining project whose BTCMT token is tied to the hashrate of its mining equipment. Holders stake the token to receive a share of the bitcoin that the hardware mines, without running machines themselves.
btcp: Bitcoin Pro (BTCP) is a separate cryptocurrency, not Bitcoin itself, that markets itself as a faster, cheaper and fully decentralized version of Bitcoin. It only borrows Bitcoin's name and idea; it has its own coin, network and much smaller community.
btg: Openverse Network (BTG) is a layer-0 network that aims to connect different blockchains and digital assets, building what it calls a "value internet". BTG is its native token, used to pay network fees, for staking by validators and delegators, and for governance votes.
btr: Bitlayer is a Bitcoin layer-2 network and the first implementation of BitVM technology. It adds fast, EVM-compatible smart contracts on top of Bitcoin so DeFi apps can be built around BTC; BTR is the network's token.
btrw: Barratt Redrow is the UK's largest housebuilder by number of homes, formed in 2024 when Barratt Developments, founded in 1958, bought rival Redrow. It builds new homes across Britain under the Barratt Homes, David Wilson Homes and Redrow brands.
bts: BitShares is one of the oldest blockchain platforms, launched in 2014 by Dan Larimer, who later co-created EOS and Steem. It runs a built-in decentralized exchange where users trade and issue their own tokens and collateral-backed smartcoins such as bitUSD, and it pioneered the delegated proof-of-stake model.
btse: BTSE Token is the utility token of BTSE, a cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2018 that offers spot and futures trading. Holding BTSE gives users trading-fee discounts and other benefits on the platform.
btsg: BrightSpring Health Services is a US healthcare provider from Louisville, Kentucky. It delivers home and community-based care for seniors and people with disabilities and runs pharmacy services, including PharMerica for long-term care facilities and specialty and infusion pharmacies.
btw: BTW is the utility and governance token of the Bitway ecosystem, which offers yield, payments and financing services. The token is used for staking, voting and running the network, tying all Bitway products together.
bty: Bityuan (BTY) is a public blockchain from China built on the Chain33 technology of the Hangzhou company Fuzamei (33.cn). The network supports smart contracts and parallel chains for business applications and uses BTY for fees and mining.
bubi: Bullbit (BUBI) is a perpetual futures DEX that aims to feel like a centralized exchange: users sign in with e-mail or a passkey, pay no gas and keep custody of their funds. It runs on Base and plans to move to its own Layer 1, BullChain.
bulla: BULLA is a meme coin linked to Hasbulla, the popular internet personality from Dagestan. The project focuses on gamified quests, access to gated content and community campaigns to bring newcomers into crypto.
bun: Bundle Cat (BUN) is the first token launched on Mosh, a launch protocol by UV Labs on Robinhood Chain. In the Mosh model, crowd-funded token bundles are locked in smart-contract vaults and autonomous AI agents use them to provide liquidity under rules no one can override.
burl: Burlington Stores is a US off-price retailer from Burlington, New Jersey, founded in 1972 as Burlington Coat Factory. Its stores sell brand-name clothing, shoes, accessories and home goods at prices below those of department stores.
burn: BurnedFi (BURN) is a token on BNB Chain built around burning: users burn BURN tokens and receive BUILD tokens as proof, and each burn also mints extra BUILD that is shared among existing BUILD holders.
buttcoin: Buttcoin (BUTTCOIN) is a meme coin on Solana. Like most meme coins, it is not backed by a business or assets, and its price is driven mainly by community attention and trading.
bvi: Bureau Veritas is a French testing, inspection and certification company based near Paris, founded in 1828 in Antwerp to rate ships. It checks that buildings, industrial plants, ships, products, food and supply chains meet safety, quality and environmental standards.
bwa: BorgWarner is an American auto parts maker based in Michigan, founded in 1928. It supplies turbochargers, drivetrain systems, electric motors, inverters and batteries for petrol, hybrid and electric cars to the world's leading carmakers.
bwxt: BWX Technologies is a US nuclear components company from Virginia. It supplies reactors and fuel for the US Navy's nuclear submarines and aircraft carriers, and also makes equipment for nuclear power plants and medical isotopes.
bx: Blackstone is the world's largest alternative asset manager, founded in New York in 1985 by Stephen Schwarzman and Peter Peterson. It invests in private equity, real estate, credit and hedge funds on behalf of pension funds and other investors.
bxn: BlackFort (BXN) is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain that runs on a Proof-of-Staked-Authority consensus with short block times and low fees. The ecosystem aims to link decentralized finance, tokenized real-world assets and traditional financial services; BXN is its native coin.
bxp: BXP (formerly Boston Properties) is a US real estate investment trust based in Boston. It develops, owns and manages premium Class A office buildings in Boston, New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Seattle and Washington, DC.
byd: BYD is a Chinese maker of electric vehicles and batteries based in Shenzhen, founded in 1995 by Wang Chuanfu. Starting with phone batteries, it became one of the world's largest producers of electric and hybrid cars, buses and Blade batteries; Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway was an early investor.
byd-cn: BYD (A shares) are shares of Chinese electric car and battery maker BYD listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. The company was founded in 1995 by Wang Chuanfu and today makes EVs and hybrids, buses, Blade batteries and electronics.
byd-etf: Boyd Gaming is a US casino and hotel operator based in Las Vegas. It runs dozens of gaming properties in Nevada and other states, from locals-focused casinos in Las Vegas to regional resorts in the Midwest and South.
byma: BYMA (Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos) operates Argentina's main stock exchange in Buenos Aires. Created in 2017 from the Buenos Aires stock market, it runs trading in shares, bonds and other securities and, through Caja de Valores, the central securities depository and settlement.
bzz: Swarm (BZZ) is the token of Swarm, a decentralized storage and communication network for the web that grew out of the Ethereum ecosystem. Node operators store and serve data; BZZ, which runs on Gnosis Chain, pays them for it.
c: Citigroup is one of the largest US banks, headquartered in New York, with a history dating back to 1812. Citi serves corporations, governments and individuals in nearly a hundred countries with payments, credit cards, investment banking and wealth management.
c-token: Chainbase is a Web3 data network that collects, indexes and structures on-chain data from many blockchains so developers and AI applications can query it through simple APIs. C is the token used to pay for data services and secure the network.
