pag: Penske Automotive Group is a US car retailer from Bloomfield Hills, Michigan, chaired by Roger Penske. It runs hundreds of new and used car dealerships in the US, UK and other countries, sells and services heavy trucks, and owns a stake in Penske Transportation Solutions.
pah3: Porsche SE is a German investment holding company based in Stuttgart and controlled by the Porsche and Piëch families. It holds the majority of Volkswagen Group's voting shares and a stake in Porsche AG, so its value depends mainly on these carmakers.
paid: PAID Network is a business toolkit built on Ethereum that offers smart agreements, escrow, reputation scores and dispute resolution, so people can make simple contracts without lawyers. The PAID token pays for agreements and subscriptions and is used for staking, governance votes and arbitration.
pal: Palfinger is an Austrian maker of lifting solutions based in Bergheim near Salzburg, founded in 1932. It is best known for truck-mounted hydraulic loader cranes and also builds marine cranes, aerial work platforms and hooklifts.
palladium: Palladium is a rare platinum-group metal that goes almost entirely into catalytic converters for petrol engines. The main producers are Russia and South Africa.
pamp: Pampa Energía is Argentina's largest independent integrated energy company, based in Buenos Aires. It generates electricity from thermal, hydro and wind plants, produces natural gas and oil, including in the Vaca Muerta shale formation, makes petrochemicals and co-controls the gas pipeline company TGS.
panasonic: Panasonic is a Japanese electronics group based in Kadoma near Osaka, founded in 1918 by Konosuke Matsushita. It makes home appliances, air conditioners, electrical equipment and industrial devices, and is a major maker of lithium-ion batteries for electric cars, including for Tesla.
panw: Palo Alto Networks is a US cybersecurity company based in Santa Clara, California, founded in 2005. It sells next-generation firewalls, cloud security and AI-powered platforms for detecting attacks, including Prisma and Cortex.
parauco: Parque Arauco is a Chilean shopping centre company based in Santiago. It develops and operates regional malls, outlets and strip centres in Chile, Peru and Colombia, including its flagship Parque Arauco Kennedy mall in Santiago, and is adding offices and rental housing to its properties.
parti: Particle Network is a layer-1 blockchain for 'chain abstraction' that unifies users and liquidity across different blockchains. Its main idea is Universal Accounts: one account and balance for all networks; PARTI is the network's token.
path: UiPath is a New York software company, founded in Bucharest, Romania, in 2005, that pioneered robotic process automation. Its platform uses software robots and AI agents to automate repetitive office tasks such as data entry, invoice handling and report generation.
paxg: PAX Gold (PAXG) is a token issued by Paxos in which each coin is backed by one troy ounce of London Good Delivery gold held in professional vaults in London. Launched in 2019 and overseen by the New York regulator, it lets people own gold on Ethereum and redeem it for bars.
payai: PayAI Network (PAYAI) is a payments project on Solana for AI agents and online services. It acts as a facilitator for the x402 protocol, letting agents and apps pay each other instantly in stablecoins over the web, and PAYAI is its native token.
payc: Paycom Software is a US payroll and HR software company from Oklahoma City, founded in 1998 by Chad Richison. Its single cloud platform handles payroll, time tracking, hiring, benefits and talent management, and its Beti tool lets employees check and approve their own payroll.
payx: Paychex is an American provider of payroll and HR services for small and mid-sized businesses, based in Rochester, New York, and founded in 1971 by Tom Golisano. It handles payroll and tax filing, employee benefits, retirement plans, insurance and HR software for hundreds of thousands of employers; it bought rival Paycor in 2025.
paza: Pavlovo Bus (PAZ) is a Russian bus maker in Pavlovo, Nizhny Novgorod region, part of the GAZ Group. It builds small and mid-size buses for city routes, schools and suburban transport.
pb: Prosperity Bancshares is an American regional bank holding company based in Houston, founded in 1983. Its Prosperity Bank serves individuals and businesses in Texas and Oklahoma with deposits, loans, mortgages and wealth management.
pbf: PBF Energy is an independent US oil refiner from Parsippany, New Jersey, founded in 2008. It runs several large refineries on the East Coast, Gulf Coast, Midwest and West Coast that turn crude oil into gasoline, diesel, jet fuel and other products.
pcar: PACCAR is a US truck maker from Bellevue, Washington. It builds heavy trucks under the Kenworth and Peterbilt brands in North America and DAF in Europe, and also sells parts and provides financing.
pcg: PG&E is California's largest utility, headquartered in Oakland. It supplies electricity and natural gas to millions of customers in northern and central California and maintains a huge network of power lines.
pci: Paycoin (PCI) is a South Korean payment cryptocurrency from Danal Fintech, part of the Danal mobile payments group. Its app lets users pay with crypto at shops, restaurants and online stores across Korea.
pco: Pepco Group is a European discount retail group that started in Poland in 1999. Through its Pepco stores it sells low-priced clothing, toys and homeware in more than 20 countries, and it also owns the Dealz chain.
pcock: PulseChain Peacock (PCOCK) is a meme token on PulseChain, the blockchain founded by Richard Heart. It was launched on the Pump.tires platform, inspired by community posts about a peacock, and is promoted as an unofficial mascot of the network.
pcty: Paylocity is an American software company based in Schaumburg, Illinois, founded in 1997. Its cloud platform handles payroll, HR, benefits, time tracking and employee engagement, mainly for mid-sized US businesses.
pdd: PDD Holdings is a Chinese e-commerce company founded in 2015 by Colin Huang. It owns Pinduoduo, a Chinese marketplace known for group-buying discounts, and Temu, an international marketplace for low-cost goods.
peaq: peaq (PEAQ) is a blockchain for the «machine economy» that gives robots, vehicles, devices, sensors and AI agents digital identities, wallets and the ability to pay each other. DePIN projects run on it, letting people earn from their devices' data and services.
pearl: Pearl is a layer-1 blockchain built on Proof of Useful Work: mining happens as a by-product of useful AI computation on graphics cards. The same GPUs train or run AI models while also securing the network; PEARL is its native coin.
peas: Peapods Finance is a DeFi protocol where users wrap tokens into 'pods' — index-like baskets that earn fees when their price moves, an approach the team calls volatility farming. PEAS is the protocol's main token and earns a share of these fees.
peg: Public Service Enterprise Group (PSEG) is an American energy company based in Newark, New Jersey. Its utility PSE&G is New Jersey's largest supplier of electricity and natural gas to millions of homes and businesses, and the group also owns nuclear power plants at Salem and Hope Creek.
pega: Pegasystems (Pega) is a Massachusetts-based enterprise software company founded in 1983 by Alan Trefler, who still leads it. Its low-code Pega Infinity platform lets banks, insurers, telecoms and governments automate workflows and customer service with AI-driven decisions.
peipei: PeiPei (PEIPEI) is a community meme coin on Ethereum that mixes the Pepe the Frog meme with Chinese cultural motifs. It was fair-launched in June 2024 with no presale and no official team, and it has no use beyond community and trading.
pen: Penumbra is a US medical device company from Alameda, California, founded in 2004. It makes catheter-based systems that remove blood clots from vessels in the brain, lungs and limbs, used to treat stroke, pulmonary embolism and vein thrombosis.
pendle: Pendle is a DeFi protocol that splits yield-bearing assets into two parts — the principal and the future yield — which can be traded separately. This lets users lock in a fixed yield or speculate on how it changes; PENDLE is the governance and rewards token.
pengu: PENGU is the official token of Pudgy Penguins, one of the best-known NFT collections of cartoon penguins. The brand has grown beyond crypto, with Pudgy Penguins toys sold in major retail stores; the token launched on Solana in late 2024.
peo: Bank Pekao is one of Poland's largest banks, headquartered in Warsaw and founded in 1929. It provides retail, business and corporate banking, asset management and brokerage across Poland; the state-controlled PZU group is a key shareholder.
peoles: Industrias Peñoles is a Mexican mining and metals group founded in 1887 and based in Mexico City. It is one of the world's largest producers of refined silver, also mines and refines gold, zinc and lead, and controls the silver miner Fresnillo.
people: ConstitutionDAO (PEOPLE) is the token of an online community that in November 2021 raised over $40 million in crypto to bid at Sotheby's for an original copy of the US Constitution. The auction was lost, but the token remained a symbol of the movement.
pep: PepsiCo is an American food and beverage giant based in Purchase, New York. Besides Pepsi it owns Lay's, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Quaker and 7UP (outside the US); it was formed in 1965 by the merger of Pepsi-Cola and Frito-Lay.
pep-token: Pepecoin (PEP) is a community-focused Layer 1 cryptocurrency created by one of the original 2013 Dogecoin community members to recreate that fun spirit. It uses the Scrypt algorithm, can be merge-mined with Litecoin and Dogecoin and was fairly launched with no premine or ICO.
pepe: Pepe is a meme coin on Ethereum dedicated to the famous Pepe the Frog internet meme, launched in 2023. The token has no hidden functions or transaction taxes and relies on the meme's popularity and community activity.
pepecat: PEPECAT is a community memecoin that mixes the Pepe the Frog meme with cat culture. Like most memecoins, it has no business or assets behind it, and its price depends mainly on community attention and trading.
pepecoin: PepeCoin (PEPECOIN) is a meme coin. Like most meme coins, it is not backed by a business or assets, and its price is driven mainly by community attention and trading.
pepper: PEPPER is a community meme token on the Chiliz Chain, made to reward the Chiliz community and CHZ holders. It had a fair launch with no pre-mint or ICO and a large supply distributed through airdrops and farming.
perp: Perpetual Protocol is a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures, launched in 2020, that lets users trade crypto with leverage directly from their wallets without an order book, using a virtual automated market maker. It runs mainly on the Ethereum layer-2 network Optimism; PERP is used for governance and staking.
petkm: Petkim is Turkey's largest petrochemical producer, founded in 1965, with its complex at Aliağa near Izmir. It makes polyethylene, PVC, polypropylene and other plastics for industry, and is controlled by Azerbaijan's SOCAR.
petr4: Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled oil company, based in Rio de Janeiro and founded in 1953. It produces oil and gas, mainly from deep-water pre-salt fields off the coast, and refines crude and sells fuel.
petrochina: PetroChina is China's largest oil and gas company, based in Beijing and created in 1999 as a subsidiary of state-owned CNPC. It produces oil and gas, refines them, owns trunk pipelines and runs a network of filling stations across the country.
petronas-chemicals: Petronas Chemicals Group is the petrochemical arm of Malaysia's state oil company Petronas and the country's largest chemicals producer. It makes olefins and polymers such as polyethylene, methanol, and fertilisers such as urea and ammonia, from plants in Malaysia including the Pengerang complex in Johor.
petronas-gas: Petronas Gas is a Malaysian gas infrastructure company majority-owned by Petronas. It processes natural gas from offshore fields at plants in Terengganu, runs the Peninsular Gas Utilisation pipeline network and LNG regasification terminals in Melaka and Johor, and supplies steam and power to industrial sites.
pfe: Pfizer is one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies, founded in 1849 in New York. It develops medicines and vaccines for cancer, infections and heart disease, and is known for the COVID-19 vaccine made with BioNTech and for drugs such as Viagra and Lipitor.
pfg: Principal Financial Group is a US financial company from Des Moines, Iowa, founded in 1879. It manages retirement plans and investment funds and sells life and disability insurance to individuals and employers.
pfgc: Performance Food Group is a US foodservice distributor from Richmond, Virginia. It delivers food, drinks and supplies to restaurants, schools, hospitals and convenience stores, and owns the Core-Mark convenience distribution business.
pg: Procter & Gamble is an American consumer goods maker based in Cincinnati, founded in 1837. It owns brands such as Gillette, Pampers, Tide, Ariel, Head & Shoulders, Oral-B and Fairy, and is known for decades of uninterrupted dividend increases.
pgas: PGN (Perusahaan Gas Negara) is Indonesia's state gas company based in Jakarta and a subsidiary of Pertamina. It transports and distributes natural gas through pipelines to factories, power plants and households.
pge: PGE (Polska Grupa Energetyczna) is Poland's largest energy company and is controlled by the state. It owns coal-fired plants including Bełchatów, Europe's biggest, is building offshore wind farms in the Baltic and supplies electricity to millions of customers.
pghn: Partners Group is a Swiss investment firm based in Baar near Zug, founded in 1996. It manages money for pension funds and other investors in private markets, buying stakes in companies, real estate and infrastructure outside the stock exchange.
pgr: Progressive is one of the largest car insurers in the US, headquartered in Mayfield Village, Ohio. It sells auto, motorcycle, home and business insurance online and through agents, and is known for its TV ads featuring the character Flo.
pgsus: Pegasus is Turkey's largest low-cost airline, based at Istanbul's Sabiha Gökçen airport. It flies domestic routes and to Europe, the Middle East and Central Asia, offering cheap fares with paid extras.
ph: Parker Hannifin is a US industrial manufacturer from Cleveland, Ohio, founded in 1917. It is a world leader in motion and control technologies: hydraulics, pneumatics, filtration, seals and components for aerospace and industry.
pha: Phala Network (PHA) is a decentralized cloud for confidential computing that uses secure processor enclaves (TEE). It lets AI agents work safely with blockchains; the PHA token is used for payments and staking.
phdc: Palm Hills Developments is an Egyptian real estate developer founded in 2005 and based in Giza. It builds gated residential communities in West and East Cairo and holiday resorts on the North Coast, selling homes and running related services.
phia: Philips is a Dutch health technology company from Amsterdam, founded in 1891 in Eindhoven as a light bulb maker. Today it makes medical imaging and patient monitoring equipment, plus electric shavers, Sonicare toothbrushes and personal care appliances.
phm: PulteGroup is one of the largest homebuilders in the US, headquartered in Atlanta and founded in 1950 by Bill Pulte. It builds houses under brands such as Pulte Homes, Centex and Del Webb, which focuses on buyers aged 55 and over.
phm-es: PharmaMar is a Spanish biopharmaceutical company based near Madrid. It discovers and develops cancer medicines derived from marine organisms; its approved drugs include Yondelis, for soft-tissue sarcoma, and Zepzelca, for small-cell lung cancer.
phnix: PHNIX is a meme coin on the XRP Ledger, launched on December 3, built around the phoenix — the rising-from-the-ashes mascot used by the XRP community. It trades on the FirstLedger DEX with no transaction tax, and its liquidity pool was burned.
phoe: Phoenix Financial, formerly Phoenix Holdings, is one of Israel's largest insurance and investment groups, based in Givatayim. It sells life, health and general insurance, manages pension and provident funds, and owns the Excellence investment house and brokerage.
phor: PhosAgro is a Moscow-based Russian producer of phosphate fertilizers and one of the largest in the world. It mines apatite ore on the Kola Peninsula and turns it into mineral fertilizers, mostly for export.
pi: Pi Network is a social cryptocurrency launched in 2019 by Stanford graduates. Users "mine" Pi in a mobile app with a single tap and no energy cost, and the network's open mainnet went live in February 2025.
pidilitind: Pidilite Industries is an Indian maker of adhesives, sealants and construction chemicals based in Mumbai. It owns some of India's best-known household brands, including Fevicol wood glue, Fevikwik instant adhesive, M-Seal and Dr. Fixit waterproofing.
pieverse: Pieverse is compliance-focused payment infrastructure for Web3. The protocol records transactions on-chain as verifiable receipts and timestamps (including on the x402 standard), so businesses and AI agents can settle payments transparently; it runs on BNB Chain.
pii: Polaris is an American maker of powersports vehicles from Medina, Minnesota, founded in 1954. It builds snowmobiles, all-terrain and side-by-side vehicles such as RZR and Ranger, Slingshot three-wheelers and pontoon boats.
pikk: PIK Group is one of Russia's largest residential property developers, founded in 1994. It builds large apartment complexes, mainly in Moscow and the Moscow region, and also manages and services the housing it builds.
pin: PinLink (PIN) is a marketplace for tokenized DePIN assets on Ethereum: it turns physical computing hardware such as GPU servers into tokens, so people can buy fractional ownership and earn a share of the rental income.
pinfra: Pinfra (Promotora y Operadora de Infraestructura) is a Mexican infrastructure company based in Mexico City. It holds concessions for toll roads and bridges, runs a port terminal in Altamira and produces asphalt and building materials.
ping-an: Ping An Insurance (A shares) are shares of the Shenzhen-based Chinese financial group Ping An listed on the Shanghai exchange. Founded in 1988, the group works in life and property insurance, banking and asset management, and develops online healthcare services.
ping-an-bank: Ping An Bank is a Chinese commercial bank from Shenzhen and part of the Ping An financial group. Its predecessor, Shenzhen Development Bank, became China's first bank with publicly traded shares in 1987; today it focuses on retail and digital banking.
ping-an-insurance: Ping An is a Chinese financial group from Shenzhen, founded in 1988 by Ma Mingzhe. It is one of the world's largest insurers, covering life and property insurance, Ping An Bank, asset management, and healthcare and fintech services.
pins: Pinterest is an American visual discovery platform based in San Francisco, founded in 2010 by Ben Silbermann, Paul Sciarra and Evan Sharp. People save images (pins) to boards to find ideas for recipes, home decor, fashion and travel; the company earns mainly from advertising.
pipe: Pipe Network (PIPE) is a decentralised content delivery network (CDN) on Solana. Independent nodes around the world cache and serve video and files close to users, and node operators are rewarded in PIPE.
pipedog: Pipedog (PIPEDOG) is a dog-themed meme coin on Robinhood Chain, the Ethereum layer-2 network that Robinhood launched in 2026. It was one of the first memecoins to draw wide attention on the network and is driven by its community, with no utility beyond that.
pipi: PIPI is a memecoin on Ethereum featuring Pipi, a laid-back cartoon toad in a pink Hawaiian shirt, gold chain and aviator sunglasses. It is a community token built around a relaxed, synthwave-style image.
pippin: Pippin is a meme token on Solana linked to an autonomous AI agent of the same name on X. The character, an SVG unicorn drawn with ChatGPT-4o, was created by investor and developer Yohei Nakajima, the author of the well-known BabyAGI experiment.
pit: Pitbull (PIT) is a community meme token on BNB Smart Chain, launched in 2021 during the wave of dog-themed coins. It is driven by its community and has no significant built-in utility.
pivx: PIVX is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency launched in 2016 as a fork of Dash. It runs on proof of stake, uses masternodes and a community treasury that funds development, and offers optional private transactions through its zk-SNARK-based SHIELD feature.
pixel: Pixels is a pixel-art online game about farming and exploration that runs on the Ronin network. Players grow crops, build skills and complete quests, and PIXEL is the in-game token used for purchases and governance.
pk: Park Hotels & Resorts is a US lodging real estate investment trust based in Virginia, spun off from Hilton in 2017. It owns upscale hotels and resorts in major cities and resort destinations, most of them run under Hilton brands.
pkg: Packaging Corporation of America is a US maker of containerboard and paper based in Lake Forest, Illinois. It produces linerboard and corrugated boxes for the food, industrial and logistics sectors, as well as office paper.
pkn: Orlen is Poland's largest company, a state-controlled energy group based in Płock. It runs oil refineries and petrochemical plants, a network of thousands of fuel stations in Poland, Germany, Czechia, Slovakia and Lithuania, gas production and trading after merging with PGNiG and Lotos in 2022, and power generation.
pko: PKO Bank Polski is Poland's largest bank, based in Warsaw, founded in 1919 and controlled by the state. It serves millions of individuals and businesses with accounts, cards, mortgages, loans, investment and insurance products, and is known for its popular IKO mobile banking app.
pkoin: Pocketcoin (PKOIN) is the coin of Bastyon, formerly Pocketnet, a decentralized and censorship-resistant social network that runs on its own blockchain. PKOIN is used for tips to authors, paid content, advertising and staking.
plai: Play AI (PLAI) is the native token of the Play AI Network on Base, used for payments, governance and incentives in the network's orchestration layer for AI agents and applications.
platinum: Platinum is a rare precious metal mined mostly in South Africa. Its main uses are catalytic converters for cars, jewellery and hydrogen technologies.
play: PlaysOut (PLAY) is the token of PlaysOut, a publishing platform for mini-games inside big apps and super apps. Developers integrate once to launch many small games, and host apps use them to keep users engaged and earn money.
pld: Prologis is the world's largest owner of logistics real estate, a REIT based in San Francisco. It builds and leases warehouses and distribution centers near major cities to online retailers, store chains and logistics companies.
plearn: PLEARN is a DeFi project on BNB Smart Chain that combines ordinary DeFi yields with perks from partner businesses in areas like travel and lifestyle. The idea is that holders can both earn on their tokens and spend them on real-world benefits, which keeps the token in circulation.
plnt: Planet Fitness is a US gym chain founded in 1992 in Dover, New Hampshire, and now based in Hampton in the same state. It is known for low-cost memberships and its "Judgement Free Zone" for beginners, and most of its clubs are run by franchisees.
pltr: Palantir is an American data analytics company headquartered in Denver, founded in 2003 by Peter Thiel, Alex Karp and others. Its Gotham, Foundry and AIP platforms help governments, armed forces and corporations analyze large datasets and put artificial intelligence to work.
pltr-token: Palantir Technologies • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of Palantir shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. It follows the price of the US-listed stock and can be traded around the clock on a blockchain.
plug: Plug Power is a US hydrogen company from New York State, founded in 1997. It makes hydrogen fuel cells, widely used to power forklifts in warehouses, as well as electrolysers that produce hydrogen, and it supplies liquid hydrogen to customers.
plume: Plume (PLUME) is an Ethereum-compatible layer-1 blockchain built for tokenized real-world assets (RWA). It lets assets such as loans, bonds or commodities be issued on-chain and used in DeFi for lending and earning yield.
plzl: Polyus is Russia's largest gold producer and one of the biggest in the world. It mines deposits in Siberia and the Far East, including Olimpiada and Natalka, and owns the Sukhoi Log deposit.
pm: Philip Morris International is a tobacco company based in Stamford, Connecticut, that sells Marlboro outside the United States. It is pushing smoke-free products: IQOS heated-tobacco devices and ZYN nicotine pouches.
pmsb: Perm Energosbyt is the main electricity retailer in Perm Krai in Russia's Urals. It buys power on the wholesale market and sells it to households and businesses across the region, issuing bills and collecting payments.
pmt: Public Masterpiece (PMT) is a platform that links physical art with blockchain: digital certificates confirm a painting's authenticity from creation to sale. It offers collectors NFTs and tokenized artworks as real-world assets (RWA).
pnc: PNC Financial Services is one of the largest US banks, headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, with roots going back to 1845. It serves consumers and businesses with checking and savings accounts, loans, mortgages, corporate banking and asset management.
pndora: Pandora is a Danish jewellery company based in Copenhagen, founded in 1982, and the world's largest jewellery brand by number of pieces sold. Best known for its charm bracelets, it designs rings, necklaces and earrings, makes most of them at its own workshops in Thailand and sells through thousands of stores worldwide.
pnfp: Pinnacle Financial Partners is a US bank holding company from Nashville, Tennessee, founded in 2000. Its Pinnacle Bank serves businesses, professionals and consumers mainly in fast-growing cities of the Southeast.
png: Pangolin (PNG) is the token of Pangolin, a decentralized exchange launched in 2021 on the Avalanche network. Users swap tokens and provide liquidity through an automated market maker, and PNG is used for governance and liquidity rewards.
pnic: Phoenic (PNIC) is a payments token on Arbitrum linked to the Miracle Chain project. It is designed for fast, low-cost digital transactions and is used across the apps of its ecosystem.
pnkstr: PunkStrategy (PNKSTR) is a token from TokenWorks whose trading fees are used to buy CryptoPunks, the famous 2017 NFT collection. The bought Punks are relisted at a higher price, and the proceeds are used to buy back and burn PNKSTR.
pnl: PostNL is the Dutch postal and parcel company based in The Hague. It delivers letters and parcels in the Netherlands and Belgium, handles e-commerce logistics for online shops, and runs international mail services.
pnr: Pentair is a water technology company registered in Ireland with its main operations in Minneapolis. It makes pumps, filters, water treatment systems and pool equipment for homes and businesses.
pnt: Pheasant Network (PNT) is a cross-chain bridge from a Japanese team that moves ETH and tokens quickly and cheaply between Ethereum layer 2 networks such as Arbitrum, Optimism and Base. PNT is the network's token.
pnut: Peanut the Squirrel (PNUT) is a meme token on Solana named after Peanut, a squirrel popular on Instagram that New York state authorities seized and euthanized in November 2024. The story went viral, and the token became a symbol of community protest.
pnw: Pinnacle West Capital is an energy holding company from Phoenix, Arizona. Its main subsidiary, Arizona Public Service, is the largest electricity supplier in Arizona and operates the Palo Verde nuclear plant.
pod: Dolphin (POD) is linked to Dolphin Network, a decentralized AI inference network where gamers and other GPU owners rent out idle graphics cards to run AI models and earn tokens. Work is checked with encryption, random validation and staked bonds.
podd: Insulet is an American medical device company based in Acton, Massachusetts. It makes the Omnipod, a tubeless, wearable insulin pump patch controlled from a smartphone or handheld; the Omnipod 5 adjusts insulin doses automatically using glucose sensor data.
pokt: Pocket Network is decentralized RPC infrastructure: thousands of independent nodes give apps access to data from dozens of blockchains instead of centralized providers. POKT is used to pay for requests and to stake nodes.
pol: POL is the native token of the Polygon network, which replaced MATIC in 2024. Polygon is a family of Ethereum scaling solutions popular for payments and tokenization; POL pays network fees and is staked to secure Polygon chains.
poli: Bank Hapoalim is one of Israel's two largest banks, based in Tel Aviv and founded in 1921 by the Histadrut labour federation and the Zionist movement. It serves households, small businesses and large companies, and offers the Bit mobile payment app.
polis: Star Atlas DAO (POLIS) is the governance token of Star Atlas, a space-exploration strategy game built on Solana. POLIS holders vote on the game's direction, while ATLAS is the separate in-game currency.
pols: Polkastarter (POLS) is the token of Polkastarter, a launchpad founded in 2020 where new crypto projects run token sales (IDOs) for the public. Holding or staking POLS helps users qualify for allocations in these sales.
polyx: Polymesh (POLYX) is a layer-1 blockchain for regulated assets such as tokenized stocks and bonds, built by the Polymath team. It has built-in identity checks and compliance rules; POLYX is used for fees and staking.
pond: Marlin is a network for verifiable off-chain computing that lets apps run tasks in secure hardware enclaves (TEEs) and ZK coprocessors and prove the results on-chain. POND is staked by node operators and used to secure and pay for the network.
ponke: PONKE is a memecoin on Solana built around a cartoon monkey character known as a reckless, degenerate gambler. It has no function beyond its community, memes and trading.
pons: Pons (PONS) is the token of Pons, a launchpad for new tokens on Robinhood Chain, the blockchain network launched by the brokerage Robinhood. Projects use the platform to issue and list their tokens.
pool: Pool Corporation (POOLCORP) is the world's largest wholesale distributor of swimming pool supplies, based in Covington, Louisiana. It sells pool chemicals, equipment, parts and outdoor-living products to pool builders, service companies and retail stores.
popcat: Popcat (POPCAT) is a Solana meme token inspired by the viral meme of a cat named Oatmeal that "pops" its mouth open in an O shape. It is driven purely by meme culture.
por: Portland General Electric is a US electric utility based in Portland, Oregon, founded in 1888. It generates, transmits and delivers electricity to homes and businesses in the Portland area and much of northwestern Oregon, using hydro, wind, solar and gas plants.
por-token: Portugal National Team Fan Token (POR) is a fan token of the Portuguese national football team, issued on BNB Chain through the Binance Fan Token platform. Holders take part in fan votes and get access to rewards and team-related experiences.
portal: Portal is a cross-chain Web3 gaming platform that aims to bring mainstream gamers into crypto. It works as a launcher and hub where players discover blockchain games across different networks; PORTAL is the ecosystem token.
porto: FC Porto Fan Token is the official fan token of FC Porto, the football club from Portugal, issued on Binance's Fan Token platform. Holders vote in club polls and get access to rewards and fan experiences.
posco-holdings: POSCO Holdings is the holding company of POSCO, South Korea's largest steelmaker, founded in 1968 as Pohang Iron and Steel. Besides steel for cars, ships and construction, the group invests in lithium, nickel and battery materials for electric vehicles.
posi: Positive Technologies (Positive Group) is a Moscow cybersecurity company founded in 2002. It makes software that finds vulnerabilities and detects attacks, such as MaxPatrol, and runs the Positive Hack Days conference; it is under US sanctions.
post: Post Holdings is a US packaged-food company from St. Louis, Missouri. It makes breakfast cereals such as Honey Bunches of Oats and Pebbles, Weetabix in the UK, egg and potato products through Michael Foods, Bob Evans side dishes and pet food.
post-at: Austrian Post (Österreichische Post) is Austria's national postal and parcel company, based in Vienna. It delivers letters, parcels and advertising mail, runs logistics in central and south-eastern Europe and owns bank99.
pot: Port of Tauranga is the company that runs New Zealand's largest port, in the Bay of Plenty on the North Island. It handles container ships and bulk cargo and is the country's main gateway for exports such as logs, kiwifruit and dairy products.
power: Power Protocol is a rewards layer for Web3 games: players earn and spend the POWER token across partner games, and studios use it to reward their communities. The token runs on BNB Chain, Ethereum and Ronin.
powergrid: Power Grid Corporation of India is a state-owned company from Gurugram that runs most of India's inter-state power transmission lines. It builds and maintains high-voltage lines and substations and also offers telecom services over its fibre network.
powr: Powerledger is an Australian tech company founded in Perth in 2016 that builds blockchain software for decentralized energy markets. Its platform tracks and trades electricity, including solar power between neighbours, and environmental certificates; POWR is the platform access token.
ppc: Pilgrim's Pride is one of the world's largest chicken producers, based in Greeley, Colorado, and majority-owned by Brazil's JBS. It raises, processes and sells fresh, frozen and prepared chicken and pork in the US, UK, Europe and Mexico.
ppc-gr: PPC (Public Power Corporation) is Greece's largest electricity company, based in Athens and founded in 1950. It generates power from lignite, gas, hydro and a growing share of solar and wind, runs the national distribution grid and supplies millions of customers.
ppc-token: Peercoin (PPC), launched in 2012 by the pseudonymous developer Sunny King, is one of the oldest cryptocurrencies and the first to use proof-of-stake, which secures the network with far less energy than Bitcoin-style mining. It combines proof-of-stake with proof-of-work.
ppg: PPG Industries is a US paint and coatings maker from Pittsburgh, founded in 1883. It produces coatings for cars, aircraft, industry and buildings; its brands include PPG, Glidden and Comex.
ppl: PPL Corporation is a US energy company from Allentown, Pennsylvania. Through regulated subsidiaries it delivers electricity and natural gas to millions of customers in Pennsylvania, Kentucky and Rhode Island.
pr: Permian Resources is an independent US oil and gas producer based in Midland, Texas. Formerly Centennial Resource Development, it took its current name in 2022 after merging with Colgate Energy, and drills mainly in the Delaware Basin of West Texas and New Mexico.
prcl: Parcl (PRCL) is the token of Parcl, a Solana-based platform for trading real-estate price indexes of cities such as New York or Miami. Users can bet on home prices rising or falling without buying property.
preopai: This token from the investment platform Republic tracks the value of pre-IPO shares of OpenAI, the US company behind ChatGPT. It gives economic exposure to a private company before any listing, but it is not issued by OpenAI and carries no shareholder rights.
prespcx: This token from the investment platform Republic tracks the value of pre-IPO shares of SpaceX, Elon Musk's rocket and Starlink satellite internet company. It offers economic exposure to the private company, but it is not issued by SpaceX and carries no shareholder rights.
press-metal: Press Metal Aluminium is Malaysia's largest aluminium producer. It runs smelters in Sarawak powered by hydroelectricity, making it one of Asia's lower-carbon aluminium makers, and turns the metal into ingots, billets and extruded profiles for construction, cars and packaging.
pri: Primerica is an American financial services company based in Duluth, Georgia, with roots going back to 1977. Through a large network of independent licensed representatives it sells term life insurance, mutual funds and other savings products to middle-income families in the US and Canada.
prime: PRIME is the token of the Echelon Prime Foundation and the main currency of the Parallel ecosystem, a sci-fi trading card game on Ethereum and Base. Players use PRIME to buy and craft cards, and it powers AI-driven games built in the ecosystem.
prio3: PRIO is an independent Brazilian oil and gas company based in Rio de Janeiro, formerly known as PetroRio. It specialises in buying mature offshore fields in the Campos Basin and running them more efficiently at low production cost.
priors: Priors Agents is an on-chain credit pool on Robinhood Chain that lends the USDG stablecoin to AI agents with ERC-8004 identities. Every loan, repayment and default is recorded on-chain and builds a public credit score from 0 to 1,000 for each agent.
prize: Prize Protocol (PRIZE) is a watch-to-earn project on Solana: users collect Gems by engaging with sponsored content and convert them into PRIZE, which is used to join giveaways. A Recycle feature also lets people swap dead tokens for PRIZE.
prl: Perle Labs is a Web3 AI platform on Solana that connects verified experts with companies and research teams to train and improve AI models. Specialists are rewarded for labeling and evaluating data, and PRL is the ecosystem token.
prmd: Promomed is a Russian pharmaceutical company based in Moscow that develops and manufactures medicines, including drugs for diabetes, obesity and infections. Its main factory, Biokhimik, is in Saransk; the company listed on the Moscow Exchange in 2024.
pro: Propy is an American blockchain platform for real-estate deals that automates buying a home, from signing the contract to recording the title. In 2017 it handled one of the first property sales recorded on a blockchain; the PRO token is used in its ecosystem.
prom: Prom (PROM) is a modular Layer 2 network built on zkEVM technology that connects different blockchains, both Ethereum-compatible and not. The project grew out of the Prometeus platform; PROM is used to pay fees and for staking.
prompt: Wayfinder is a non-custodial AI agent for crypto trading: from a single chat you can trade spot on EVM chains and Solana, futures on Hyperliquid and Polymarket markets. The PROMPT token powers the ecosystem.
propc: Propchain is a Swiss-based blockchain platform for real estate that tokenizes property, letting investors buy fractional digital shares of buildings and helping owners and funds manage and raise capital on-chain. The PROPC token is used for access, fees and rewards on the platform.
props: Propbase (PROPS) is the token of Propbase, a real estate tokenization marketplace on the Aptos blockchain. It lets people buy fractions of rental properties with small amounts and receive their share of rental income.
pros: Pharos (PROS) is an Ethereum-compatible layer-1 blockchain built for payments and tokenized real-world assets. The network is designed for very high throughput, and PROS is its native token.
prove: Succinct (PROVE) is a decentralized network of provers that generates zero-knowledge proofs for blockchains and apps. The team built the SP1 zkVM, and the PROVE token is used to pay for proofs and for staking.
prox: Proximus is Belgium's largest telecom company, based in Brussels and majority owned by the Belgian state. It provides mobile, fixed broadband and TV services, and owns the international carrier BICS and the communications platform Telesign.
pru: Prudential Financial is one of the largest US life insurers, based in Newark, New Jersey, and founded in 1875; its Rock of Gibraltar logo is widely known. It sells life insurance, annuities and retirement plans and runs the investment manager PGIM; it is a separate company from the UK's Prudential plc.
pru-gb: Prudential plc is an insurer founded in 1848 in London and now headquartered in Hong Kong. It sells life and health insurance and savings products in Asia and Africa, and is not related to the US company Prudential Financial.
prx: Prosus is a Dutch internet investment group based in Amsterdam, spun off from South Africa's Naspers in 2019. It owns a large stake in China's Tencent and runs online businesses such as OLX classifieds, iFood food delivery and PayU payments.
pry: Prysmian is an Italian cable maker from Milan and the largest in the world in its industry. It produces power cables, including high-voltage subsea cables for offshore wind farms, plus telecom and fiber-optic cables under the Prysmian, Draka and General Cable brands.
psa: Public Storage is the largest self-storage operator in the US, a REIT based in Glendale, California, and founded in 1972. It rents storage units and lockers to individuals and businesses at thousands of locations.
psg: Paris Saint-Germain Fan Token (PSG) is the fan token of French football club PSG on the Socios.com platform on the Chiliz network. It lets supporters vote in club polls and take part in giveaways and fan promotions.
psg-es: Prosegur is a Spanish security company from Madrid, founded in 1976. It provides security guards, alarm systems, and cash transport and management for banks and retailers in Europe, Latin America and other regions.
psn: Parsons is an American engineering and technology company from Centreville, Virginia, founded in 1944. It works for the US government on defense, intelligence, cyber and space projects and designs and manages infrastructure such as roads, rail, airports and water systems.
psn-gb: Persimmon is a British housebuilder based in York, founded in 1972 by Duncan Davidson. It builds new homes across the UK under the Persimmon Homes and Charles Church brands and makes some of its own building materials, such as bricks and timber frames.
pson: Pearson is a London-based British education company and the world's largest publisher of learning materials. It makes textbooks and digital courses, runs the PTE English test and delivers professional certification exams through Pearson VUE.
pssa3: Porto Seguro is a Brazilian insurance group based in São Paulo, founded in 1945. It is a leader in car insurance in Brazil and also sells home, life and health insurance, and runs financial services under Porto Bank, including credit cards, consortia and loans.
pst: Poste Italiane is Italy's national postal operator, based in Rome and controlled by the state, with roots going back to 1862. Besides letters and parcels it is one of the country's largest financial groups, offering BancoPosta savings and payments, PostePay cards and life insurance through Poste Vita in thousands of post offices.
psx: Phillips 66 is a US energy company from Houston, spun off from ConocoPhillips in 2012. It refines crude oil, runs pipelines, makes chemicals through the Chevron Phillips joint venture and sells fuel at Phillips 66, 76 and Conoco stations.
ptc: PTC is an American software company based in Boston, founded in 1985 as Parametric Technology. It makes software for engineers and manufacturers: Creo and Onshape for 3D design, Windchill for product lifecycle management, and ThingWorx for the industrial internet of things.
ptgc: The Grays Currency (PTGC) is a DAO token on PulseChain. Holders collect rewards simply by holding, stakers earn more with no lock-up, the top 100 stakers can create proposals and all stakers vote; the project focuses on buying and burning liquidity tokens.
pton: Peloton is a US fitness company from New York, founded in 2012. It sells connected exercise bikes, treadmills and rowers with built-in screens, and earns much of its money from monthly memberships for live and on-demand classes that also work in its app without equipment.
ptsb: PTSB (Permanent TSB) is an Irish retail bank based in Dublin. It is one of Ireland's main high-street banks, offering mortgages, current accounts, savings and loans to households and small businesses.
ptt: PTT is Thailand's state-owned oil and gas company from Bangkok, founded in 1978. It runs gas pipelines and gas processing, exploration and production (through PTTEP), refining and petrochemicals; PTT gas stations belong to its unit PTT Oil and Retail.
pttep: PTT Exploration and Production (PTTEP) is Thailand's national oil and gas exploration and production company, based in Bangkok and founded in 1985 as a subsidiary of the state energy group PTT. It finds and produces oil and natural gas in Thailand, Southeast Asia and other regions.
pub: Publicis Groupe is a French advertising and communications holding company based in Paris, founded in 1926. It brings together agencies such as Leo Burnett, Saatchi & Saatchi and BBH, plus Epsilon and Publicis Sapient for data, media and digital services.
public: PublicAI (PUBLIC) is a platform that pays people for helping train artificial intelligence, for example by labeling and checking data with their own expertise. PUBLIC is used for contributor rewards, validator staking and voting, and the token exists on BNB Chain and NEAR.
public-bank: Public Bank is one of Malaysia's largest banks, based in Kuala Lumpur and founded in 1966 by Teh Hong Piow. It focuses on retail banking — mortgages, car loans, deposits and small-business lending — and also operates in Hong Kong, Cambodia, Vietnam and Laos.
puffer: Puffer is a decentralized Ethereum platform that combines restaking with rollup-based solutions. Users receive the liquid token pufETH in place of staked ETH, while PUFFER is used for voting in the protocol.
puig: Puig is a Spanish beauty and fashion company from Barcelona, founded in 1914 and still controlled by the founding family. It owns fragrance and fashion brands such as Carolina Herrera, Paco Rabanne and Jean Paul Gaultier, plus Charlotte Tilbury makeup and Byredo.
pum: Puma is a German sportswear company based in Herzogenaurach, founded in 1948 by Rudolf Dassler. It designs and sells sports shoes, clothing and accessories for football, running, motorsport and everyday wear worldwide.
pump: PUMP is the token of Pump.fun, a Solana platform that since 2024 lets anyone launch their own meme coin in about a minute. Pump.fun became one of the main venues of the meme coin boom, and part of its revenue goes to buying back PUMP.
pumpcade: PUMPCADE is the token of Pumpcade, a platform for fast, real-time prediction markets embedded in livestreams. Streamers can show markets as an overlay, viewers predict right from the stream chat, and markets settle automatically.
pundix: Pundi X is a project from Indonesia that built crypto point-of-sale terminals for paying in shops. Today it is developing the Pundi AI blockchain ecosystem for data and AI; PUNDIX is the project's token.
puppies: I love puppies (PUPPIES) is a meme coin. Like most meme coins, it is not backed by a business or assets, and its price is driven mainly by community attention and trading.
pups: PUPS (Pups) is a memecoin on the Bitcoin blockchain, issued with the Runes protocol that lets tokens live directly on Bitcoin. It grew from a dog-themed community and has no business behind it.
purpe: Purple Pepe (PURPE) is a memecoin built around a purple version of the Pepe the Frog meme. Like most memecoins, it has no business or assets behind it, and its price depends mainly on community attention and trading.
purr: Purr (PURR) is a cat-themed memecoin, the first spot token on the Hyperliquid network, launched without a sale. Half of the supply was distributed to Hyperliquid users; the token has no planned utility and exists as a community symbol.
puss: PUSS is a meme token on the TRON blockchain, launched through SunPump and tied to the Steemit blogging community. Its project, PussFi, aims to reward Steemit bloggers and token stakers with extra curation upvotes.
pvh: PVH is an American apparel company from New York whose roots go back to 1881. It owns the global fashion brands Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger and sells clothing, underwear, jeans and accessories through stores, wholesale partners and online.
pvt: Punkvism (PVT), from "punk" and "activism", grew out of the PunkyKongz community of 5,000 NFTs. PVT is an access and governance token linking digital and real-world assets; it launched on Solana with plans for its own layer 2, PUNK Chain.
pwr: Quanta Services is a US infrastructure contractor based in Houston. It designs, builds and maintains power lines, substations, renewable energy connections, gas pipelines and communications networks for utilities and other industries across North America and abroad.
pwt: Permacast (PWT) is the token of an AI-powered permanent media network from PermawebDAO that stores and indexes news, podcasts, audio and video on Arweave. PWT is a BNB Chain token used for publishing and storage fees, creator rewards and governance.
px: Not Pixel (PX) is the token of Not Pixel, a Telegram mini-app game from the team behind Notcoin in which players paint a huge shared pixel canvas together. The PX token was issued on The Open Network (TON).
pxp: PointPay (PXP) is the utility token of PointPay, a crypto financial platform that combines a multi-currency wallet, an exchange and other crypto services; holders get fee discounts and rewards.
pybobo: Capybobo is a Web3 art toy project built around a capybara character. Its ecosystem combines a GameFi game, NFTs linked to blind boxes and physical collectible figures, and the PYBOBO token is used in games and rewards.
pypl: PayPal is a US online payments company from San Jose, California, founded in 1998; its founders include Peter Thiel and Elon Musk. It owns the PayPal wallet, the Venmo app and the Braintree payment platform.
pyr: Vulcan Forged (PYR) is the token of Vulcan Forged, a blockchain gaming studio and ecosystem with games such as VulcanVerse and Berserk, an NFT marketplace and its own Elysium blockchain. PYR is used for payments, staking and in-game purchases.
pyth: Pyth Network is a decentralized oracle network that delivers real-time prices of stocks, crypto, currencies and commodities to blockchains. The data comes directly from exchanges and trading firms; PYTH is the network's governance token.
pyusd: PayPal USD (PYUSD) is a dollar-pegged stablecoin launched by PayPal in August 2023 and issued by Paxos. It is backed by dollar deposits and short-term US Treasuries, runs on Ethereum and Solana, and can be bought, sent and used for payments inside PayPal and Venmo in the US.
pzp: PlayZap Games (PZP) is a mobile gaming platform where people play casual skill games such as pool, solitaire and puzzles in tournaments against other players. PZP is its utility token, used for tournament rewards and staking, and it runs on BNB Chain.
pzu: PZU (Powszechny Zakład Ubezpieczeń) is Poland's largest insurer, based in Warsaw, with roots going back to 1803. Controlled by the state, it sells life and non-life insurance and pensions in Poland and the Baltics and owns large stakes in Bank Pekao and Alior Bank.
q: Qnity Electronics is a US company spun off from DuPont in 2025. It makes materials for producing semiconductors and electronics, such as wafer-polishing chemicals, photoresists and materials for circuit boards and chip packaging.
q-mx: Quálitas is Mexico's largest car insurer, founded in 1994 and based in Mexico City. It specialises in auto insurance for drivers, fleets and financed vehicles, and also operates in the United States, Costa Rica, El Salvador and Peru.
q-token: Quack AI (Q) is a project building a governance layer for the AI agent economy, where agents, users and apps interact under verifiable rules. It supports sign-to-pay, gasless payments across blockchains based on the x402 standard; Q is the ecosystem token.
qait: QAIT is the token of the SEALCOIN ecosystem, issued and governed by the QAIT Association, a Swiss non-profit. It serves as a settlement mechanism for machine-to-machine and AI agent transactions, letting connected devices, robots and autonomous agents exchange data and pay each other without intermediaries.
qanx: QANplatform is a hybrid blockchain designed to resist attacks from quantum computers. It lets developers write smart contracts in any programming language and deploy both public and private networks; QANX is the native token.
qbe: QBE Insurance is an Australian insurer from Sydney, founded in 1886. It insures businesses and individuals, covering property, liability and agriculture, in Australia, North America and Europe.
qbts: D-Wave Quantum is a quantum computing company with headquarters in Palo Alto, California, and Burnaby, Canada, founded in 1999. It was the first to sell commercial quantum computers; its annealing systems, offered through the Leap cloud, solve optimisation problems, and it also develops gate-model machines.
qcad: QCAD is a stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the Canadian dollar, issued by Stablecorp, a Toronto-based company. Each token is backed by Canadian dollar reserves, and it is used for payments and trading on blockchains such as Ethereum.
qcom: Qualcomm is a US chip designer from San Diego, founded in 1985. It makes Snapdragon processors and modems for smartphones, cars and PCs, and earns licensing fees on its patents for 3G, 4G and 5G wireless technology.
qi: BENQI is a DeFi protocol on Avalanche for lending and borrowing crypto, and it also offers sAVAX liquid staking for AVAX. Depositors earn interest from borrowers; QI is the governance token.
qia: Qiagen is a Dutch-German biotech company with its operational centre in Hilden near Düsseldorf, founded in 1984. It makes kits for extracting DNA and RNA from samples, molecular diagnostic tests such as the QuantiFERON tuberculosis test, and lab instruments.
qie: QIE Blockchain is an Ethereum-compatible layer-1 blockchain that positions itself as a digital identity layer for Web3. The network offers fast, cheap transactions, its own wallet and a decentralized exchange; QIE pays fees and validator staking.
qka: Qkacoin (QKA) is a meme coin dedicated to the quokka, the small smiling marsupial from islands off Western Australia such as Rottnest Island. The project rests on its community and the image of "the happiest animal in the world".
qkc: QuarkChain is a scalable sharded blockchain launched in 2018 by a team led by Qi Zhou. The network is split into many parallel shard chains for high throughput; QKC is its native coin.
qlys: Qualys is an American cybersecurity company from Foster City, California, founded in 1999. Its cloud platform helps businesses find their IT assets, scan them for vulnerabilities, check compliance and fix security weaknesses.
qnt: Quant is a London-based company founded by Gilbert Verdian whose Overledger technology connects different blockchains with each other and with banking systems. The QNT token is needed to access the platform and pay for licences for developers and businesses.
qone: qONE is a token from qLABS billed as the first quantum-safe token, launched on Hyperliquid's HyperEVM. It is tied to the qONE Security Protocol, which combines post-quantum NIST algorithms with zero-knowledge proofs, and the qVAULT asset vault.
qor: QoreChain (QOR) is the native coin of a quantum-safe, AI-native layer-1 blockchain built on the Cosmos SDK that runs EVM, CosmWasm and SVM smart contracts. Its mainnet launched in June 2026; it is run by a Swiss non-profit association.
qorpo: QORPO WORLD is a Web3 game studio that brings several games under one roof, including the competitive shooter Citizen Conflict and the creature-companion game AneeMate. QORPO is its shared token, used for staking, tournament prizes and community rewards across the games.
qqq: Invesco QQQ is an ETF that tracks the Nasdaq-100, the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq. Tech giants such as Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia and Amazon dominate it.
qqq-token: This is a Robinhood stock token that tracks Invesco QQQ, the ETF that follows the Nasdaq-100 index of the largest non-financial companies on Nasdaq. Robinhood launched such tokens in 2025 for customers in the European Union, letting them get US stock exposure on-chain around the clock.
qqqm: Invesco Nasdaq 100 (QQQM) tracks the same Nasdaq-100 index as QQQ but with a lower annual fee, aimed at long-term investors.
qrl: Quantum Resistant Ledger (QRL) is a blockchain launched in 2018 and secured by XMSS signatures that resist attacks from future quantum computers. Its core idea is to keep funds safe even once quantum machines can break today's usual cryptography.
qtc: Quantus (QTC) is the coin of Quantus Network, a proof-of-work Layer 1 blockchain built on Substrate and designed to resist attacks from future quantum computers. It uses NIST-approved post-quantum cryptography such as ML-DSA (Dilithium) signatures.
qtum: Qtum (QTUM) is a Singapore-based blockchain launched in 2017 that combines Bitcoin's UTXO transaction model with Ethereum-style smart contracts. It runs on proof of stake, so QTUM holders earn rewards for helping secure the network.
quai: Quai Network is a proof-of-work blockchain made of many connected chains (shards) that are merge-mined together, so it can scale to high transaction speeds. It uses a consensus called Proof-of-Entropy-Minima and has two tokens: QUAI and the Qi payment token.
quanta-computer: Quanta Computer is a Taiwanese company from Taoyuan, founded in 1988 by Barry Lam. It is one of the world's largest contract manufacturers of laptops for major brands and also builds servers for cloud and AI data centers.
qubic: Qubic (QUBIC) is a layer-1 blockchain founded by Sergey Ivancheglo, a co-founder of IOTA. It offers fee-free transactions and «useful» mining, where miners' computing power goes toward training artificial intelligence.
quest: Quest Holdings is a Greek group based in Athens. It distributes IT and consumer electronics including Apple products, provides IT services and systems integration through Unisystems, and owns ACS, one of Greece's largest courier companies.
quid: Squid is a cross-chain protocol that lets users swap and move tokens between more than a hundred blockchains in one click, without manual bridges. It aggregates liquidity from many DEXs and is built on the Axelar network; QUID is the project's token.
r: Ryder System is an American transportation and logistics company from Miami, founded in 1933. It leases and rents trucks to businesses, maintains fleets, provides dedicated drivers and runs warehouses and supply chains for other companies.
r2: R2 Protocol (R2) is a DeFi yield project on Ethereum and BNB Chain that pools stablecoin deposits, mainly USDC, into vaults investing in tokenized real-world assets such as private credit and US Treasury bills. R2 is paid as a reward to depositors and launched in 2025.
ra: Banregio is a Mexican bank from Monterrey, Nuevo León, founded in 1994. It lends mainly to small and medium-sized businesses and serves individuals, chiefly in northern Mexico, and also runs the digital bank Hey Banco.
raa: Rational is a German maker of professional cooking equipment based in Landsberg am Lech, founded in 1973. Its combi-steamers such as the iCombi and multifunction cookers are used in restaurant, hotel, canteen and fast-food kitchens worldwide.
raca: Radio Caca (RACA) started as a community memecoin and grew into a metaverse project known for the Metamon NFT game and the USM virtual world. RACA is used to buy NFTs, items and land within its ecosystem on BNB Chain and Ethereum.
race: Ferrari is the legendary Italian sports-car maker from Maranello, founded by Enzo Ferrari in 1947. It builds a limited number of expensive supercars and runs Scuderia Ferrari, the most successful team in Formula 1 history.
rad: Radworks is a community that develops Radicle, a decentralized peer-to-peer network for collaborating on code built on Git and an alternative to GitHub, and Drips, a way to fund open-source software. RAD is the governance token.
radl3: Raia Drogasil (RD Saúde) is Brazil's largest pharmacy chain, based in São Paulo and formed in 2011 by the merger of Droga Raia and Drogasil. It runs thousands of drugstores across the country and also sells medicines, beauty and health products online.
rageguy: Rage Guy (RAGEGUY) is a meme coin based on the famous angry "FFFUUU" face from the rage comics of the late 2000s internet. It has no product of its own: its value rests on community interest and trading.
ragr: Rusagro is one of Russia's largest agricultural holdings. It grows crops, produces sugar, pork, vegetable oils, mayonnaise and margarine, and owns farmland mainly in central and southern Russia and the Far East.
rai: Rai Reflex Index (RAI) is a stable asset backed by ETH, created by Reflexer Labs. Unlike typical stablecoins it is not pegged to the dollar: an automated controller nudges its redemption price to dampen volatility.
rail: Railgun (RAIL) is a smart contract system for private transactions on Ethereum and other networks that uses zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs). It lets users trade and lend on DeFi platforms while hiding their balances and wallet history; RAIL is the governance token.
rail3: Rumo is Brazil's largest railway operator, part of the Cosan group and based in Curitiba. It runs freight rail networks across Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná and other states, carrying grain, fertiliser, sugar and fuel from farm regions to ports such as Santos.
rain: Rain is a decentralised protocol for options and prediction markets on the Arbitrum network. Anyone can create a market on an event and trade it; public markets are settled by an AI oracle, while in private ones the creator decides the result.
ram-pt: Ramada Investimentos e Indústria is a Portuguese company based near Porto. Its main business, Ramada Aços, processes and sells special steels for moulds and tools, and it also owns forest land and other real estate that it leases out.
rand: Randstad is a Dutch staffing company based in Diemen and one of the world's largest, founded in 1960. It provides temporary workers, recruitment and HR services to businesses in Europe, North America and Asia.
rare: SuperRare is one of the first marketplaces for digital art as NFTs on Ethereum, launched in 2018. Artists sell unique works to collectors there, and the RARE token gives voting rights in the DAO and in running curated spaces.
rari: RARI is the governance token of Rarible, an NFT marketplace and toolkit launched in 2020 that lets creators mint and sell digital collectibles and lets other platforms build their own NFT stores. Holders vote in the Rarible DAO; the project also runs its own network, RARI Chain.
rasp: Raspadskaya is a Russian coking coal miner based in Mezhdurechensk in the Kemerovo region, part of the Evraz group's former coal business. It mines and enriches high-quality coking coal used by steelmakers.
rave: RaveDAO (RAVE) is a global community that combines music, technology and charity by organizing electronic music events, the first of which took place in Dubai in 2024. The RAVE token is used for tickets and community participation.
ray: Raydium is an automated market maker (AMM) and decentralized exchange on Solana, launched in 2021. It lets users swap tokens, provide liquidity and launch new projects, and many Solana meme coins trade in Raydium pools.
rba: RB Global, formerly Ritchie Bros., is a marketplace for used heavy equipment and vehicles, founded in Canada in 1958. Through Ritchie Bros. auctions, IAA and online platforms it sells construction machinery, trucks and damaged or used cars.
rbc: RBC Bearings is an American manufacturer from Oxford, Connecticut, founded in 1919. It makes precision bearings, gears and engineered components used in aircraft, defense systems, ships and industrial machinery.
rbc-token: Rubic (RBC) is the token of Rubic, a cross-chain swap aggregator that finds routes across many blockchains, DEXs and bridges so users can swap tokens between networks in one transaction.
rbi: Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) is an Austrian banking group based in Vienna. It serves corporate clients in Austria and runs retail and corporate banks across central and eastern Europe, from the Czech Republic and Slovakia to Romania and the Balkans.
rblx-etf: Roblox is a US online gaming platform from San Mateo, California, launched in 2006. Players — many of them children and teens — join millions of games and virtual worlds built by other users, and creators earn money through the in-game currency Robux.
rbnt: Redbelly Network (RBNT) is a formally verified blockchain developed at the University of Sydney together with CSIRO, Australia's national science agency. It is built for issuing and trading compliant tokenized real-world assets, with user identity checked at the transaction layer and personal data protected by zero-knowledge proofs.
rbrew: Royal Unibrew is a Danish brewer and soft-drink maker based in Faxe. Its brands include Faxe, Albani, Royal and Faxe Kondi in Denmark, Lapin Kulta in Finland and Ceres in Italy, and it bottles PepsiCo drinks in several Nordic and Baltic markets.
rbrk: Rubrik is a US cybersecurity company from Palo Alto, California, founded in 2014. Its platform backs up and protects business data across data centres, cloud services and software-as-a-service apps, and helps companies recover quickly after ransomware attacks.
rc: Rebel Cars is a car-racing game on the Elysium blockchain where cars, parts and tracks are NFTs that players can own and trade. RC is the in-game currency, earned by winning races and completing challenges and spent on cars, upgrades, premium events and marketplace trades.
rcl: Royal Caribbean Group is the world's second-largest cruise company, headquartered in Miami. It runs the Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises and Silversea brands and operates some of the largest passenger ships ever built.
rddt: Reddit is a US social platform based in San Francisco, founded in 2005 by Steve Huffman and Alexis Ohanian. It hosts thousands of topic communities called subreddits, where users post and vote on content, and earns money from advertising and licensing its data for AI.
rddt-token: Reddit • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of Reddit shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. It follows the price of the US-listed stock and can be traded around the clock on a blockchain.
rdnt: Radiant Capital (RDNT) is the token of Radiant, a cross-chain lending protocol launched in 2022 on Arbitrum and later BNB Chain, which uses LayerZero so users can deposit on one network and borrow on another.
rdor3: Rede D'Or São Luiz is Brazil's largest private hospital network, based in São Paulo. It runs dozens of hospitals and cancer centres across the country and, after merging with SulAmérica in 2022, also has a health insurance business.
re: Re (RE) is an online capital market for insurance that connects investors with fully collateralized reinsurance deals and brings them on-chain. Investors earn income from insurance premiums, which is only loosely linked to crypto market cycles.
rea: REA Group is an Australian online property company based in Melbourne and majority-owned by News Corp. It runs realestate.com.au, Australia's leading property listings website, and has property portals in India (Housing.com) and other Asian markets.
react: Reactive Network (REACT) is the token of Reactive Network, an EVM-compatible blockchain built around reactive smart contracts. These contracts watch events on other chains and automatically run actions in response, without a user sending a transaction.
ready: Ready Cards (READY) is a platform on Solana that turns collecting physical trading cards, such as Pokémon cards, into a digital experience. Users open digital packs of real graded cards with on-chain verifiable odds, keep cards in a vault, trade them on a marketplace or sell them back; READY is its token.
real: RealLink (REAL) is the token of a Web3 social-finance ecosystem that links content creation, social apps and crypto payments. It is connected to the video social app BuzzCast, the voice chat app Tada and the multi-chain payment gateway DPay.
recall: Recall (RECALL) is a decentralized network where AI agents compete in public, on-chain challenges such as trading, so their skills can be measured and ranked. The results build a verifiable reputation that helps people find agents worth trusting; RECALL is used for staking and rewards.
recruit: Recruit Holdings is a Tokyo-based Japanese company in the jobs and HR technology market. It owns the job sites Indeed and Glassdoor, and in Japan runs listings platforms, staffing agencies and booking services.
red: RedStone (RED) is a blockchain oracle that feeds asset prices into DeFi smart contracts. It specializes in yield-bearing assets such as liquid staking and restaking tokens that lending markets accept as collateral; RED is used for staking and security.
red-es: Redeia is a Spanish group based in Madrid that owns Red Eléctrica, the operator of Spain's national power grid and electricity system. It also owns the satellite operator Hispasat and fibre-optic networks; the Spanish state is its largest shareholder.
redo: Resistance Dog (REDO) is a community memecoin on the TON blockchain. It is inspired by the 'Resistance Dog', the dog image that became a symbol of Telegram users defending internet freedom; it has no function beyond trading and community.
reef: Reef (REEF) is the coin of Reef Chain, an EVM-compatible layer-1 blockchain built with Substrate, the Polkadot technology. It aims at fast, low-cost apps for DeFi, NFTs and games, and REEF pays fees and secures the network through staking.
reg: Regency Centers is a US real estate investment trust (REIT) from Jacksonville, Florida, founded in 1963. It owns and operates shopping centers anchored by grocery stores in affluent suburban neighborhoods across the US.
regn: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals is a US biotech company from Tarrytown, New York, founded in 1988. It develops antibody-based medicines; its best known are Eylea for eye diseases and Dupixent for eczema and asthma, sold with Sanofi.
rei: Rei (REI) is the token of 0xReisearch, a team of AI and crypto developers researching how to bring neural networks onto blockchains, mainly Ethereum-compatible (EVM) chains, and building AI agents on that work.
rekt: Rekt (REKT) is a meme token linked to Rekt Brands, a Web3 brand spanning art, media, NFTs and physical goods. Its best-known projects are Rekt Drinks, a flavoured sparkling water marketed as the «official drink of web3», and the Rektguy NFT collection launched in 2022.
rel: RELX is a British information and analytics company based in London, formerly Reed Elsevier. It publishes Elsevier scientific journals and the Scopus database, provides the LexisNexis legal database, risk analytics for banks and insurers, and runs trade exhibitions.
reliance: Reliance Industries is India's largest conglomerate, based in Mumbai, founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and led by Mukesh Ambani. It runs the world's largest oil refining complex in Jamnagar, the mobile operator Jio and the Reliance Retail chain.
ren: Ren is a project whose RenVM network let users move bitcoin and other coins onto Ethereum and other chains as wrapped tokens such as renBTC. Bought by Alameda Research in 2020, it wound down its original network after the FTX collapse in 2022; REN was used to stake darknodes that ran the system.
render: Render Network is a decentralized platform where owners of graphics cards rent out computing power for 3D rendering, visual effects and AI workloads. It grew out of Jules Urbach's company OTOY; RENDER is used to pay for GPU work.
rene: REN – Redes Energéticas Nacionais is a Portuguese utility based in Lisbon. It owns and operates Portugal's high-voltage electricity transmission grid and its natural gas transmission network, LNG terminal and storage, and also has gas networks in Chile.
renesas-electronics: Renesas Electronics is a Japanese semiconductor company headquartered in Tokyo, formed in 2010 from NEC's chip unit and the Hitachi–Mitsubishi venture Renesas Technology. It is one of the world's largest suppliers of microcontrollers for cars and industrial equipment and has bought Intersil, IDT and Dialog.
reni: Renaissance Insurance is a Russian insurance company based in Moscow, founded in 1997. It sells car, property, health and life insurance to individuals and businesses, largely through online and partner channels.
renk: Renk Group is a German maker of transmissions from Augsburg, founded in 1873. It builds gearboxes for tanks and armoured vehicles, including the Leopard 2, as well as gear units for ships and industrial machinery.
rent3: Localiza is Latin America's largest car rental company, based in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, and founded in 1973. It rents cars to people and businesses, manages corporate fleets and sells used vehicles; it merged with Unidas in 2022.
rep: Repsol is a Spanish energy company based in Madrid. It produces oil and gas in the Americas and other regions, runs refineries and a network of fuel stations in Spain, sells electricity and gas, and is expanding renewables and synthetic fuels.
reppo: REPPO is the token of REPPO.AI, a platform that combines AI training data with prediction markets. Creators publish AI-made work such as apps, videos or images, other users vote on its quality in weekly rounds, and both sides share token rewards.
req: Request (REQ) is a network for decentralized invoices and payments, launched in 2017. Companies and freelancers issue and pay invoices in crypto with a transparent record on the blockchain; REQ tokens are burned when the network is used.
resolv: Resolv is a DeFi protocol that issues USR, a dollar stablecoin backed by crypto such as ETH and kept stable with offsetting short futures positions (a delta-neutral strategy). RESOLV is the protocol's governance token.
rexr: Rexford Industrial Realty is an American real estate investment trust from Los Angeles. It owns and leases warehouses, distribution centres and other industrial properties exclusively in infill Southern California, one of the largest industrial markets in the US.
rez: Renzo (REZ) is a restaking protocol on Ethereum that works with EigenLayer: users receive the liquid token ezETH and earn extra yield for helping secure other networks. REZ is the governance token.
rf: Regions Financial is a US regional bank from Birmingham, Alabama. It serves individuals and businesses in the South and Midwest with accounts, loans, mortgages and wealth management.
rga: Reinsurance Group of America (RGA) is a US reinsurer from Chesterfield, Missouri, founded in 1973. It is one of the world's largest life and health reinsurers, taking on part of the mortality, longevity and health risks of insurance companies worldwide.
rgen: Repligen is an American life sciences company from Waltham, Massachusetts, founded in 1981. It makes filtration systems, chromatography products and other bioprocessing tools that drugmakers use to produce biologic medicines such as antibodies and gene therapies.
rgld: Royal Gold is an American precious metals royalty and streaming company from Denver, founded in 1981. Instead of running mines itself, it finances mining companies in exchange for a share of the gold, silver and copper their mines produce.
rgss: Rosgosstrakh is one of Russia's oldest and largest insurers, tracing its history to the state insurer Gosstrakh founded in 1921. It sells car, property, life and health insurance across Russia and is part of the VTB group.
rgti: Rigetti Computing is a US quantum computing company from Berkeley, California, founded in 2013 by Chad Rigetti. It designs and builds superconducting quantum chips and full quantum computers, which it offers through the cloud and sells to research labs and governments.
rh: RH, formerly Restoration Hardware, is an American luxury home furnishings retailer from Corte Madera, California, founded in 1979. It sells furniture, lighting, textiles and décor through large design galleries, catalogs and online, and runs restaurants inside its galleries.
rhb-bank: RHB Bank is one of Malaysia's largest financial groups, based in Kuala Lumpur. It offers retail and business banking, Islamic banking, investment banking, asset management and insurance, with branches across Southeast Asia including Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and Cambodia.
rhea: RHEA Finance is a DeFi platform in the NEAR ecosystem formed by merging the Ref Finance decentralized exchange with the Burrow lending protocol. It offers token swaps, lending and margin trading; RHEA is the governance token.
rhm: Rheinmetall is Germany's largest defense company, based in Düsseldorf and founded in 1889. It produces artillery and tank ammunition, military vehicles such as the Boxer, Lynx and the gun of the Leopard 2 tank, air-defense systems and digital military equipment, and is expanding ammunition plants across Europe.
ri: Pernod Ricard is the world's second-largest wine and spirits maker, based in Paris and formed in 1975 by the merger of Pernod and Ricard. Its brands include Absolut, Jameson, Chivas Regal, Havana Club, Martell, Malibu and Mumm champagne.
rice: Rice is the staple food of more than half of humanity. The Chicago exchange trades rough (unhusked) rice; prices depend on Asian harvests and export restrictions.
rice-token: Rice AI (RICE) is a decentralized AI project focused on robotics, aiming to train general-purpose AI for robots with data from a community network. It is backed by Rice Robotics, a Hong Kong company whose service robots are deployed in many countries.
richter: Gedeon Richter is a Hungarian pharmaceutical company based in Budapest, founded in 1901 by pharmacist Gedeon Richter. It develops and makes medicines for women's health, such as contraceptives, and for the central nervous system, including the antipsychotic cariprazine (Vraylar), and also produces biosimilars.
rif: RIF (Rootstock Infrastructure Framework) is the infrastructure token of Rootstock, a smart-contract network that runs alongside Bitcoin and is secured by its miners. RIF encourages DeFi app development on Rootstock and is used across ecosystem services.
rio: Rio Tinto is a British-Australian mining company founded in 1873 at the Río Tinto copper mines in Spain. It is one of the world's largest iron ore miners (Pilbara, Australia) and also produces copper, aluminium, lithium and diamonds.
rio-au: Rio Tinto is a British-Australian mining company founded in 1873 to work mines in Spain; these shares trade on the Sydney exchange. It mines iron ore in Australia as well as copper, aluminium and lithium.
rio-token: Realio Network is a platform for issuing and trading tokenized real-world assets such as real estate and private equity, built on its own proof-of-stake blockchain. RIO is the network's native token used for staking, fees and governance.
