svav: Sollers is a Russian carmaker, formerly known as Severstal-Avto. It owns the Ulyanovsk Automobile Plant, which builds UAZ off-road vehicles and vans, and produces Sollers-brand light trucks and commercial vehicles.
svcb: Sovcombank is one of Russia's largest private banks, headquartered in Moscow, with roots in a bank founded in 1990. It serves individuals and businesses with loans, deposits and leasing and is known for its Halva instalment card; it is under Western sanctions.
svl: Slash Vision Labs (SVL) is a crypto payments company on the Mantle Network. Its products are Slash Payment, which lets merchants accept many tokens on any network since 2022, and Slash Card, a crypto-backed credit card; protocol fees go to SVL stakers.
sw: Smurfit Westrock is one of the world's largest paper-based packaging makers, formed in 2024 by the merger of Ireland's Smurfit Kappa and America's WestRock, with headquarters in Dublin. It produces containerboard, corrugated boxes and consumer packaging across Europe and the Americas.
swap: TrustSwap is a crypto company that offers smart-contract tools for token projects, best known for Team Finance, a service for locking liquidity and team tokens so investors can see they cannot be sold early. SWAP is its utility token.
swarm: SWARM ENGINE (SWARM) is an AI tool for traders that watches the market and new token launches around the clock and rates them by signals. The SWARM token is used within the project's ecosystem.
swarms: Swarms (SWARMS) is a token on Solana linked to Swarms, an open-source framework created by Kye Gomez for building systems in which many AI agents cooperate on complex tasks. The token is tied to the project's community and ecosystem.
swch: SwissCheese (SWCH) is the native token of SwissCheese, a platform on Polygon for buying fractions of tokenized stocks of companies such as Apple, Netflix and Meta, paying with crypto. The aim is to make stock investing cheaper and easier to start.
swdy: Elsewedy Electric is an Egyptian industrial group based in Cairo that grew from a family business founded in 1938. It makes power cables, electrical products and meters and builds power plants, grids and other energy infrastructure in Africa, the Middle East and beyond.
swed-a: Swedbank is a Swedish bank headquartered in Stockholm, with roots in savings banks dating back to 1820. It serves millions of private and business customers in Sweden and is a leading bank in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.
swell: Swell is a liquid staking and restaking protocol for Ethereum: users deposit ETH and receive tokens such as swETH and rswETH that earn rewards while staying usable in DeFi. The project also runs Swellchain, its own layer-2; SWELL is the governance token.
swftc: SWFTCOIN (SWFTC) is the token of SWFT Blockchain, a service for fast cross-chain crypto swaps through the SWFT Wallet app and the SwftSwap service. It also powers the project's AI services, including the SWFTGPT assistant.
swk: Stanley Black & Decker is a US tool maker from New Britain, Connecticut, formed in 2010 when Stanley Works (founded 1843) merged with Black & Decker. It sells hand and power tools and outdoor equipment under brands such as DeWalt, Stanley, Craftsman and Black+Decker.
swks: Skyworks Solutions is a US maker of radio-frequency chips based in Irvine, California. Its amplifiers, filters and front-end modules handle wireless signals in smartphones, including the iPhone, as well as in Wi-Fi gear, cars and industrial devices.
swmr: Swarmer is an American company that develops software for autonomous drone swarms and AI systems. Its platforms let military users plan and coordinate many unmanned vehicles operating at the same time.
swx: Southwest Gas Holdings is an American natural gas utility company from Las Vegas, founded in 1931. Its Southwest Gas utility delivers natural gas to homes and businesses in Arizona, Nevada and parts of California.
sxp: Solar (SXP) is the coin of Solar Network, a community-run blockchain that uses delegated proof of stake. The project grew out of Swipe: SXP moved from Ethereum and BNB Chain to its own Solar mainnet, where holders vote for block producers.
sxt: Space and Time (SXT) is a blockchain database that gives smart contracts and AI verified data with a cryptographic proof that the query was correct (Proof of SQL). The project was backed by Microsoft's venture fund M12; SXT pays for queries and staking.
sy1: Symrise is a German maker of fragrances, flavors and cosmetic ingredients based in Holzminden, formed in 2003 from Haarmann & Reimer and Dragoco. It supplies scents and tastes to producers of perfumes, cosmetics, food, drinks and pet food.
syens: Syensqo is a Belgian specialty materials company based in Brussels, spun off from Solvay in 2023. It makes high-performance polymers, composites and specialty chemicals used in aircraft, cars, batteries, electronics, healthcare and consumer products.
syf: Synchrony Financial is a US consumer lender based in Stamford, Connecticut, spun off from General Electric. It issues store and co-branded credit cards for retailers such as Amazon and Lowe's and finances healthcare purchases.
syk: Stryker is a US medical technology company based in Portage, Michigan, founded in 1941 by orthopedic surgeon Homer Stryker. It makes joint replacements, Mako surgical robots, surgical instruments and hospital beds.
syl: myDid (SYL) is the token of XSL Labs, a French company behind myDid, a self-sovereign digital identity app that lets people store verified credentials and prove who they are without handing over all their data.
symm: SYMMIO is a settlement layer for intent-based, peer-to-peer derivatives trading: other apps plug into it to offer perpetual futures, with trades matched between users and liquidity providers. SYMM is its token for governance and incentives.
syn: Synapse is a cross-chain protocol that connects layer-1 and layer-2 blockchains. Through its bridges users move assets and messages between networks without middlemen, and the SYN token is used for protocol governance.
syna: Synaptics is an American semiconductor company from San Jose, California, founded in 1986. A pioneer of laptop touchpads, it now makes chips for touch, displays, audio, wireless connectivity and edge AI used in PCs, phones, cars and IoT devices.
synd: Syndicate (SYND) builds infrastructure for app-specific blockchains (appchains) in the Ethereum ecosystem, letting projects run their own chain with custom rules. SYND is the token of the Syndicate network.
syrup: Maple Finance (SYRUP) is an onchain lending platform that lends capital to institutional borrowers against collateral and offers depositors yield through syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT. The protocol was founded in Australia in 2019; SYRUP is its governance and staking token.
sys: Syscoin is a blockchain launched in 2014 that is merge-mined with bitcoin, so it shares bitcoin miners' security. On top it runs an Ethereum-compatible layer (NEVM) for smart contracts and supports rollups for cheaper transactions; SYS pays fees and rewards masternode operators.
syy: Sysco is the world's largest foodservice distributor, based in Houston, Texas, and founded in 1969. It delivers food, drinks, kitchen supplies and equipment to restaurants, hospitals, schools, hotels and other businesses that prepare meals away from home in the US and many other countries.
t: AT&T is one of the largest US telecom operators, headquartered in Dallas. It provides mobile service, home internet and fibre networks for consumers and businesses; its history goes back to the Bell Telephone Company founded in 1877.
t-ca: Telus is one of Canada's three largest telecom companies, headquartered in Vancouver. It provides mobile, home internet, TV and security services and also runs Telus Health, a digital health and employee wellness business.
t-ru: T-Technologies is a Russian financial group, the parent of T-Bank (formerly Tinkoff Bank), founded by Oleg Tinkov in 2006. The bank has no branches and serves millions of customers online.
t-token: Threshold Network (T) was formed in 2022 by merging the NuCypher and Keep networks. It develops threshold cryptography, and its best-known product is tBTC, a decentralized bitcoin token for use on Ethereum; T is used for node staking and governance.
t99: Tethereum (T99) is a decentralized finance token on BNB Chain. Despite the name, it is not related to Tether or to Ethereum: it is a separate project with its own community and apps.
ta: Trusta AI is an on-chain identity project that uses AI to tell real people apart from bots and AI agents. It is used to protect airdrops from Sybil attacks and to score wallet reputation; TA is the network's token.
tabak: Philip Morris ČR is the Czech arm of Philip Morris International, with a cigarette factory in Kutná Hora. It makes and sells tobacco products such as Marlboro and L&M and IQOS heated-tobacco products in the Czech Republic and Slovakia.
tabgd: TAB Gıda is a Turkish restaurant company based in Istanbul that runs fast-food chains under franchise. It operates Burger King in Turkey along with Popeyes, Sbarro and Arby's, and its own döner brand Usta Dönerci.
tac: TAC is a layer-1 network that lets developers bring Ethereum-compatible (EVM) apps to the TON blockchain and Telegram's users, who can use them from TON wallets without bridging. TAC is the network's native token for fees and staking.
taee11: Taesa (Transmissora Aliança de Energia Elétrica) is one of Brazil's largest private electricity transmission companies, based in Rio de Janeiro and controlled by Cemig and ISA Energia. It owns and operates thousands of kilometres of high-voltage lines across the country, earning regulated annual revenues; TAEE11 is a unit of its shares.
tag: TAGGER (TAG) is a decentralized data platform for AI where participants collect and label data for training models. The blockchain records authorship and rights to the data, and the platform lets it be sold as a commodity.
taiko: Taiko is a decentralized Ethereum layer-2 rollup that is fully Ethereum-equivalent (a Type-1 ZK-EVM), with block ordering handled by Ethereum's own validators. TAIKO is used for governance and securing the network.
take: OVERTAKE is a smart-contract platform for trading in-game assets that replaces risky peer-to-peer deals between players. It makes ownership of game items verifiable and safe to transfer; TAKE is the ecosystem token.
takeda: Takeda Pharmaceutical is Japan's largest drugmaker, founded in 1781 in Osaka. It develops medicines for gastroenterology, rare diseases, oncology and neuroscience as well as plasma-derived therapies, and acquired Ireland's Shire in 2019.
tao: Bittensor is a decentralised machine-learning network where participants compete to provide AI models and computing power in specialised 'subnets'. The best performers are rewarded in TAO, whose supply is capped at 21 million, like bitcoin's.
taobot: tao.bot (TAOBOT) is the token of an all-in-one Telegram bot for Bittensor, a trading and interaction terminal where users can trade TAO and Bittensor subnet tokens and manage their activity without leaving Telegram.
tap: Molson Coors Beverage Company is a North American brewer based in Chicago, with roots in Molson (founded in Montreal in 1786) and Coors (Colorado, 1873). Its beers include Coors Light, Miller Lite, Molson Canadian, Blue Moon, Carling and Staropramen.
tatapower: Tata Power is one of India's largest integrated power companies, founded in 1911 and part of the Tata Group, based in Mumbai. It generates electricity from coal, hydro, solar and wind, distributes power to millions of customers, makes solar panels and builds EV charging stations.
tatasteel: Tata Steel is an Indian steelmaker from Mumbai, founded in 1907 by Jamsetji Tata's group. One of the world's largest steel producers, it has plants in India (Jamshedpur), the Netherlands and the UK.
tatn: Tatneft is a Russian oil company based in Almetyevsk, Tatarstan, controlled by the republic's government. It produces oil in the Volga region, runs the TANECO refining complex and a chain of filling stations, and also makes tyres.
tatsu: Tatsu (TATSU) is the token of the Tatsu ecosystem, a decentralized AI services platform built on the Bittensor network. It offers tools such as image generation, text-to-speech and translation plus an API for developers, and TATSU is an Ethereum token used to pay for services, staking and governance.
tavhl: TAV Havalimanları is a Turkish airport operator from Istanbul, controlled by France's Groupe ADP. It runs airports in Turkey (Ankara, Izmir, Antalya) and in Georgia, Tunisia, North Macedonia, Saudi Arabia and other countries, plus duty-free and ground handling.
tbk: TronBank (TBK) is a DeFi protocol in the TRON ecosystem that helps users rent network energy and stake TRX to cut transaction fees. Its algorithms match energy supply and demand, and TBK is the protocol's token.
tcb: Techcombank is one of Vietnam's largest private banks, based in Hanoi and founded in 1993. It is known for its digital banking, lending to affluent customers and property developers, and its partnerships with Masan and Vingroup.
tcbi: Texas Capital Bancshares is an American bank holding company from Dallas, founded in 1998. Its Texas Capital Bank serves businesses and wealthy individuals in Texas with commercial lending, treasury services, investment banking and private wealth services.
tcell: Turkcell is Turkey's leading mobile operator, headquartered in Istanbul and founded in 1994. It provides mobile, home internet and TV services and builds digital products such as the BiP messenger and the Paycell fintech platform; it also operates in Northern Cyprus.
tcl: Transurban is an Australian company from Melbourne that builds and operates toll roads and tunnels. Its roads are in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane, as well as in North America.
tcom: TCOM Global (TCOM) is a BNB Chain project built around classic manga characters by Osamu Tezuka, such as Astro Boy, working with Tezuka Productions. It combines NFTs, games and AI content tools, and TCOM is used for payments, rewards and community votes.
tcom-etf: Trip.com Group is a Chinese online travel company from Shanghai, founded in 1999 as Ctrip. It sells flights, hotels, train tickets and tours through Ctrip and Qunar in China and Trip.com abroad, and also owns the flight search site Skyscanner.
tcs: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is India's largest IT services company, based in Mumbai and part of the Tata Group. Founded in 1968, it builds and runs software, cloud and consulting projects for banks, retailers and other large businesses around the world.
td: TD Bank (Toronto-Dominion Bank) is one of Canada's largest banks, based in Toronto and formed in 1955 by the merger of two banks. Besides Canada, it has a large branch network on the US East Coast under the TD Bank brand.
tdccp: TDCCP is a meme coin on Solana. Like most meme coins, it is not backed by a business or assets, and its price is driven mainly by community attention and trading.
tdg: TransDigm Group is a US maker of aircraft components based in Cleveland, Ohio. It buys and grows makers of highly specialised parts such as pumps, valves, sensors and seat belts for passenger and military aircraft.
tdk: TDK is a Japanese electronic-components maker from Tokyo, founded in 1935 to commercialise ferrite, a magnetic material. It makes capacitors, inductors, sensors, magnets and rechargeable batteries for phones, cars and industry; many people remember it for its cassette tapes.
tdrop: TDROP is the token of ThetaDrop, the NFT marketplace on the Theta blockchain known for digital collectibles from entertainment brands. Users earn TDROP for activity on the marketplace and use it for governance and rewards.
tdy: Teledyne Technologies is a US technology company based in Thousand Oaks, California. It makes FLIR thermal cameras, digital imaging sensors, scientific instruments, underwater drones and electronics for aerospace, space and defence.
tea: tea Protocol is a decentralized system for supporting open-source software: developers of open-source packages are rewarded according to how important their code is, and participants help check the security of the software supply chain. It was founded by Max Howell, creator of Homebrew.
team: Atlassian is an Australian software company founded in Sydney in 2002. It makes teamwork tools: the Jira issue and project tracker, the Confluence wiki and the Trello task boards.
tech: Bio-Techne is a US life sciences company based in Minneapolis. It makes reagents, antibodies, proteins and instruments for scientific research and drug development, plus diagnostic tests, including a urine test for early prostate cancer detection.
techm: Tech Mahindra is an Indian IT services and consulting company based in Pune, part of the Mahindra Group, founded in 1986. It provides software development, telecom network services, consulting and business process outsourcing to clients worldwide.
techtronic-industries: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a Hong Kong-based maker of power tools and outdoor equipment, founded in 1985. Its best-known brands are Milwaukee for professional tradespeople, Ryobi for home users and AEG, and most of its sales come from North America, often through The Home Depot.
teco2: Telecom Argentina is one of Argentina's largest telecommunications and media companies, based in Buenos Aires. It offers mobile service under the Personal brand, internet and cable TV under Flow, and fixed-line and business services; in 2025 it bought Telefónica's Argentine operator Movistar.
tef: Telefónica is Spain's largest telecom operator, based in Madrid and founded in 1924. Under the Movistar, O2 and Vivo brands it provides mobile, broadband and TV services in Spain, Germany, Brazil and the UK, where it co-owns Virgin Media O2.
tel: TE Connectivity is a maker of connectors and sensors registered in Ireland with its main base in Switzerland, spun off from Tyco in 2007. Its components are used in cars, industrial equipment, data centres and medical devices.
tel-no: Telenor is a Norwegian telecom group based at Fornebu near Oslo. It provides mobile, broadband and TV services in the Nordic countries and Asia, including Grameenphone in Bangladesh. Its roots go back to the state telegraph founded in 1855, and the Norwegian state is the largest owner.
tel2-b: Tele2 is a Swedish telecom operator based in Stockholm, founded in 1993 within Jan Stenbeck's Kinnevik group. It provides mobile, broadband and TV services to consumers and businesses in Sweden and the Baltic countries.
telekom-malaysia: Telekom Malaysia (TM) is Malaysia's national fixed-line and broadband company, based in Kuala Lumpur. It sells home fibre internet and mobile plans under the Unifi brand, provides network, cloud and data-centre services to businesses and government, and runs wholesale networks and submarine cables.
telia: Telia Company is a Swedish telecom operator based in Stockholm, formed in 2002 by the merger of Sweden's Telia and Finland's Sonera. It provides mobile, broadband, TV and business network services in the Nordic and Baltic countries.
tem: Tempus AI is a US health-technology company from Chicago, founded in 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, a co-founder of Groupon. It runs genomic and other lab tests and combines them with a large library of clinical data and AI tools to help doctors personalise treatment, especially for cancer.
ten: Tenaris is a global maker of steel pipes for the oil and gas industry and part of the Techint group of the Italian-Argentine Rocca family. Its plants in the Americas, Europe and Asia produce seamless and welded casing and tubing for wells and pipelines.
tenaga-nasional: Tenaga Nasional (TNB) is Malaysia's national electricity utility, based in Kuala Lumpur. It generates, transmits and distributes power across Peninsular Malaysia and Sabah, runs the national grid, and is investing in solar and other renewable energy at home and abroad.
tenb: Tenable is a US cybersecurity company from Columbia, Maryland, founded in 2002 and known for Nessus, one of the most widely used vulnerability scanners. Its exposure-management platform helps organisations find weak spots across IT systems, cloud, factories and user accounts before attackers do.
tencent: Tencent is a Chinese tech giant based in Shenzhen, founded in 1998 by Ma Huateng (Pony Ma). It owns the super-app WeChat and the WeChat Pay payment service, is the world's largest gaming company (Honor of Kings, stakes in Riot Games and Supercell) and runs cloud services.
ter: Teradyne is an American company based in North Reading, Massachusetts, founded in 1960. Its main business is automatic test equipment that chipmakers use to check semiconductors, including AI and smartphone chips, before they ship; it also makes collaborative robots through Universal Robots and mobile robots through MiR.
terumo: Terumo is a Japanese medical-device maker based in Tokyo, founded in 1921 to produce clinical thermometers. Today it makes catheters and other tools for heart and blood-vessel treatment, syringes and infusion systems, and blood-collection and blood-management equipment sold worldwide.
tet: Tectum (TET) is the coin of the Tectum blockchain, a high-speed Layer 1 network. Its best-known product is SoftNote, a system for instant, fee-free Bitcoin payments using digital banknotes.
teva: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries is an Israeli drug maker headquartered in Tel Aviv and one of the world's largest producers of generic medicines. Founded in 1901, it also sells branded drugs such as Austedo for movement disorders and Ajovy for migraine.
tex: Terex is an American industrial equipment maker from Norwalk, Connecticut, founded in 1933. It builds Genie aerial work platforms, materials processing machines such as crushers and screens, and refuse trucks and other environmental equipment.
tfc: Truist Financial is one of the largest US banks, headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, and formed in 2019 by merging BB&T and SunTrust. It serves individuals and businesses mainly in the southeastern US.
tfuel: Theta Fuel (TFUEL) is the operational token of the Theta network, used to pay for blockchain operations and to reward participants for relaying video streams and running computations on edge nodes. It works alongside THETA, which handles governance and security.
tgbp: Tokenised GBP (tGBP) is a stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the British pound and issued by a UK firm registered with the FCA. It is backed by cash and short-term UK Treasury bills and is used for on-chain payments in sterling.
tgc: TG.Casino is an online crypto casino that can also be played through Telegram. Its TGC token is tied to the platform through buy-backs: part of the casino's profits is used to buy TGC on the market.
tgka: TGK-1 is the main power and heat producer in north-western Russia, part of Gazprom Energoholding. It runs combined heat and power plants in St Petersburg and hydroelectric plants in Karelia and the Murmansk region.
tgkb: TGK-2 is a Russian power and heat generating company based in Yaroslavl. It runs combined heat and power plants that supply electricity and district heating to cities in the Yaroslavl, Kostroma, Vologda, Arkhangelsk and Novgorod regions.
tgs: TGS is a Norwegian geoscience data company based in Oslo that merged with PGS in 2024. It collects and processes seismic and other subsurface data and licenses its large multi-client data library to oil and gas companies exploring for resources, and also provides data for offshore wind projects.
tgsu2: Transportadora de Gas del Sur (TGS) is Argentina's largest natural gas transporter, based in Buenos Aires. Its pipeline network carries most of the gas consumed in the country from southern fields to Buenos Aires; it also processes gas into liquids at its Cerri complex and builds pipelines in Vaca Muerta.
tgt: Target is one of the largest US general-merchandise retailers, based in Minneapolis and founded in 1902. It sells clothing, home goods, groceries and electronics in its bullseye-logo stores and online.
that: THAT is a crypto payment project for everyday purchases. It pairs a non-custodial wallet with a directory of participating businesses, so users can pay for goods and services on-chain in seconds and send money peer-to-peer without banks or card networks.
thc: Tenet Healthcare is a Dallas-based US hospital operator. It runs acute-care hospitals and, through its USPI unit, one of the largest networks of ambulatory surgery centers in the country, plus revenue-cycle services through Conifer.
the: Thena is a decentralized exchange and liquidity hub on BNB Chain, launched in 2023 with a ve(3,3) model: holders lock THE to vote on which pools receive rewards and earn a share of trading fees.
theros: THEROS is a Solana meme token launched in November 2025 around a gamified entertainment and learning platform about trading concepts. Its main feature is the on-chain Daily 4(X) Challenge; the supply is fixed and the mint authority was permanently revoked at launch.
theta: Theta Network is a blockchain for decentralized video delivery, media and AI computing. Participants share their computers' bandwidth and processing power and earn rewards; THETA is used for governance and staking, while a separate token, TFUEL, pays for operations.
thg: The Hanover Insurance Group is a US property and casualty insurer from Worcester, Massachusetts, founded in 1852. It sells car, home and business insurance mainly through independent agents.
tho: Thor Industries is the world's largest maker of recreational vehicles, based in Elkhart, Indiana. Its brands include Airstream, Jayco, Keystone, Heartland and, in Europe, Erwin Hymer Group motorhomes and caravans.
thq: Theoriq (THQ) is the token of Theoriq, a protocol for AI agents that work together in groups to research and run decentralized finance (DeFi) strategies. THQ is used for staking and governance in the network.
thyao: Turkish Airlines (Türk Hava Yolları) is Turkey's national airline, founded in 1933, with its hub at Istanbul Airport. It flies to more countries than any other airline in the world, carries both passengers and freight (Turkish Cargo) and is a member of Star Alliance.
tia: Celestia is a modular blockchain specializing in data availability: other networks publish their transaction data on it instead of storing everything themselves. This makes launching new blockchains and rollups easier; TIA pays for data and is used for staking.
tieto: Tietoevry is a Nordic IT services and software company based in Espoo, Finland, formed by the 2019 merger of Tieto and Norway's EVRY. It builds software for banks, healthcare and the public sector and runs cloud and IT services.
tig: The Innovation Game (TIG) is a protocol that rewards people for creating and improving algorithms that solve hard computational challenges. Its proof-of-work style system pays TIG tokens to the best solutions and their inventors.
tims3: TIM Brasil is one of Brazil's largest mobile operators, based in Rio de Janeiro and controlled by Italy's Telecom Italia (TIM). It provides 4G and 5G mobile services and fibre home internet under the TIM UltraFibra brand.
tina: TINA is a Geo-DePIN project that collects and verifies real-world map and mobility data. Participants share road and point-of-interest information through a mobile app and dashcam devices while driving, and can earn TINA tokens for their contributions.
tit: Telecom Italia (TIM) is Italy's largest telecom operator, a former state company based in Rome. Under the TIM brand it provides mobile and home internet in Italy and owns the mobile operator TIM Brasil; in 2024 it sold its fixed-line network to the fund KKR.
titan: Titan Company is an Indian watch and jewelry maker from Bengaluru, a joint venture of the Tata Group. It owns the Tanishq jewelry chain, the Titan and Fastrack watch brands and Titan Eye+ optical stores.
titc: Titan Cement International is a cement and building materials group founded in Greece in 1902 and now based in Brussels. It produces cement, ready-mix concrete and aggregates in Greece, the United States, south-eastern Europe, Egypt and Turkey.
titn: THORWallet (TITN) is the token of THORWallet, a Swiss self-custody crypto wallet that lets users swap coins across different blockchains. TITN replaced the older TGT token in 2025, and staking it on Base gives a share of swap fees paid in USDC plus lower fees.
tjx: TJX Companies is the world's largest off-price retailer of clothing and home goods, headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts. It runs the T.J. Maxx, Marshalls and HomeGoods chains in the US and TK Maxx in Europe and Australia.
tka: thyssenkrupp is a German industrial group based in Essen, formed in 1999 by the merger of Thyssen and Krupp. Its businesses include steel, materials trading, automotive technology, hydrogen electrolysers and marine systems such as submarines.
tko: TKO Group Holdings is an American sports entertainment company formed in 2023 by merging UFC and WWE under Endeavor's control. It runs UFC mixed martial arts fights and WWE wrestling shows and sells their broadcast rights.
tko-token: Tokocrypto is a cryptocurrency exchange in Indonesia, founded in 2018 and acquired by Binance in 2022. TKO is its utility token, giving users fee discounts and access to platform features.
tkr: Timken is a US engineering company from North Canton, Ohio, founded in 1899 by Henry Timken, inventor of a tapered roller bearing. It makes bearings and power-transmission products such as gearboxes, belts and couplings for industry.
tlevisacpo: Grupo Televisa is a Mexican media and telecom company based in Mexico City. It runs the izzi cable and broadband network and Sky México satellite TV, and owns a large stake in TelevisaUnivision, the biggest Spanish-language media company.
tlkm: Telkom Indonesia is Indonesia's state-controlled telecom company, based in Bandung. Through its subsidiary Telkomsel it runs the country's largest mobile network, and it also provides home internet (IndiHome), data centers and digital services.
tlm: Alien Worlds is a blockchain game and NFT metaverse where players "mine" the in-game token Trilium (TLM) on virtual planets and vote on how they develop. It runs on WAX, Ethereum and BNB Chain and launched on Binance Launchpad.
tln: Talen Energy is an independent power producer from Houston, Texas. It owns power plants in the US, most notably the Susquehanna nuclear plant in Pennsylvania, and sells electricity both to the grid and directly to data centers.
tlos: Telos (TLOS) is a layer-1 blockchain launched in 2018, originally built on EOSIO technology and later extended with an Ethereum-compatible virtual machine. It offers fast, low-cost transactions; TLOS pays fees and is used for staking and governance.
tls: Telstra is Australia's largest telecommunications company, based in Melbourne. Formerly the state-owned Telecom Australia, it was privatized in stages from 1997 and now provides mobile, home internet and phone services, enterprise networks and international connectivity, running the country's biggest mobile network.
tlt: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond (TLT) holds long-term US government bonds maturing in more than 20 years. Its price reacts strongly to changes in interest rates.
tlx: Talanx is a German insurance group based in Hanover that sells property, casualty and life insurance under brands such as HDI and owns a majority stake in the reinsurer Hannover Re.
tmgh: Talaat Moustafa Group is Egypt's largest real estate developer, based in Cairo. It built the large planned cities of Al Rehab and Madinaty near Cairo, develops new communities such as Noor City and owns luxury hotels, including Four Seasons properties in Egypt.
tmo: Thermo Fisher Scientific is the world's largest supplier of equipment and services for science, headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It sells lab instruments, reagents and consumables and manufactures medicines under contract for drug companies.
tmus: T-Mobile US is an American mobile carrier based in Bellevue, Washington, controlled by Deutsche Telekom. After merging with Sprint in 2020 it became one of the largest US wireless operators and a leader in 5G coverage.
tmx: TermMax (TMX) is the governance and utility token of TermMax, a DeFi protocol for fixed-rate, fixed-term borrowing and lending and leveraged yield on several EVM chains, including Ethereum and BNB Chain. It was launched in 2025 by Term Structure Labs.
tnk: Trac Network (TNK) is a peer-to-peer, "local-first" Layer 1 network from the Bitcoin ecosystem, built by the Trac Systems team for business and consumer apps. TNK is its native token; it previously traded under the ticker TRAC before the rename.
tnl: Travel + Leisure Co. is a vacation ownership (timeshare) company from Orlando, Florida. It runs Club Wyndham and WorldMark resorts, the RCI vacation exchange network and the Travel + Leisure travel club.
tnse: TNS energo is a Russian group of regional electricity retailers. Its companies act as suppliers of last resort in several regions, selling electricity to households and businesses and handling their billing.
tnsr: Tensor is an NFT marketplace on Solana for professional traders, offering advanced trading tools, limit orders and bulk buying of collections. The team also developed a low-cost NFT standard on Solana; TNSR is the protocol's governance token.
toaso: Tofaş is a Turkish carmaker from Bursa, a joint venture of Koç Holding and Stellantis founded in 1968. It builds passenger cars and light commercial vans, including the Fiat Egea and Doblò, for Turkey and for export to Europe.
token: TokenFi (TOKEN) is a tokenization platform launched by the team behind Floki. It lets anyone create crypto tokens without coding and aims to bring real-world assets on-chain; TOKEN runs on Ethereum and BNB Chain and is used for fees and staking.
tokio-marine: Tokio Marine Holdings is Japan's oldest and one of its largest insurance groups, founded in 1879. It offers property, auto and life insurance in Japan and abroad, including the US through Philadelphia Insurance and HCC.
tokyo-electric-power: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings (TEPCO) is Japan's largest electric utility, supplying power to Tokyo and the surrounding Kanto region. It operated the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear plant hit by the 2011 disaster and has been largely controlled by the Japanese state since then.
tokyo-electron: Tokyo Electron is a Japanese maker of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, founded in Tokyo in 1963. It supplies tools for photoresist coating, etching, deposition and wafer cleaning to chipmakers such as TSMC, Samsung and Intel.
tol: Toll Brothers is a US luxury homebuilder from Fort Washington, Pennsylvania, founded in 1967 by brothers Robert and Bruce Toll. It builds upscale single-family homes, townhouses and rental apartments in more than 20 states.
tolly: Tolly (TOLLY) is the fee-sharing token of Tolly, a token launchpad and trading interface on Circle's Arc network where users create fixed-supply tokens paired with USDC. Trading fees fund TOLLY buybacks and burns; the project is not affiliated with Circle.
tom: Tomra is a Norwegian company based in Asker near Oslo, founded in 1972, best known for inventing the reverse vending machine that takes back empty bottles and cans for recycling. It also makes sensor-based sorting machines for recycling plants, mining and food processing.
tom2: TomTom is a Dutch location technology company from Amsterdam, founded in 1991. Once famous for car sat-navs, it now supplies digital maps, navigation software and traffic data to carmakers, app developers and businesses.
ton: Toncoin (TON) is the native coin of The Open Network blockchain, originally developed by the Telegram team led by the Durov brothers. The network is now deeply integrated into Telegram: a wallet, mini apps and payments inside the messenger.
tonic: Tectonic (TONIC) is the token of Tectonic, a decentralized lending and borrowing protocol on the Cronos blockchain. Users supply crypto to earn interest or borrow against collateral, and TONIC is used for rewards, staking and governance.
top: TOP AI Network (TOP) is a layer-1 blockchain, formerly TOP Network, that rebranded in 2024 to focus on decentralized AI. It lets developers deploy and host AI models without buying costly hardware, and TOP is the network's native token.
torch: TORCH is the token of Torch, a multi-chain trading and token-launch platform built on Robinhood Chain. It combines a fair-launch launchpad, a web trading terminal and a Telegram bot with one non-custodial wallet, and every trade on Torch buys back and burns the traded token.
torn: Tornado Cash is a decentralized privacy protocol on Ethereum that breaks the link between the sender's and recipient's wallets using zero-knowledge proofs. The US sanctioned it in 2022, and the sanctions were later lifted; TORN is the governance token.
toshi: Toshi (TOSHI) is a meme token on the Base network, named after the cat of Coinbase co-founder Brian Armstrong. The coin has become one of the symbols of Base's meme culture; it has no separate product and is driven by its community.
tost: Toast is a Boston-based restaurant software company founded in 2011. It sells an all-in-one cloud platform for restaurants: point-of-sale terminals, payments, online ordering, delivery, payroll and kitchen tools.
tots3: Totvs is Brazil's largest business software company, based in São Paulo and founded in 1983. It sells ERP systems and other management software — for accounting, payroll, retail, manufacturing and agribusiness — mainly to small and mid-sized Brazilian companies, plus business-performance and fintech services.
tower: TOWER is the in-game token of Crazy Defense Heroes, a mobile tower-defense game by Animoca Brands, and of its related games. Players can earn TOWER through play-to-earn events, and it is also used for game items and NFTs; the token launched in 2021.
towns: Towns (TOWNS) is the token of Towns Protocol, a platform for decentralized, programmable group chats called spaces. Communities own their spaces on-chain, can add bots and memberships, and TOWNS is used for staking, rewards and governance.
toyota: Toyota Motor is a Japanese carmaker based in Toyota City and one of the largest in the world, founded in 1937. It builds Toyota and Lexus cars and Hino trucks and is known for its «just-in-time» production system and the Prius hybrid.
tpe: Tauron is one of Poland's largest energy groups, based in Katowice. It distributes and sells electricity to millions of customers in southern Poland and runs coal, wind and solar power plants.
tpeir: Piraeus Bank is one of Greece's largest banks, headquartered in Athens and founded in 1916. It serves millions of retail and business customers with accounts, loans, cards, asset management and insurance.
tpia: Chandra Asri Pacific is Indonesia's largest petrochemical company, part of the Barito Pacific group, with its main complex in Cilegon, Banten. It produces ethylene, propylene, polyethylene and polypropylene for plastics and is developing energy and port infrastructure.
tpl: Texas Pacific Land is one of the largest private landowners in Texas, based in Dallas. It grew out of an 1888 trust created in a railroad bankruptcy and earns money from oil and gas royalties, land leases and water sales in the Permian Basin.
tpr: Tapestry is a US fashion brand holding company from New York. It owns Coach, the leather bag brand founded in 1941, as well as Kate Spade.
tpt: TokenPocket Token (TPT) is the token of TokenPocket, a multi-chain self-custody crypto wallet founded in 2018 and available on mobile, desktop and as a browser extension. TPT is used for rewards, fee discounts and community programmes in the wallet's ecosystem.
tptu: TPTU is a utility token of the Ultima ecosystem, built on the SMART Blockchain. It serves as an entry point to the ecosystem's tools, such as automated trading bots and staking.
tra: Trabzonspor Fan Token (TRA) is the official fan token of Trabzonspor, the football club from the Turkish Black Sea city of Trabzon. Fans who hold it can vote in club polls, join contests and get rewards and perks linked to the team.
trac: OriginTrail (TRAC) is a project from Slovenia building a decentralized knowledge graph for artificial intelligence and supply chains. It helps verify where data and goods come from, and TRAC is used to pay for publishing and storing data on the network.
trade: Polytrade (TRADE) is the token of Polytrade, a marketplace for tokenized real-world assets that started in trade finance. Businesses' invoices and other assets are turned into on-chain investments, and TRADE is used for staking and rewards.
tradoor: Tradoor is a decentralized derivatives exchange that uses its own NDMM market-making model, designed with risk controls to protect traders, liquidity providers and the protocol from sudden market moves. TRADOOR is the platform's token.
tran: Transener is Argentina's main high-voltage electricity transmission company, based in Buenos Aires and created in 1993 during the privatisation of the power sector. It operates and maintains most of the country's 500 kV national grid that carries power from plants to distribution networks.
traton: Traton is the commercial vehicle arm of the Volkswagen Group, based in Munich. It builds trucks and buses under the Scania, MAN, International and Volkswagen Truck & Bus brands, selling them around the world.
trb: Tellor (TRB) is a decentralized oracle that delivers outside data, such as prices, to smart contracts on Ethereum and other networks. Data is submitted by participants who stake TRB, and they can lose their stake for reporting false information.
tre: Técnicas Reunidas is a Spanish engineering and construction company based in Madrid. It designs and builds oil refineries, petrochemical plants, gas processing and low-carbon facilities such as hydrogen and carbon-capture plants, largely for clients in the Middle East.
tread: Tread.fi is an algorithmic trade-execution platform for crypto traders that lets them trade on many centralized and decentralized exchanges from a single interface. TREAD is the ecosystem's token.
treat: Shiba Inu Treat (TREAT) is a governance and utility token of the Shiba Inu ecosystem, alongside SHIB, BONE and LEASH, launched in January 2025. It is an Ethereum token used on Shibarium for voting on proposals, yield farming, SHIB Pay payments and community rewards.
tree: Tree (TREE) is the utility token of Tree News, a fast crypto news service for traders. Holding the token unlocks a subscription tier with all the perks that were previously reserved for TreeNFT holders.
trent: Trent is an Indian fashion retailer from Mumbai and part of the Tata group. It runs the Westside and Zudio store chains and Star grocery stores, and operates Zara stores in India in a joint venture with Inditex.
trex: Trex is a US maker of composite decking from Winchester, Virginia. Its boards, railings and outdoor products are made largely from recycled plastic film and reclaimed wood, as a low-maintenance alternative to timber decks.
trgp: Targa Resources is a US energy infrastructure company based in Houston. It gathers and processes natural gas, fractionates natural gas liquids and runs pipelines and export terminals for liquefied petroleum gas.
tri: Thomson Reuters is a Canadian information company from Toronto, formed in 2008 by the merger of Thomson and Reuters. It provides lawyers, accountants and tax professionals with professional databases and software (Westlaw, Checkpoint) and owns the Reuters news agency.
tri-etf: Thomson Reuters is a Canadian information company from Toronto, formed in 2008 by the merger of Thomson and Reuters. It provides lawyers, accountants and tax professionals with professional databases and software (Westlaw, Checkpoint) and owns the Reuters news agency.
tria: Tria (TRIA) is a self-custodial crypto neobank: one account combines a Visa card, swaps, perpetual futures and earn vaults across many blockchains, with its BestPath engine routing each action so users never bridge or switch networks by hand.
tribe: TRIBE is the governance token of Tribe DAO, which ran Fei Protocol, issuer of the FEI stablecoin, and after a 2021 merger also Rari Capital. Holders voted on upgrades and the DAO treasury; the DAO wound down its protocols in 2022.
trmb: Trimble is a US technology company from Westminster, Colorado, founded in 1978. It makes high-precision GPS equipment and software for construction, surveying, farming and transport logistics, connecting field work with office planning.
trmk: TMK is a Russian steel pipe maker based in Moscow and one of the world's largest producers of pipes for the oil and gas industry. It makes seamless and welded pipes, drilling pipes and premium threaded connections at plants across Russia.
trn: Terna is the operator of Italy's national high-voltage power grid, based in Rome. It owns most of the country's transmission lines, balances electricity supply and demand across Italy, and builds new interconnections, including undersea cables.
trnfp: Transneft is a Russian state-controlled company that operates the world's largest network of trunk oil pipelines. It carries most of the oil produced in Russia, including through the Druzhba and ESPO (East Siberia–Pacific Ocean) pipelines, and also runs oil-product pipelines and ports.
troll: TROLL is a Solana meme coin inspired by internet trolling culture and the famous Trollface meme. It was created for fun and community and has no utility or intrinsic value of its own.
trow: T. Rowe Price is a US investment management firm from Baltimore, founded in 1937. It runs mutual funds, retirement plans and portfolios for individuals and institutions and is known for active, growth-focused management.
trp: TC Energy is a Canadian energy company based in Calgary that operates one of North America's largest natural gas pipeline networks. It also owns power plants, including a stake in the Bruce nuclear station in Ontario.
tru: TransUnion is one of the three major US credit bureaus, based in Chicago. It collects credit data on consumers and businesses in more than 30 countries and sells credit reports, scores, fraud prevention and marketing data.
tru-token: TrueFi (TRU) is a DeFi lending protocol on Ethereum that offers loans to institutions without traditional crypto collateral, relying on credit assessment instead. It was launched in 2020 by the team behind the TrueUSD stablecoin, and TRU is used for staking and governance.
true: True Corporation is a Thai telecom company from Bangkok that merged with operator dtac in 2023. It is Thailand's largest mobile operator by subscribers and also offers home internet and TrueVisions pay TV; its key shareholders are the CP Group and Telenor.
true-token: True is a decentralized prediction market on the Base blockchain. Users buy and sell shares in the outcomes of real-world events in politics, sports, tech and finance, prices reflect the crowd's odds, funds stay in users' own wallets and oracles settle the results.
truf: TRUF.Network (TRUF), formerly Truflation, is a decentralized data network for economic and financial indexes. It publishes on-chain data such as real-time inflation measures that apps and smart contracts can use; TRUF pays for data and secures the network.
trump: Official Trump (TRUMP) is a meme coin on Solana, launched in January 2025 on the eve of Donald Trump's inauguration and tied to his brand. The token gives no rights to any company or income — it is purely a meme and collectible asset.
trunk: TRUNK is the stablecoin of Elephant Money, a DeFi project on BNB Chain. It aims to stay near one US dollar and is supported by the project's treasury, which holds its other token, ELEPHANT, and other assets.
trust: Intuition is a layer-2 network for trusted data: users create and vouch for claims about people, projects and things, forming an open, token-curated 'trust graph'. AI and recommendation services can use this data; TRUST is the network's token.
truth: Swarm Network (TRUTH) is a decentralized protocol in which swarms of AI agents, together with people, check facts and data and record the results of the checks on the blockchain. The TRUTH token is used for payments, staking and rewards for network participants.
trv: The Travelers Companies is one of the largest US insurers, with roots going back to 1864 and headquarters in New York. It insures business property and liability as well as cars and homes; its symbol is a red umbrella.
trx: TRON is a blockchain founded by Justin Sun in 2017. It is popular for sending stablecoins, above all USDT, thanks to low fees; TRX pays for network resources and is used for staking.
tryg: Tryg is one of Scandinavia's largest non-life insurers, based in Ballerup near Copenhagen and majority-owned by the members' association TryghedsGruppen. It sells car, home, accident, health and business insurance in Denmark, Norway and Sweden under brands such as Tryg and Trygg-Hansa.
tsc: TensorCash (TSC) is a proof-of-work Layer 1 blockchain forked from Bitcoin Core in which mining means running AI inference instead of hashing. Miners answer prompts with registered open-source language models, and each answer comes with a proof that nodes can verify.
tsco: Tractor Supply is the largest rural lifestyle retail chain in the US, headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee, and founded in 1938. It sells animal feed, farm and ranch supplies, tools, clothing and equipment for farmers, homeowners and pet owners.
tsco-gb: Tesco is the UK's largest supermarket chain, founded in 1919 by Jack Cohen in London. It runs thousands of stores in Britain, Ireland and Central Europe, online grocery delivery, Tesco Bank and the Clubcard loyalty scheme.
tsem: Tower Semiconductor is an Israeli chip foundry based in Migdal HaEmek. It manufactures analog and specialty chips designed by other companies, such as radio-frequency, power-management, image-sensor and silicon-photonics chips, in its fabs in Israel, the United States and Japan.
tskb: TSKB (Industrial Development Bank of Turkey) is a privately owned development and investment bank founded in 1950 and part of the İşbank group. It provides long-term loans to industry and finances renewable energy and infrastructure projects in Turkey.
tsla: Tesla is an American electric car maker based in Austin, Texas, led by Elon Musk. It builds the Model 3, Model Y, Cybertruck and other cars, Powerwall and Megapack batteries for homes and the grid, and develops self-driving, robotaxis and the Optimus humanoid robot.
tsla-token: Tesla • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of Tesla shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. The token follows the price of the US-listed stock and lets people trade Tesla exposure around the clock on a blockchain.
tsm: TSMC (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing) is the world's largest contract chipmaker, based in Hsinchu, Taiwan, and founded in 1987 by Morris Chang. It makes processors to order for Apple, Nvidia, AMD and other companies on the most advanced production processes.
tsm-token: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of TSMC shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. It follows the price of the US-listed stock and can be traded around the clock on a blockchain.
tsmc: TSMC (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company) is a Taiwanese contract chipmaker from Hsinchu, founded in 1987 by Morris Chang. As the world's largest chip foundry, it produces the most advanced processors for Apple, Nvidia, AMD and Qualcomm.
tsn: Tyson Foods is one of the world's largest meat producers, headquartered in Springdale, Arkansas, and founded in 1935. It processes chicken, beef and pork and sells food under the Tyson, Jimmy Dean, Hillshire Farm and Ball Park brands.
tst: Test (TST) is a memecoin on BNB Chain that the network's team launched on the four.meme platform as a test token for a tutorial video. Despite the plan, it became popular and now trades on exchanges as a memecoin.
tsuki: Tsuki (TSUKI) is a cat-themed meme coin on the Solana blockchain. Its name means moon in Japanese, and the project builds its community image around Japanese culture; the token has no function beyond trading and community.
tt: Trane Technologies is an Irish-domiciled climate technology company that makes heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) systems for buildings and homes. Its brands include Trane and American Standard, and Thermo King for refrigerated trucks and containers.
tt-token: ThunderCore (TT) is the coin of ThunderCore, a fast, low-fee layer-1 blockchain that is compatible with Ethereum's EVM. It focuses on everyday apps, games and DeFi, and TT pays network fees and is used for staking.
ttc: Toro is a US maker of outdoor equipment from Bloomington, Minnesota, founded in 1914. It sells lawn mowers, snow blowers, golf-course and sports-field machines, irrigation systems and construction equipment under brands such as Toro, Exmark and Ditch Witch.
ttd: The Trade Desk is an advertising technology company from Ventura, California, founded in 2009. Its self-service platform lets advertisers and agencies buy digital ads automatically across websites, apps, connected TV, audio and more.
tte: TotalEnergies is a French energy company based in Paris and one of the world's largest oil and gas groups, with roots going back to 1924. It produces oil and gas, is a major LNG supplier, refines oil, runs a network of filling stations and is rapidly expanding solar and wind power.
ttek: Tetra Tech is a US consulting and engineering firm from Pasadena, California. It specialises in water, the environment and infrastructure, advising governments and companies on water supply, climate resilience, clean-up and international development projects.
ttkom: Türk Telekom is Turkey's largest fixed-line operator, based in Ankara, and the country's former state telecom. It owns the national fibre backbone and provides home internet, mobile service and Tivibu TV to millions of subscribers.
ttlk: Tattelecom is the main fixed-line telecom operator in Tatarstan, Russia, based in Kazan. It provides home internet, TV, landline phone and data services to households and businesses across the republic.
ttmi: TTM Technologies is a US maker of printed circuit boards from Santa Ana, California. It produces advanced PCBs, radio-frequency components and electronic assemblies for aerospace and defense, data centers, networking, medical and automotive customers.
ttrak: Türk Traktör is a Turkish tractor maker based in Ankara, founded in 1954 and jointly owned by Koç Holding and CNH. It builds New Holland and Case IH tractors and other farm machinery for Turkey and for export.
ttwo: Take-Two Interactive is an American video game publisher based in New York, founded in 1993. It owns Rockstar Games, maker of Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption, the 2K label behind NBA 2K, Civilization and BioShock, and the mobile games company Zynga, bought in 2022.
ttwo-token: This is a tokenized version of Take-Two Interactive stock issued by Backpack, giving crypto users price exposure to the shares. Take-Two is the New York-based video game publisher behind Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption (Rockstar Games) and NBA 2K.
tuprs: Tüpraş is Turkey's largest oil refiner and part of the Koç Group. It runs four refineries, including İzmit and İzmir, and produces petrol, diesel, jet fuel and fuel oil for the Turkish market and for export.
turbo: Turbo (TURBO) is a meme coin on Ethereum created in 2023 by artist Rhett Mankind following prompts from the GPT-4 chatbot and a budget of 69 dollars. It is promoted as the first meme coin designed by artificial intelligence; the token has no practical function.
turbos: Turbos Finance (TURBOS) is the token of Turbos, a decentralised exchange on the Sui blockchain with concentrated-liquidity pools and a token launch platform; early backers include Mysten Labs and Jump Crypto.
tursg: Türkiye Sigorta is a state-owned Turkish insurance company formed in 2020 by merging the insurers of the state banks, and part of the Türkiye Wealth Fund. It sells property, motor, health, agricultural and other non-life insurance.
turtle: Turtle (TURTLE) is a DeFi liquidity platform launched in 2024 that matches crypto protocols seeking liquidity with liquidity providers, curating reward campaigns and tracking deposits and rewards without taking custody of funds.
tusd: TrueUSD (TUSD) is a dollar-pegged stablecoin launched in 2018 by TrustToken and later sold to Techteryx, a company linked to the Tron ecosystem. Its reserves are meant to be held in dollars and short-term assets, with attestations published online, and it runs on Ethereum, Tron and other networks.
tut: Tutorial (TUT) is a memecoin on BNB Chain. It grew out of a developer's video tutorial on how to launch your own token on BNB Chain, and aims to promote building projects on that network.
tvsmotor: TVS Motor is an Indian maker of motorcycles, scooters and three-wheelers based in Chennai, part of the TVS Group. Its best-known models include the Apache motorcycles, the Jupiter scooter and the electric iQube, and it owns the British brand Norton.
tweka: TKH Group is a Dutch technology company based in Haaksbergen. It makes machine-vision cameras and security systems, specialised cables for energy and telecom networks, and automated systems for building tyres.
twlo: Twilio is an American cloud company from San Francisco, founded in 2008. Its APIs let developers build SMS, voice calls, video, email and chat into their apps, for example for login codes and notifications.
twt: Trust Wallet Token (TWT) is the token of Trust Wallet, a popular mobile crypto wallet owned by Binance since 2018. TWT holders get fee discounts inside the wallet, bonuses and a vote on how the product develops.
tx: tx is a US platform for tokenized real-world assets: issuing, trading and settling tokenized stocks, ETFs and alternative assets through a network of regulated partners. KYC/AML checks are built directly into the tokens.
txar: Ternium Argentina, formerly Siderar, is Argentina's largest flat steel producer and part of the Techint group's Ternium. Its main plant in San Nicolás, Buenos Aires province, makes hot- and cold-rolled, coated and galvanised steel sheet for cars, appliances, construction and the energy industry.
txn: Texas Instruments is a US semiconductor maker based in Dallas, founded in 1930. It leads in analog and embedded chips for industry and cars, is also known for school calculators, and its engineer Jack Kilby invented the integrated circuit.
txnm: TXNM Energy, formerly PNM Resources, is a US electric utility holding company from Albuquerque, New Mexico. It owns PNM, the largest power company in New Mexico, and TNMP, which runs power lines in Texas.
txrh: Texas Roadhouse is a US restaurant company from Louisville, Kentucky, founded in 1993 by Kent Taylor. It runs Texas Roadhouse steakhouses known for hand-cut steaks and fresh-baked rolls, plus the Bubba's 33 and Jaggers chains.
txt: Textron is a US industrial conglomerate from Providence, Rhode Island, founded in 1923. It makes Cessna and Beechcraft airplanes, Bell helicopters including military tiltrotors, defense systems and drones from Textron Systems, and industrial and specialty vehicles.
txt-pl: Text (formerly LiveChat Software) is a Polish software company from Wrocław, founded in 2002. It builds cloud apps that help businesses talk to customers — the LiveChat website chat, ChatBot and the HelpDesk ticketing system — used by companies in 150 countries.
tyl: Tyler Technologies is a US software company from Plano, Texas, that serves the public sector. Its software runs courts, tax and payment systems, public safety, schools and city and county administration for thousands of local governments.
u: Unity Software is a San Francisco company behind the Unity engine, a widely used tool for making video games, especially mobile games, as well as 3D apps and simulations. Founded in Copenhagen in 2004, it also earns from advertising tools that help app makers grow and monetise.
u11: UOB (United Overseas Bank) is one of Singapore's three big banks, founded in 1935 as the United Chinese Bank. It has a large network across Southeast Asia, especially Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam, and in 2022–2023 took over Citigroup's consumer banking in four ASEAN countries.
u96: Sembcorp Industries is a Singapore energy and urban development company. It builds and runs power plants, solar and wind farms and battery storage in Singapore, India, China and other countries, and develops large industrial parks and townships in Vietnam, Indonesia and China.
uai: UnifAI Network is infrastructure for autonomous AI agents that makes DeFi simpler: agents carry out investment strategies on a user's behalf, and developers can build their own agents on the platform. UAI is the ecosystem token.
ual: United Airlines is one of the world's largest airlines, headquartered in Chicago. It has hubs in Chicago, Denver, Houston, Newark and San Francisco, flies domestic and international routes and is a founding member of Star Alliance.
ub: Unibase is a decentralized memory layer for AI agents, giving them long-term memory and the ability to work across different platforms. The project builds blockchain infrastructure for an "open agent internet"; UB is the ecosystem token.
uber: Uber is an American tech company from San Francisco, founded in 2009. Through its app people order rides with drivers, food and grocery delivery (Uber Eats) and freight transport (Uber Freight) in dozens of countries.
ubsg: UBS is Switzerland's largest bank, headquartered in Zurich and Basel. It is the world leader in managing wealth for affluent clients, and in 2023 it took over its long-time rival Credit Suisse.
ubsi: United Bankshares is a US regional bank holding company based in Charleston, West Virginia, and Washington, D.C. Through United Bank it offers deposits, loans, mortgages and wealth management across the Mid-Atlantic and Southeast.
ubt: Unibright is a German blockchain company that builds tools for connecting business processes to blockchains, including a visual workflow designer that works without coding. UBT is the token used across its platform and services.
ucb: UCB is a Belgian biopharmaceutical company from Brussels, founded in 1928. It develops medicines for serious neurological and immune diseases, such as the epilepsy drugs Keppra and Briviact and the psoriasis treatment Bimzelx.
ucg: UniCredit is one of Italy's largest banks, headquartered in Milan. Beyond Italy it owns major banks in Germany (HypoVereinsbank), Austria (Bank Austria) and Central and Eastern Europe, serving retail and corporate clients.
ucn: UCHAIN (UCN) is the coin of UCHAIN, a high-speed blockchain that supports smart contracts and says it can process more than 2,000 transactions per second, aimed at developers building decentralized applications.
udr: UDR is a US real estate investment trust from Highlands Ranch, Colorado. It owns, develops and rents out apartment communities in major US cities, from the coasts to the Sun Belt.
ufd: Unicorn Fart Dust (UFD) is a meme coin on Solana, launched through the pump.fun platform in 2024. It is driven by humor and community and has no built-in utility.
ufpi: UFP Industries is a US wood and building-products company from Grand Rapids, Michigan, founded in 1955. It makes treated lumber, decking, roof trusses, pallets and crates for retail home-improvement stores, homebuilders and factories.
ugi: UGI Corporation is a US energy distributor from King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, founded in 1882. It sells propane through AmeriGas and in Europe, and runs natural gas and electric utilities in Pennsylvania and West Virginia.
ugld: UGC (Uzhuralzoloto Group of Companies) is one of Russia's largest gold miners, based in the Chelyabinsk region of the Southern Urals. It runs gold mines and processing plants in the Urals and sells refined gold.
ugpa3: Ultrapar is a Brazilian holding company from São Paulo founded in 1937. Through Ipiranga it sells fuel at a nationwide chain of service stations, through Ultragaz it distributes bottled LPG, and through Ultracargo it runs liquid bulk storage terminals.
uhs: Universal Health Services is a US hospital operator from Pennsylvania, founded in 1979. It runs acute-care hospitals and one of the largest networks of behavioral health facilities in the US, and also operates in the UK.
ukuz: Yuzhny Kuzbass is a Russian coal mining company in the Kemerovo region, part of the Mechel group. It mines coking and steam coal in the Kuzbass basin through open-pit and underground mines.
ulker: Ülker is a Turkish confectionery maker from Istanbul, founded in 1944. It makes biscuits, chocolate, crackers and snacks for Turkey, the Middle East and Central Asia, and belongs to Yıldız Holding, which also owns the Godiva brand.
uls: UL Solutions is a global safety science company from Northbrook, Illinois, whose roots go back to Underwriters Laboratories, founded in 1894. It tests and certifies products — the familiar UL mark — and sells inspection, advisory and safety software services.
ulta: Ulta Beauty is the largest beauty retailer in the US, based in Bolingbrook, Illinois, and founded in 1990. It sells cosmetics, fragrance and skin and hair care from drugstore to luxury brands, and runs beauty salons inside its stores.
ultima: Ultima (ULTIMA) is the token of the Ultima ecosystem, which runs on its own DPoS blockchain and focuses on fast, cheap everyday payments. The ecosystem includes a wallet, a payment card and other services for storing and spending the coins.
ultracemco: UltraTech Cement is India's largest cement maker and part of the Aditya Birla Group, based in Mumbai. It produces grey cement, ready-mix concrete and white cement (Birla White) at plants across India and abroad, supplying homes, infrastructure and commercial projects, and is one of the biggest cement companies in the world outside China.
ulvr: Unilever is a British consumer-goods company based in London, founded in 1929. It sells personal care, beauty and food products to billions of people under brands such as Dove, Rexona, Axe, Knorr, Hellmann's and Domestos.
uma: UMA (Universal Market Access) is a DeFi protocol for creating financial contracts and a decentralized oracle. Its "optimistic oracle" confirms real-world events and data for smart contracts, including resolving Polymarket prediction markets; the UMA token is used for voting and settling disputes.
umbf: UMB Financial is a US bank holding company from Kansas City, Missouri, founded in 1913. Through UMB Bank it serves businesses, institutions and individuals with commercial and personal banking, wealth management and fund services.
umbra: Umbra (UMBRA) is a privacy infrastructure project on Solana that lets users send, receive and hold tokens privately, hiding balances and transaction details. Its token was launched through the MetaDAO launchpad.
umc: UMC (United Microelectronics) is a Taiwanese contract chipmaker from Hsinchu, founded in 1980 as Taiwan's first semiconductor company. It manufactures chips on mature process nodes for cars, displays, communications and consumer electronics.
umg: Universal Music Group is the world's largest music company, headquartered in Hilversum (Netherlands) and Santa Monica. Its labels such as Republic, Interscope, Island and Def Jam release Taylor Swift, Billie Eilish and The Weeknd, and it manages a huge catalog of music rights.
umi: Umicore is a Belgian materials technology and recycling company from Brussels, with roots going back to 1805. It makes catalysts that clean car exhaust, battery materials and specialty metals, and recovers precious metals from electronic and industrial waste.
umia: Umia is an on-chain venture protocol: founders launch a token and raise money in an open auction, the funds sit in an on-chain treasury the team cannot spend alone, and token holders steer the treasury through decision markets.
umxm: Manadia (UMXM) is a Web3 infrastructure project that combines AI collaboration with privacy-preserving computation. It aims to provide verifiable data settlement and private value transfer between on-chain and off-chain systems, for uses such as finance and asset digitization.
unac: United Aircraft Corporation (UAC) is Russia's state aircraft-building holding, formed in 2006 and part of Rostec. It unites Sukhoi, MiG, Ilyushin, Tupolev and Yakovlev, building military jets, airliners and transport aircraft.
unh: UnitedHealth Group is the largest health insurance company in the United States, based in Minnetonka, Minnesota. It has two parts: UnitedHealthcare sells health insurance, while Optum runs clinics, pharmacy benefits, health data and software for hospitals.
uni: UNI is the governance token of Uniswap, the largest decentralised exchange (DEX) on Ethereum, launched in 2018 by Hayden Adams. Uniswap lets people swap tokens straight from their wallet via liquidity pools, and UNI holders vote on protocol changes.
uni-es: Unicaja Banco is a Spanish bank based in Málaga, created from regional savings banks. It serves households and small businesses with mortgages, accounts, insurance and investment funds, mainly in Andalusia and Castilla y León.
unm: Unum Group is a US insurer from Chattanooga, Tennessee, and a leading provider of disability insurance. It sells workplace benefits through employers — disability, life, accident, critical illness, dental and vision cover — in the US and UK, plus Colonial Life policies.
unp: Union Pacific is the largest US railroad by track length, headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, and founded in 1862. It hauls coal, grain, chemicals, cars and containers across a network of tens of thousands of kilometres of track in the western United States.
unp-token: Unipoly (UNP) is a GameFi project launched in October 2023 that is building a decentralized entertainment platform mixing games with real-estate-themed elements. The UNP token serves as the currency of its ecosystem.
untr: United Tractors is a Jakarta-based Indonesian company and part of the Astra group. It is Indonesia's largest distributor of Komatsu heavy equipment, provides mining contracting services and mines coal and gold.
unvr: Unilever Indonesia is the Indonesian arm of the British consumer-goods group Unilever, operating in the country since 1933. It makes and sells everyday products such as Pepsodent toothpaste, Lifebuoy soap, Rinso detergent and Royco seasonings.
up: Unitas (UP) is a yield-bearing stablecoin protocol from Unipay: its dollar token earns income through delta-neutral arbitrage strategies, including ones built on JLP on Solana. The UP token is tied to the protocol's governance and incentives.
upc: UPCX is an open-source payment system running on its own fast blockchain built for payments and financial services. It offers a wallet app for transfers and settlements, and UPC is the network's native coin.
upm: UPM-Kymmene is a Finnish forest industry company based in Helsinki. It makes pulp, graphic and specialty paper, self-adhesive label materials (Raflatac), plywood and timber, and also produces renewable fuels and energy from wood.
upr: Uniphar is an Irish healthcare services company based in Dublin. It distributes medicines to pharmacies and hospitals, supplies medical devices across Europe, helps pharma companies bring products to market, and runs the Hickey's and Allcare pharmacy chains.
upro: Unipro is a Russian power generator, formerly E.ON Russia, that runs large thermal power plants such as Surgut GRES-2 and Berezovskaya GRES. Since 2023 it has been under temporary Russian state management after Germany's Uniper lost control.
ups: United Parcel Service (UPS) is a US package delivery and logistics giant based in Atlanta, founded in 1907 in Seattle. Its brown trucks and own airline deliver parcels in more than 200 countries, and it also offers freight, supply-chain and healthcare logistics.
upst: Upstart is a US online lending marketplace from San Mateo, California, founded in 2012 by former Google employees. It uses AI models instead of credit scores alone to approve personal, auto and home-equity loans, which are funded by partner banks, credit unions and investors.
uqa: UNIQA is an Austrian insurance group based in Vienna. It offers property, health and life insurance to millions of customers in Austria and across Central and Eastern Europe.
uqc: Uquid Coin (UQC) is an Ethereum token linked to the Uquid online store, where shoppers can buy goods, gift cards and mobile top-ups with cryptocurrency. UQC gives discounts and is used within that ecosystem.
ura: Global X Uranium (URA) invests in uranium miners and companies in the nuclear power supply chain.
urbn: Urban Outfitters, Inc. is a US lifestyle retailer from Philadelphia, founded in 1970. It owns the Urban Outfitters, Anthropologie and Free People brands, selling clothing, accessories and home goods in stores and online, and runs Nuuly, a monthly clothing rental service.
uri: United Rentals is the world's largest equipment rental company, founded in 1997 in Stamford, Connecticut. It rents out excavators, aerial lifts, generators, tools and other equipment to builders, factories and utilities in the US and Canada.
urkz: Uralskaya Kuznitsa is a Russian forging plant in Chebarkul, Chelyabinsk region, part of the Mechel group. It makes heavy forgings and stampings for aircraft, power engineering, railways and the oil and gas industry.
us: Talus is an AI infrastructure network that gives autonomous AI agents an on-chain layer to run on. Its Nexus protocol lets agents carry out verifiable tasks and workflows on the blockchain, and the US token powers the network.
usb: U.S. Bancorp is the parent of U.S. Bank, one of the largest banks in the United States, headquartered in Minneapolis. It offers checking and savings accounts, mortgages, credit cards, business loans, payment processing and wealth management.
usbn: Bank Uralsib is a Russian private bank headquartered in Moscow, with historic roots in Ufa, Bashkortostan. It offers loans, deposits, cards and mortgages to individuals and banking services to small and large businesses.
usd0: Usual USD (USD0) is a dollar stablecoin from Usual, a Paris-founded DeFi protocol launched in 2024. It is backed one-to-one by tokenized short-term US Treasury bills, and the protocol's USUAL token gives holders a share of its revenue and governance.
usd1: USD1 is a dollar-pegged stablecoin launched in 2025 by World Liberty Financial, a crypto project linked to the Trump family. Its reserves are held in short-term US Treasuries, dollar deposits and cash equivalents, with custody by BitGo, and it runs on Ethereum and BNB Chain.
usdc: USDC is a dollar-pegged stablecoin issued by Circle, a US fintech company, launched in 2018 together with Coinbase. Each token is backed by cash and short-term US Treasuries held at regulated institutions, and it is used for payments, trading and DeFi on Ethereum, Solana and other networks.
usdd: USDD is a dollar-pegged stablecoin of the Tron ecosystem, launched in 2022 and associated with Tron founder Justin Sun. It is over-collateralized with crypto reserves such as TRX and other stablecoins, runs mainly on the TRON network and is used in its DeFi apps.
usde: Ethena USDe (USDE) is a synthetic dollar from Ethena Labs, launched in 2024. Instead of bank deposits it holds crypto such as ETH and BTC and offsets their price moves with short futures positions; staked USDe (sUSDe) earns the funding and staking income.
usdf: Falcon USD (USDF) is a synthetic dollar from Falcon Finance, a project backed by DWF Labs. Users mint it by depositing stablecoins, bitcoin, ether and other assets worth more than the USDF they receive; staking it as sUSDf earns yield from market-neutral trading strategies.
usdg: Global Dollar (USDG) is a dollar-pegged stablecoin issued by Paxos from Singapore under the city's stablecoin rules, launched in 2024. It belongs to the Global Dollar Network, whose members such as Robinhood and Kraken share the reserve income, and it runs on Ethereum and Solana.
usdgo: USDGO is a stablecoin designed to keep a 1:1 value with the US dollar. Like other dollar stablecoins, it is used to hold dollar value on the blockchain, move money between exchanges and wallets, and pay or trade without converting back to a bank account.
usds: USDS is the dollar-pegged stablecoin of Sky, the protocol formerly known as MakerDAO, launched in 2024 as the upgraded successor to DAI. DAI can be swapped for USDS one-to-one, and holders can deposit it to earn the Sky Savings Rate.
usdt: Tether (USDT) is the largest stablecoin, a token designed to stay equal to one US dollar. Issued by Tether since 2014 and backed mainly by cash and US Treasury bills, it runs on Tron, Ethereum and many other networks and is widely used for trading and transfers.
useless: Useless Coin (USELESS) is a Solana memecoin launched in 2025 that openly presents itself as a "useless" token with no function at all. The whole idea is irony about crypto speculation, and its price depends only on community demand.
usfd: US Foods is one of the largest foodservice distributors in the United States, based in Rosemont, Illinois. It delivers food, kitchen supplies and equipment to restaurants, hospitals, hotels, schools and government kitchens, and runs CHEF'STORE cash-and-carry shops.
usg: USG is an over-collateralized dollar stablecoin issued by Tangent Finance on Ethereum. Users borrow USG against yield-bearing collateral such as boosted Curve LP tokens and keep most of the underlying yield, while sUSG shares protocol revenue with savers.
uso: United States Oil Fund • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of United States Oil Fund (USO) shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. It follows the price of the US-listed stock and can be traded around the clock on a blockchain.
usual: Usual is a DeFi protocol that issues the USD0 stablecoin, backed by tokenized US Treasury bonds and other real-world assets. The USUAL token gives holders governance rights and a share of the protocol's revenue.
usualx: USUALx is the staked form of USUAL, the governance token of Usual, the protocol that issues the USD0 dollar stablecoin backed by tokenized US Treasury bills. Holders lock USUAL to receive USUALx and a share of the protocol's rewards.
utar: UTair is a Russian airline with roots in a Tyumen aviation unit set up in 1967, now based in Western Siberia. It flies domestic passenger routes, many from Moscow Vnukovo and Surgut, and its group also provides helicopter services.
uthr: United Therapeutics is a US biotech company from Silver Spring, Maryland, founded in 1996 by Martine Rothblatt. It sells medicines for pulmonary arterial hypertension, such as Tyvaso, Remodulin and Orenitram, and is developing manufactured organs for transplant.
utya: Utya is a memecoin on the TON blockchain inspired by the popular Utya duck stickers in Telegram. It has no function beyond its community and the fame of the yellow duck character among Telegram users.
uwgn: OVK (United Wagon Company) is a Russian maker of railway freight wagons based in Moscow. Its main plant in Tikhvin, Leningrad region, builds modern freight cars and bogies, and the company also leases wagons to rail operators.
v: Visa is a San Francisco-based US payments company that runs the world's largest card payment network. It does not issue cards or lend money itself: banks issue Visa cards, and Visa earns a fee for processing each transaction.
